title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Whole Wheat Bagel
ingredients_json: ["1 whole Wheat bagel", "30 g Cream cheese, light", "50 g Smoked salmon, lean", "5 g Fresh dill, chopped", "0.5 dl Rocket salad", "0.25 piece Lemon, raw"]
instructions: Toast the whole wheat bagel until golden brown and slightly crisp. While the bagel is toasting, gently spread the light cream cheese evenly over both halves of the toasted bagel. Arrange the smoked salmon slices over the cream cheese on the bottom half of the bagel. Sprinkle the chopped fresh dill over the salmon. Top with a handful of fresh rocket salad. Squeeze a small amount of fresh lemon juice over the filling. Place the top half of the bagel on top to complete your sandwich.

title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Whole Wheat Bagel
ingredients_json: ["1 piece Whole wheat bagel", "30 g Cream cheese, light", "50 g Smoked salmon, thinly sliced", "5 g Capers, drained", "5 g Red onion, finely chopped", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Toast the whole wheat bagel until golden brown and slightly crisp. While the bagel is toasting, spread the light cream cheese evenly over both halves of the toasted bagel. Layer the thinly sliced smoked salmon on top of the cream cheese. Sprinkle the drained capers and finely chopped red onion over the salmon. Finish with a grind of fresh black pepper. Close the bagel and serve immediately.

title: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Whole Wheat Bagel
ingredients_json: ["1 whole Wheat Bagel", "50 g Smoked salmon, raw", "50 g Avocado, ripe", "30 g Cream cheese, light", "10 g Red onion, raw", "1 dl Spinach, raw", "0.5 piece Lemon"]
instructions: Slice the whole wheat bagel in half horizontally and toast it lightly. While the bagel is toasting, mash the ripe avocado in a small bowl with a fork. Squeeze in a little bit of fresh lemon juice to prevent browning and add flavour. Finely chop the red onion. Spread the light cream cheese evenly over the bottom half of the toasted bagel. Layer the fresh spinach leaves on top of the cream cheese. Arrange the slices of smoked salmon over the spinach. Spoon the mashed avocado over the salmon. Sprinkle the chopped red onion on top of the avocado. Place the top half of the toasted bagel on top to complete. Slice in half if desired.

title: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Whole Wheat Bagel
ingredients_json: ["1 piece Whole wheat bagel, 100g", "50 g Smoked salmon, thinly sliced", "0.5 piece Avocado, ripe, 60g", "30 g Cream cheese, light", "5 g Fresh dill, chopped", "1 slice Red onion, thinly sliced", "0.5 tsp Lemon juice"]

Arrange the thinly sliced red onion over the avocado. Sprinkle with fresh chopped dill. Place the top half of the bagel on top.

title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Whole Wheat Bagel
ingredients_json: ["1 whole wheat bagel", "30 g Cream cheese, light", "50 g Smoked salmon, pre-sliced", "10 g Red onion, thinly sliced", "5 g Fresh dill, chopped", "1/4 piece Lemon, juice"]

title: Whole Wheat Banana Oat Bread
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "100 g Ripe bananas, mashed", "80 g Maple syrup", "60 ml Unsweetened almond milk", "50 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "40 g Walnuts, chopped", "30 ml Coconut oil, melted", "10 g Baking powder", "5 g Vanilla extract", "2 g Cinnamon, ground", "1 g Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F) and lightly grease a standard loaf pan or line it with parchment paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate medium bowl, mash the ripe bananas until smooth, then whisk in the maple syrup, almond milk, Greek yogurt, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined; be careful not to overmix. Gently fold in the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and spread evenly. Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Bread with Walnuts and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "1.5 tsp Baking soda", "1 tsp Ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp Ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp Salt", "3 large Ripe bananas, mashed", "100 g Unsweetened applesauce", "80 ml Maple syrup", "60 ml Coconut oil, melted", "2 tsp Vanilla extract", "2 large Eggs, raw", "100 g Walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 degrees C (350 degrees F) and grease and flour a standard loaf pan. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. In a separate medium bowl, combine the mashed bananas, unsweetened applesauce, maple syrup, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract. Stir in the eggs until well combined. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Fold in the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and bake for 55-65 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the banana bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Oat Bread
ingredients_json: ["200 g Banana, ripe, mashed", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats", "60 g Honey", "60 ml Olive oil", "2 large Eggs, raw", "1 tsp Baking soda", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1/2 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "1/4 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 degrees C (350 degrees F). Grease and flour a standard loaf pan or line it with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine the mashed ripe bananas, honey, olive oil, and eggs. Mix until well combined. In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and spread evenly. Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Bread with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "100 g Brown sugar, light", "10 g Baking powder", "5 g Ground cinnamon", "2 g Salt", "3 pieces Banana, ripe, mashed", "100 ml Vegetable oil", "2 pieces Egg, large, raw", "50 g Walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Grease and flour a 23x13 cm (9x5 inch) loaf pan. Gently fold in the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and spread evenly. Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Bread with Walnuts and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats, whole", "10 g Baking powder", "5 g Ground cinnamon", "2 g Ground nutmeg", "3 pieces Banana, ripe, mashed", "100 g Honey", "60 ml Coconut oil, melted", "2 pieces Egg, raw, large", "1 dl Milk, unsweetened almond", "100 g Walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit) and lightly grease a standard loaf pan. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and nutmeg. In a separate bowl, mash the ripe bananas until smooth, then stir in the honey, melted coconut oil, eggs, and almond milk until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined; do not overmix. Fold in the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Whole Wheat Apple Cinnamon Biscuits
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats", "15 g Baking powder", "5 g Salt", "10 g Ground cinnamon", "2 g Ground nutmeg", "50 g Unsalted butter, cold, cubed", "150 ml Skim milk", "1 unit Egg, large, lightly beaten", "50 g Apple, finely chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees C (400 degrees F). In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Cut in the cold, cubed butter using a pastry blender or your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in the finely chopped apple. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the skim milk and the lightly beaten egg. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix. The dough should be slightly sticky. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and gently pat it into a 2 cm thick round. Cut out biscuits using a round cutter. Place the biscuits on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15-18 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve warm.

title: Whole Wheat Berry Biscuits with Greek Yogurt Dip
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g All-purpose flour", "10 g Baking powder", "5 g Salt", "30 g Granulated sugar", "60 g Cold unsalted butter, cut into small cubes", "180 ml Milk, low-fat", "50 g Mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "5 g Honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F). In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry blender or your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in the milk until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Gently fold in the mixed berries. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat it down to about 2 cm thickness. Cut out biscuits using a round cutter. Place the biscuits on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown and puffed up. While the biscuits are baking, mix the Greek yogurt with honey in a small bowl to create the dip. Serve the warm biscuits with the yogurt dip.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Oat Biscuits with Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "50 g Brown sugar", "2 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp Salt", "120 g Ripe banana, mashed", "80 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "60 ml Vegetable oil", "1 piece Egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/Gas mark 6). In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, mash the ripe banana until smooth, then whisk in the milk, vegetable oil, and egg until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Be careful not to overmix. The dough will be sticky. Lightly flour a surface and turn out the dough. Gently pat or roll the dough to about 2cm thickness. Cut out biscuits using a round cutter and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Let them cool slightly before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Berry Biscuits with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g All-purpose flour", "15 g Baking powder", "5 g Salt", "50 g Unsalted butter, cold, cubed", "150 ml Milk, low-fat", "75 g Mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "15 g Honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F). In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and salt. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry blender or your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in the mixed berries. Gradually add the milk, mixing until just combined into a shaggy dough; do not overmix. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat it into a 2 cm thick disc. Cut out biscuits using a 5 cm round cutter, re-patting scraps gently once. Place the biscuits on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown and risen. While the biscuits are baking, whisk together the Greek yogurt and honey in a small bowl to create a glaze. Once the biscuits are out of the oven and slightly cooled, drizzle with the Greek yogurt glaze.

title: Whole Wheat Berry Biscuits with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g All-purpose flour", "10 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt", "30 g Sugar, granulated", "100 g Mixed berries, frozen", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "60 ml Milk, skim", "30 g Butter, unsalted, melted"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius (400 degrees Fahrenheit). In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar. Gently stir in the frozen mixed berries. In a separate small bowl, combine the Greek yogurt and skim milk until smooth. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix. The dough will be sticky. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat it into a 2 cm (3/4 inch) thick rectangle. Cut out biscuits using a round cutter or knife. Place the biscuits on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush the tops of the biscuits with the melted butter. Bake for 15-18 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Let cool slightly before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Berry Blintzes with Greek Yogurt and Mixed Berries
ingredients_json: ["1.5 dl Whole wheat flour", "0.5 dl All-purpose flour", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "3 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tbsp Sugar, granulated", "1 pinch Salt", "1 tbsp Butter, unsalted, melted", "150 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "2 tbsp Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "1 tsp Lemon zest", "1 dl Mixed berries, fresh or frozen"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, sugar, and salt. In a separate bowl, lightly beat the eggs, then whisk in the milk and melted butter. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk until just combined and smooth, with no lumps. Let the batter rest for 15 minutes. Heat a lightly oiled non-stick skillet over medium heat. Pour about 0.75 dl of batter into the skillet, swirling to coat the bottom evenly. Cook for about 1-2 minutes per side, until golden brown. Repeat with the remaining batter, stacking the cooked blintzes on a plate. In a small bowl, mix the ricotta cheese with the Greek yogurt and lemon zest until well combined. Spoon about 1-2 tablespoons of the ricotta mixture onto the center of each blintz. Fold the blintz in half, then in half again to form a triangle, or roll it up. Serve immediately, topped with mixed berries.

title: Whole Wheat Berry Blintzes with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["1.5 dl Whole wheat flour", "1 dl All-purpose flour", "2 pcs Egg, raw", "3 dl Milk, semi-skimmed, unspecified", "0.5 dl Water, unspecified", "1 pinch Salt, table, unspecified", "15 g Butter, unsalted, unspecified", "200 g Greek yogurt, 2%", "100 g Mixed berries, frozen, unspecified", "1 tbsp Honey, unspecified"]
instructions: To make the blintz batter, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, salt, and eggs in a large bowl until well combined. Gradually whisk in the milk and water until you have a smooth, thin batter. Melt the butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Pour about 0.75 dl of batter into the skillet, tilting to coat the bottom evenly. Cook for about 1-2 minutes until the edges are set and lightly golden. Flip carefully and cook for another 30 seconds. Slide the blintz onto a plate and repeat with the remaining batter. To serve, spoon Greek yogurt and mixed berries into the center of each blintz, drizzle with honey, and fold or roll them up.

title: Whole Wheat Berry Blintzes with Greek Yogurt and Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["1.5 dl Whole wheat flour", "1 dl All-purpose flour", "2 dl Milk, low-fat", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "1 pinch Salt", "1 tbsp Butter, unsalted, melted", "250 g Quark or thick Greek yogurt", "50 g Mixed berries, fresh", "1 tbsp Honey, liquid"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk and eggs. Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, whisking until a smooth batter forms. Stir in the melted butter. Heat a lightly oiled non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat. Pour about 0.6 dl of batter into the hot skillet and swirl to spread it thinly. Cook for about 1-2 minutes per side, until golden brown. Repeat with the remaining batter. Let the blintzes cool slightly. Fill each blintz with about 1-2 tablespoons of quark or Greek yogurt and some fresh berries. Fold or roll the blintzes. Drizzle with honey before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Blintzes with Greek Yogurt and Berries
ingredients_json: ["1.5 dl Whole wheat flour", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Sugar, white", "0.5 tsp Salt, table", "5 g Butter, unsalted", "200 g Greek yogurt, 2%", "100 g Mixed berries, frozen"]
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, milk, eggs, sugar, and salt until a smooth batter forms. Melt 1/2 teaspoon of butter in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Pour about 0.75 dl of batter into the hot pan and swirl to create a thin layer. Cook for 1-2 minutes per side, until golden brown. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining batter and butter. Once all blintzes are cooked, spoon 2 tablespoons of Greek yogurt and a sprinkle of mixed berries onto the center of each blintz. Fold the blintz in half, then in half again to form a triangle. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Blintzes with Quark and Mixed Berries
ingredients_json: ["2 dl Whole wheat flour", "3 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Rapeseed oil", "1 pinch Salt", "500 g Quark, low-fat", "50 g Honey", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "300 g Mixed berries, frozen or fresh"]
instructions: For the blintzes, whisk together the whole wheat flour, milk, eggs, rapeseed oil, and salt in a bowl until smooth. Heat a lightly oiled non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Pour about 0.75 dl of batter into the pan and swirl to coat the bottom thinly. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the edges lift and the bottom is golden brown. Flip and cook for another 30 seconds. Repeat with the remaining batter, stacking the cooked blintzes on a plate. For the filling, combine the quark, honey, and vanilla extract in a bowl and mix well. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the quark filling onto the center of each blintz. Fold in the sides and then roll up from the bottom. Serve the blintzes immediately, topped with the mixed berries.

title: Hearty Black Bean and Sweet Potato Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Whole wheat tortillas", "150 g Sweet potato, raw", "100 g Black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Spinach, raw", "30 g Onion, raw", "10 g Olive oil", "0.5 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.25 tsp Smoked paprika", "5 g Fresh cilantro, chopped", "50 g Low-fat cheese, grated"]
instructions: Peel and dice the sweet potato into small cubes. Finely chop the onion. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the diced sweet potato and chopped onion, and sauté for 8-10 minutes until the sweet potato is tender and slightly browned. Stir in the drained black beans, cumin, and smoked paprika, and cook for another 2 minutes until heated through. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg and pour it into the skillet with the sweet potato mixture. Cook, stirring gently, until the egg is scrambled and cooked through. Stir in the fresh spinach until it wilts. Warm the whole wheat tortillas according to package directions. Fill each tortilla with the sweet potato and black bean mixture, top with grated cheese and fresh cilantro. Fold the tortillas tightly to form burritos.

title: Hearty Black Bean and Sweet Potato Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["2 medium Sweet potatoes, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Chili powder", "0.5 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.25 tsp Smoked paprika", "250 g Black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "1 dl Corn, sweet, canned, drained", "4 large Eggs, raw", "4 whole Wheat tortillas, medium", "50 g Cheddar cheese, shredded", "1 dl Salsa", "1 dl Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Peel and dice the sweet potatoes into 1cm cubes. Toss the sweet potato cubes with olive oil, chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized, flipping halfway through. While the sweet potatoes are roasting, gently heat the black beans and corn in a small saucepan over medium heat until warmed through. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs. Lightly grease a non-stick frying pan and heat over medium-low heat. Pour in the whisked eggs and cook, stirring gently, until softly scrambled. Warm the tortillas according to package directions. To assemble the burritos, lay a warm tortilla flat. Spoon a quarter of the roasted sweet potato mixture, black beans, corn, scrambled eggs, shredded cheddar cheese, and salsa onto the center of each tortilla. Top with a dollop of Greek yogurt. Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then tightly roll it up from the bottom. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Breakfast Burritos with Black Beans and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["2 whole Wheat Tortillas, large", "2 large Egg, raw", "60 g Black Beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "30 g Avocado, ripe", "15 g Onion, red, finely chopped", "5 g Coriander, fresh, chopped", "1 tsp Olive Oil", "1/4 tsp Cumin, ground", "Salt, to taste", "Black Pepper, to taste"]
instructions: Warm a small non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil. Add the chopped red onion and sauté for 2-3 minutes until softened. Add the drained black beans and ground cumin, stirring to combine and heat through for another 2 minutes. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook until just wilted, about 1 minute. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Remove the bean and spinach mixture from the skillet and set aside. In a small bowl, whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper. Pour the eggs into the same skillet and scramble them until cooked through. Warm the whole wheat tortillas according to package instructions, usually for about 20-30 seconds per side. Lay each tortilla flat. Divide the scrambled eggs, black bean and spinach mixture, sliced avocado, and chopped coriander evenly between the two tortillas. Fold in the sides of each tortilla and then roll them up tightly to form burritos. Serve immediately.

title: Hearty Black Bean and Sweet Potato Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["2 medium Sweet potatoes, raw", "1 dl Olive oil", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Chili powder", "1 dl Black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "100 g Spinach, raw", "4 large Eggs, raw", "0.5 dl Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "100 g Cheese, cheddar, grated", "4 large Whole wheat tortillas, 20 cm diameter", "1 dl Salsa, tomato-based", "1 dl Greek yogurt, 2% fat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Peel and dice the sweet potatoes into 1 cm cubes. Toss the sweet potato cubes with 0.5 dl olive oil, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized. While the sweet potatoes are roasting, heat the remaining 0.5 dl olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the drained black beans and cook for 3-5 minutes until heated through. Stir in the spinach and cook until wilted, about 1-2 minutes. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet with the beans and spinach. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are set but still moist. Remove from heat and stir in the grated cheddar cheese. Warm the tortillas according to package directions. To assemble, spoon a portion of the roasted sweet potatoes, black bean and egg mixture, salsa, and a dollop of Greek yogurt onto the center of each tortilla. Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll up tightly from the bottom to create a burrito. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Breakfast Burritos with Black Beans and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["2 units Whole wheat tortillas", "200 g Black beans, canned, rinsed and drained", "4 units Egg, raw", "1 dl Spinach, fresh", "50 g Cheese, cheddar, grated", "1/2 piece Avocado", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1/4 tsp Cumin, ground", "1/4 tsp Chili powder", "Salt, to taste", "Black pepper, to taste"]
instructions: Warm the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the rinsed and drained black beans, cumin, and chili powder. Cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Add the fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 1-2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs and pour them into the skillet with the beans and spinach. Scramble the eggs until cooked through. Warm the whole wheat tortillas according to package directions. Place a portion of the egg and bean mixture onto each tortilla, then top with grated cheddar cheese and sliced avocado. Fold the tortillas to create burritos.

title: Spinach and Feta Breakfast Strata
ingredients_json: ["6 whole Eggs, raw", "3 dl Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "1 dl Water", "200 g Whole wheat bread, day-old, cut into cubes", "150 g Spinach, fresh, raw", "100 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "50 g Onion, raw", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic in 1 tbsp of olive oil in a pan over medium heat until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the fresh spinach to the pan and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Squeeze out any excess water from the spinach. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, water, salt, and pepper. Stir in the bread cubes, sautéed spinach and onion mixture, and crumbled feta cheese. Ensure the bread cubes are well coated with the liquid mixture. Pour the mixture into a greased 20x20 cm baking dish. Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until the strata is set and golden brown. Let it rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.

title: Hearty Spinach and Feta Breakfast Casserole
ingredients_json: ["6 piece Egg, raw", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "150 g Spinach, raw", "100 g Feta cheese, low-fat", "100 g Ham, lean, cooked", "50 g Onion, yellow, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit). Lightly grease a medium-sized baking dish. Finely chop the onion and sauté it in olive oil in a pan over medium heat until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the spinach to the pan and cook until wilted, then remove from heat and let it cool slightly. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk. Crumble the feta cheese and chop the ham into small pieces. Add the cooked spinach and onion mixture, crumbled feta, and chopped ham to the egg mixture. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the casserole is set and golden brown on top. Let it rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Savory Spinach and Feta Breakfast Casserole
ingredients_json: ["12 piece Egg, raw", "2 dl Milk, low-fat, 1.5% fat", "200 g Spinach, frozen, chopped", "150 g Feta cheese, low-fat", "100 g Onion, raw", "1 dl Whole wheat bread, coarse, chopped", "1 tsp Olive oil", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Sauté the chopped onion in olive oil in a pan over medium heat until softened, about 5 minutes. Squeeze excess water from the thawed spinach. In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk. Stir in the sautéed onion, squeezed spinach, crumbled feta cheese, chopped whole wheat bread, black pepper, and salt. Pour the mixture into a greased 20x30 cm baking dish. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the casserole is set and lightly golden brown on top. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Spinach and Feta Breakfast Casserole with Whole Wheat Bread
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat bread, day-old, cubed", "200 g Fresh spinach, chopped", "150 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "100 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "50 g Red bell pepper, chopped", "6 pieces Egg, raw", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.25 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "1 pinch Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit). Grease a medium-sized baking dish. In a large bowl, combine the cubed whole wheat bread, chopped spinach, crumbled feta cheese, chopped onion, and chopped red bell pepper. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, olive oil, black pepper, nutmeg, and salt until well combined. Pour the egg mixture evenly over the bread and vegetable mixture, ensuring all the bread is moistened. Gently toss to combine. Let the mixture sit for about 10 minutes to allow the bread to absorb the liquid. Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish. Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until the casserole is set and the top is golden brown. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Spinach and Feta Egg Bake with Whole Wheat Toast

title: Hearty Sweet Potato and Black Bean Breakfast Hash
ingredients_json: ["400 g Sweet potato, raw", "150 g Black beans, canned, rinsed and drained", "100 g Red onion, raw", "1 piece Bell pepper, red, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Chili powder", "100 ml Water", "1 pinch Salt", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground", "2 pieces Egg, raw"]

title: Rosemary and Garlic Roasted Sweet Potato Hash
ingredients_json: ["500 g Sweet potato, raw", "1 medium Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "0.5 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "5 g Fresh parsley, chopped"]

title: Hearty Sweet Potato and Black Bean Hash

title: Whole Wheat Spelt Cinnamon Rolls with Cream Cheese Frosting

title: Whole Wheat Apple Cinnamon Danishes with Greek Yogurt Filling

title: Whole Wheat Baked Apple Cinnamon Doughnuts

title: Savory Spinach and Feta English Muffins with Fried Egg
ingredients_json: ["2 whole English muffins, whole wheat", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "30 g Feta cheese, reduced fat, crumbled", "1 large Egg, raw", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground", "1 pinch Salt"]

title: Savory Sweet Potato and Spinach English Muffin Breakfast Sandwich

In a non-stick skillet, heat the remaining 1/2 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat. Add the fresh spinach and sauté until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Remove the spinach from the skillet and set aside. title: Savory Spinach and Feta Egg Muffins

title: Whole Wheat English Muffins with Avocado and Smoked Salmon

Top with slices of smoked salmon and sprinkle with fresh dill.

title: Whole Wheat French Toast with Berries and Greek Yogurt

ingredients_json: ["300 g Rolled oats", "100 g Almonds, blanched, whole", "50 g Pumpkin seeds", "50 g Sunflower seeds", "30 g Flax seeds", "80 ml Maple syrup", "60 ml Coconut oil, virgin", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/2 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1/4 tsp Salt", "50 g Dried cranberries", "50 g Dried blueberries"]

title: Hearty Maple Pecan Granola with Dried Cranberries

title: Creamy Parmesan Grits with Spinach and Fried Egg
ingredients_json: ["1.2 dl Grits, quick-cooking", "4 dl Water", "1 dl Milk, low-fat", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 tsp Olive oil", "0.5 g Salt", "0.2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring 4 dl of water to a boil. Gradually whisk in 1.2 dl of quick-cooking grits. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in 1 dl of low-fat milk and cook for another 2 minutes until creamy. Remove from heat and stir in 30 g of grated Parmesan cheese, 0.5 g of salt, and 0.2 g of black pepper. Stir in 50 g of fresh spinach until it wilts. While the grits are cooking, heat 1 tsp of olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Crack 1 egg into the skillet and fry until the whites are set and the yolk is cooked to your preference. Spoon the creamy grits into a bowl and top with the fried egg.

title: Creamy Stone-Ground Grits with Spinach and Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["1.5 dl Stone-ground grits, dry", "7.5 dl Water", "2.5 dl Milk, whole, unspecified", "5 g Salt", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "2 piece Egg, raw", "5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the dry grits, water, and salt. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally. Stir in the milk and cook for another 2-3 minutes until heated through and the grits are creamy. While the grits are simmering, poach the eggs: bring about 5 cm of water to a gentle simmer in a separate saucepan. Crack each egg into a small bowl, then gently slide them into the simmering water. Cook for 3-4 minutes for runny yolks, or longer to your preference. Remove the poached eggs with a slotted spoon. To serve, divide the creamy grits between two bowls. title: Creamy Spinach and Feta Grits with Poached Egg

title: Creamy Grits with Spinach and Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["1 dl Stone-ground grits", "4 dl Water", "1 dl Milk, low-fat", "1 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "2 piece Egg, raw", "5 g Butter"]

title: Savory Steel-Cut Oats with Spinach and Feta
ingredients_json: ["1.5 dl Steel-cut oats", "6 dl Water", "1 dl Low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "1 tbsp Olive oil"]

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Feta Kolaches
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g All-purpose flour", "7 g Dry yeast", "5 g Salt", "25 g Honey", "150 ml Warm water", "50 g Butter, unsalted, softened", "1 piece Egg, raw", "150 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "100 g Spinach, fresh, finely chopped", "1 dl Milk, whole, unspecified", "1 pinch Nutmeg, ground"]

Add the softened butter and the egg, and knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for about 8-10 minutes, until smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size. While the dough is rising, prepare the filling by combining the crumbled feta cheese, chopped spinach, milk, and ground nutmeg in a bowl. Season to taste if desired. title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Feta Kolaches

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, instant yeast, salt, and sugar. In a separate small bowl, warm the milk slightly (about 30-40°C) and whisk in the egg. title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Feta Kolaches

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Feta Kolaches
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g All-purpose flour", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "30 g Unsalted butter, cold, cut into cubes", "1 piece Egg, raw", "80 ml Milk, skim", "100 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "50 g Spinach, raw, chopped", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Feta Kolaches
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g All-purpose flour", "7 g Dried yeast", "1 tsp Sugar", "0.5 tsp Salt", "150 ml Lukewarm water", "30 ml Olive oil", "100 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "100 g Fresh spinach, roughly chopped", "1 piece Egg, raw, for egg wash", "1 tbsp Sesame seeds, optional"]

title: Whole Wheat Banana Nut Monkey Bread Muffins

title: Whole Wheat Banana Nut Monkey Bread

title: Whole Wheat Apple Cinnamon Monkey Bread

title: Whole Wheat Apple Cinnamon Monkey Bread

title: Hearty Berry and Nut Oatmeal with Chia Seeds

title: Hearty Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["1 dl Rolled oats", "2 dl Water", "1 dl Milk, low-fat", "1 medium Apple, raw, unspecified", "1 tbsp Maple syrup", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "20 g Walnuts, raw", "1 pinch Salt"]
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the rolled oats, water, milk, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer. While the oats are cooking, core and dice the apple into small pieces. Add the diced apple to the saucepan along with the cinnamon. Stir occasionally and cook for about 5-7 minutes, or until the oats have reached your desired consistency and the apple is softened. Stir in the maple syrup. Pour the oatmeal into a bowl and top with the chopped walnuts.

title: Hearty Steel-Cut Oats with Berries and Almonds
ingredients_json: ["1 dl Steel-cut oats", "3 dl Water", "1 dl Milk, semi-skimmed (1.5%)", "100 g Mixed berries, frozen", "20 g Almonds, blanched, chopped", "1 tsp Honey"]
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the steel-cut oats and water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the oats are tender and most of the water is absorbed. Stir in the milk and cook for another 5 minutes, uncovered, until the oatmeal reaches your desired consistency. While the oats are simmering, gently warm the frozen berries in a separate small saucepan or microwave until just heated through. To serve, spoon the oatmeal into a bowl, top with the warm berries and chopped almonds, and drizzle with honey.

title: Hearty Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["1 dl Rolled oats, whole", "2 dl Water", "1 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 medium Apple, raw, unspecified", "1 tbsp Maple syrup, light amber", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "20 g Walnuts, raw", "0.5 tsp Vanilla extract"]
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the rolled oats and water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the semi-skimmed milk and cook for another 3-5 minutes, or until the oatmeal reaches your desired consistency. While the oatmeal is cooking, dice the apple into small pieces. Stir the diced apple, maple syrup, cinnamon, and vanilla extract into the oatmeal. Cook for an additional 2 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the apple to soften slightly. Pour the oatmeal into a bowl and top with chopped walnuts.

title: Warm Spiced Apple and Walnut Oatmeal
ingredients_json: ["100 g Rolled oats", "4 dl Water", "0.5 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.25 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "100 g Apple, raw, with skin", "20 g Walnuts, raw", "1 tbsp Maple syrup"]
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the rolled oats and water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 5-7 minutes, or until the oats are tender and the mixture has thickened. Stir in the ground cinnamon and nutmeg. While the oats are cooking, dice the apple into small, bite-sized pieces. Once the oatmeal is cooked, stir in the diced apple and maple syrup. Serve the oatmeal hot, topped with the raw walnuts.

title: Spinach and Feta Omelet with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["2 large Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Milk, semi-skimmed", "50 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Feta cheese, low fat", "100 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "0.5 tbsp Olive oil", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and black pepper until well combined and slightly frothy. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the spinach to the hot skillet and cook for about 1-2 minutes until it wilts. Pour the egg mixture over the spinach. As the eggs begin to set around the edges, gently push the cooked portions towards the center with a spatula, allowing the uncooked egg to flow underneath. Scatter the crumbled feta cheese and halved cherry tomatoes over the top of the omelet. Continue to cook for another 2-3 minutes, or until the eggs are mostly set and the cheese is slightly softened. Carefully fold the omelet in half and slide it onto a plate.

title: Spinach and Feta Omelet with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["2 medium Egg, raw", "0.5 dl Milk, whole, unspecified", "50 g Spinach, fresh", "30 g Feta cheese, low fat", "6 Cherry tomato, raw", "1 tsp Olive oil", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.25 tsp Salt"]
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until well combined and slightly frothy. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the fresh spinach and cook for about 1-2 minutes until it wilts. Pour the egg mixture over the spinach. As the eggs begin to set around the edges, gently push the cooked portions towards the center, allowing the uncooked egg to flow underneath. Continue this process until the omelet is mostly set but still slightly moist on top. Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese and halved cherry tomatoes over one half of the omelet. Carefully fold the other half over the filling. Cook for another minute until the cheese is slightly melted. Slide the omelet onto a plate and serve immediately.

title: Spinach and Feta Omelet with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Egg, raw", "50 g Spinach, raw", "30 g Feta cheese, semi-hard", "50 g Cherry tomatoes", "5 g Olive oil", "10 ml Milk, whole, unspecified", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Whisk together the eggs, milk, and black pepper in a bowl until well combined. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the spinach and cook for 1-2 minutes until wilted. Pour in the egg mixture and cook for about 3-4 minutes, or until the edges begin to set. Gently lift the edges with a spatula and tilt the pan to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Once the omelet is almost set, sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese and halved cherry tomatoes over one half of the omelet. Fold the other half over the filling. Cook for another 1-2 minutes until the cheese is slightly melted and the omelet is cooked through. Slide the omelet onto a plate and serve immediately.

title: Spinach and Feta Omelet with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Egg, raw", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Feta cheese, low fat", "100 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "5 g Olive oil"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs and milk together in a bowl until well combined. Season with a little salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes until they start to soften. Pour the egg mixture over the tomatoes. As the eggs begin to set, gently pull the edges towards the center, tilting the pan to allow the uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook for about 4-5 minutes until the omelet is almost set. Scatter the spinach and crumbled feta cheese over one half of the omelet. Carefully fold the other half over the filling. Cook for another minute until the cheese is slightly melted and the spinach is wilted. Slide the omelet onto a plate and serve immediately.

title: Spinach and Feta Omelet with Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["2 piece Egg, raw", "1 dl Spinach, raw", "50 g Feta cheese, low fat", "50 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "0.5 dl Milk, skimmed", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs with milk and black pepper in a bowl until well combined. Heat olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the spinach and cook for 1-2 minutes until wilted. Pour the egg mixture over the spinach. Cook for 3-4 minutes until the edges begin to set. Crumble the feta cheese over half of the omelet and scatter the cherry tomatoes over the top. Gently fold the other half of the omelet over the filling. Cook for another 1-2 minutes until the cheese is slightly melted and the omelet is cooked through. Slide onto a plate and serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Oat Pancakes
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats", "2 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 pinch Salt", "2 large Eggs", "250 ml Milk, low fat", "2 medium Bananas, ripe", "30 ml Maple syrup", "15 ml Vegetable oil, for cooking"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, mash the ripe bananas until mostly smooth. Whisk the eggs and milk into the mashed bananas, followed by the maple syrup. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined; a few lumps are okay. Heat a lightly oiled griddle or non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Pour about 60 ml of batter per pancake onto the hot griddle. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Protein Pancakes
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "2 ripe Bananas, mashed", "2 large Eggs, raw", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 scoop (30 g) Whey protein powder, unflavoured", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1/2 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1 tbsp Honey", "10 g Butter, unsalted", "1 tbsp Olive oil"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, whey protein powder, baking powder, and cinnamon. In a separate bowl, mash the ripe bananas until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, milk, and honey until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined; do not overmix. Heat the olive oil and butter in a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat. Once shimmering, pour about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake onto the hot surface. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Adjust heat as needed to prevent burning.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Oat Pancakes
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats, fine", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Baking soda", "0.25 tsp Salt", "2 large Ripe bananas, mashed", "2 dl Milk, unsweetened almond", "2 tbsp Maple syrup", "1 tbsp Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 piece Egg, large", "1 tbsp Olive oil, for cooking"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a separate bowl, mash the ripe bananas until smooth. Add the almond milk, maple syrup, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract to the mashed bananas and stir to combine. Whisk in the egg until well incorporated. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined; do not overmix, some lumps are okay. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat. Once hot, pour about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake onto the skillet. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter, adding more oil as needed.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Pancakes with Greek Yogurt Drizzle
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "2 tsp Baking powder", "1/2 tsp Baking soda", "1/4 tsp Salt", "2 large Eggs, raw", "300 ml Buttermilk", "2 tbsp Maple syrup", "50 g Unsalted butter, melted", "1 large Banana, ripe, mashed", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "1 tbsp Honey", "1 tsp Lemon juice", "10 g Fresh berries, mixed, for garnish"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, buttermilk, maple syrup, and melted butter until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix; a few lumps are okay. Gently fold in the mashed banana. Heat a lightly greased griddle or non-stick pan over medium heat. Once hot, pour about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake onto the griddle. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. While the pancakes cook, whisk together the Greek yogurt, honey, and lemon juice in a small bowl until smooth. Serve the pancakes warm, topped with the Greek yogurt drizzle and fresh berries.

title: Whole Wheat Banana Pancakes with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "2 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "1 tbsp Brown sugar", "1 large Egg", "2.5 dl Milk, low fat", "2 tbsp Vegetable oil", "1 medium Banana, ripe, mashed", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat, for serving", "50 g Berries, mixed, fresh or frozen, for serving"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, baking powder, salt, and brown sugar. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg, then whisk in the milk and vegetable oil until well combined. Add the mashed banana to the wet ingredients and mix. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined; do not overmix, a few lumps are okay. Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium heat. Pour or scoop the batter onto the griddle, using approximately 60 ml (1/4 cup) of batter for each pancake. Cook for about 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Serve immediately topped with a dollop of Greek yogurt and fresh berries.

title: Whole Wheat Berry Popovers with Honey-Yogurt Dip
ingredients_json: ["1.5 dl Whole wheat flour", "1.5 dl All-purpose flour", "0.5 tsp Baking powder", "0.25 tsp Salt", "2 pieces Large egg, raw", "2.5 dl Skim milk", "0.5 dl Water, warm", "2 tbsp Unsalted butter, melted", "1 dl Mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "50 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "1 tbsp Honey"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F). Whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs, then whisk in the skim milk and warm water until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk until just combined, being careful not to overmix; a few lumps are acceptable. Stir in the melted butter. Gently fold in the mixed berries. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin or popover pan generously with butter or cooking spray. Fill each cup about two-thirds full with the batter. Bake for 20 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 190°C (375°F) and bake for another 15-20 minutes, or until the popovers are golden brown and puffed up. While the popovers are baking, combine the Greek yogurt and honey in a small bowl to make the dip. Serve the warm popovers immediately with the honey-yogurt dip.

title: Whole Wheat Savory Popovers with Smoked Salmon and Dill
ingredients_json: ["2 dl Milk, whole, unspecified", "2 large Egg, raw", "1 dl Water, tap, unspecified", "150 g Whole wheat flour, unspecified", "0.5 tsp Salt, table, iodized", "2 tbsp Butter, unsalted, melted", "100 g Smoked salmon, thinly sliced", "2 tbsp Fresh dill, chopped", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220 degrees Celsius (425 degrees Fahrenheit). Lightly grease 6 cups of a standard muffin tin or a popover pan with butter or oil. In a medium bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, and water until well combined. In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, whisking until just combined and smooth. Stir in the melted butter. Pour the batter evenly into the prepared muffin cups, filling each about two-thirds full. Bake for 20 minutes at 220 degrees Celsius, then reduce the oven temperature to 190 degrees Celsius (375 degrees Fahrenheit) and bake for another 15-20 minutes, or until the popovers are puffed, golden brown, and crisp. Do not open the oven door during the first 20 minutes of baking. While the popovers are baking, gently toss the smoked salmon with chopped dill and lemon juice. Once the popovers are done, carefully remove them from the oven and let them cool slightly. Serve immediately, topped with the smoked salmon mixture.

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Feta Popovers with Savory Herbs
ingredients_json: ["2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "2 dl Water", "200 g Flour, whole wheat", "2 piece Egg, raw, large", "10 g Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "50 g Spinach, fresh, raw", "50 g Feta cheese, low fat", "5 g Dried mixed herbs"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220 degrees Celsius. Place a popover pan or muffin tin in the oven to preheat. In a large bowl, whisk together the milk and water. Add the whole wheat flour, eggs, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk until smooth and well combined, ensuring there are no lumps. Finely chop the fresh spinach and crumble the feta cheese. Stir the chopped spinach, crumbled feta, and dried mixed herbs into the batter. Carefully remove the hot popover pan from the oven. Pour the batter evenly into the hot cups, filling each about two-thirds full. Return the pan to the hot oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the popovers are puffed up, golden brown, and firm. Avoid opening the oven door during the first 15-20 minutes of baking, as this can cause them to collapse. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Savory Popovers with Spinach and Feta
ingredients_json: ["2 dl Whole wheat flour", "1 dl All-purpose flour", "0.5 tsp Salt", "4 pieces Egg, raw", "3 dl Milk, low fat (1.5%)", "2 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "75 g Feta cheese, low fat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F) and place your popover or muffin tin in the oven to heat up. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs until well beaten. Gradually whisk in the milk and olive oil until combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk until just combined; a few lumps are okay. Stir in the fresh spinach, roughly chopped, and crumbled feta cheese. Carefully remove the hot tin from the oven and lightly grease each cup with a little oil or butter. Pour the batter evenly into the hot cups, filling each about two-thirds full. Immediately place the tin back into the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes. Then, reduce the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F) and bake for another 10-15 minutes, or until the popovers are golden brown and puffed up. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Popovers with Smoked Salmon and Dill
ingredients_json: ["2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "2 dl Water", "200 g Whole wheat flour", "4 piece Egg, medium", "5 g Salt", "10 g Butter, unsalted", "200 g Smoked salmon", "2 tbsp Dill, fresh, chopped", "100 g Cream cheese, low-fat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 220°C. Place a popover tin or muffin tin in the oven to heat up thoroughly. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, water, and eggs until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk until you have a smooth batter, free of lumps. Melt the 10g of butter and stir it into the batter. Carefully remove the hot tin from the oven. Pour the batter evenly into the cups, filling each about two-thirds full. Return the tin to the oven and bake for 20 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 190°C and bake for another 10-15 minutes, or until the popovers are golden brown and puffed up. While the popovers are baking, mix the cream cheese with the chopped fresh dill. Once the popovers are out of the oven and slightly cooled, gently slice them open horizontally. Spread a layer of the dill cream cheese inside each popover and top with a generous portion of smoked salmon.

title: Hearty Sweet Potato and Kale Pancakes with Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["400 g Sweet potato, raw", "100 g Kale, raw", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "75 g Whole wheat flour", "1 dl Milk, low fat, unspecified", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Salt, table", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp Olive oil"]
instructions: Peel the sweet potato and grate it using a large-hole grater. Finely chop the kale. In a large bowl, combine the grated sweet potato, chopped kale, eggs, whole wheat flour, milk, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Mix well until everything is evenly incorporated. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Once the oil is shimmering, carefully spoon about 1/4 cup of the batter per pancake into the pan. Cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. Add the remaining olive oil to the pan as needed for subsequent batches. Serve hot.

title: Savory Sweet Potato Pancakes with Smoked Salmon and Dill
ingredients_json: ["300 g Sweet potato, raw", "100 g Onion, raw", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Fresh dill, chopped", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "100 g Smoked salmon", "50 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat"]
instructions: Peel and finely grate the sweet potato and onion. Squeeze out excess moisture from the grated sweet potato. In a medium bowl, whisk together the egg, whole wheat flour, baking powder, salt, pepper, and chopped dill. Add the grated sweet potato and onion to the bowl and mix until well combined. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Spoon about 2 tablespoons of the batter for each pancake into the hot skillet, flattening them slightly with the back of the spoon. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter, adding more olive oil as needed. Serve the pancakes warm, topped with smoked salmon and a dollop of Greek yogurt.

title: Healthy Sweet Potato and Oat Pancakes with Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["200 g Sweet potato, raw", "50 g Oat flakes, rolled", "2 piece Egg, raw", "1 dl Milk, low fat, 1.5% fat", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "1 tbsp Honey", "1 tbsp Rapeseed oil"]
instructions: Peel and dice the sweet potato, then boil until tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain well and mash until smooth. In a bowl, combine the mashed sweet potato with oat flakes, eggs, milk, baking powder, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Stir until just combined; do not overmix. Heat the rapeseed oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Pour ladlefuls of batter into the pan to form pancakes, about 8-10 cm in diameter. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Drizzle with honey before serving.

title: Hearty Potato and Zucchini Pancakes with Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potatoes, raw, starchy", "200 g Zucchini, raw", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Onion, raw", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "50 ml Vegetable oil, for frying"]
instructions: Grate the potatoes and zucchini using the large holes of a box grater. Squeeze out as much excess liquid as possible from both. Finely dice the onion. In a large bowl, combine the grated potato, zucchini, diced onion, egg, whole wheat flour, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Mix well until just combined; do not overmix. Heat the vegetable oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Once the oil is shimmering, carefully spoon portions of the batter into the skillet, flattening them slightly with the back of the spoon to form pancakes about 1 cm thick. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. You may need to do this in batches. Drain the cooked pancakes on a plate lined with paper towels.

title: Savory Sweet Potato and Kale Pancakes with Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["300 g Sweet potato, raw", "100 g Kale, raw", "100 g Onion, raw", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "50 ml Milk, whole, unspecified", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1/2 tsp Salt", "1/4 tsp Black pepper, ground", "100 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat"]
instructions: Grate the sweet potato and finely chop the kale and onion. In a medium bowl, combine the grated sweet potato, chopped kale, chopped onion, whole wheat flour, half of the milk, salt, and pepper. Mix well until just combined. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the batter for each pancake into the skillet, flattening them slightly with the back of the spoon. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter, adding more oil if needed. While the pancakes are cooking, poach the eggs. Bring a small saucepan of water to a gentle simmer. Crack each egg into a separate ramekin and carefully slide them into the simmering water. Poach for 3-4 minutes for a runny yolk. Serve the sweet potato and kale pancakes warm, topped with a poached egg and a dollop of Greek yogurt.

title: Wholesome Spiced Pumpkin Bread with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["250 g Pumpkin puree, canned", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g All-purpose flour", "150 g Brown sugar, light", "2 piece Egg, raw, large", "120 ml Vegetable oil, unspecified", "60 ml Milk, low-fat, unspecified", "1 tsp Baking soda", "1/2 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Ground cinnamon", "1/2 tsp Ground nutmeg", "1/4 tsp Ground cloves", "1/2 tsp Salt", "100 g Walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit) and grease and flour a standard loaf pan. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, brown sugar, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, and salt. In a separate medium bowl, whisk together the pumpkin puree, eggs, vegetable oil, and milk until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Fold in the chopped walnuts. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and spread evenly. Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Whole Wheat Pumpkin Spice Bread with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g All-purpose flour", "1.5 tsp Baking soda", "0.5 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp Ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp Ground ginger", "0.25 tsp Ground cloves", "0.5 tsp Salt", "400 g Pumpkin puree, unsweetened", "150 g Maple syrup", "100 g Unsweetened applesauce", "60 ml Coconut oil, melted", "2 large Eggs, raw", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "100 g Walnuts, chopped"]

title: Whole Wheat Pumpkin Spice Bread
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat flour", "1.5 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Baking soda", "1 tsp Ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp Ground nutmeg", "0.5 tsp Ground ginger", "0.25 tsp Ground cloves", "0.5 tsp Salt", "250 g Pumpkin puree, unsweetened", "150 g Maple syrup", "100 g Unsweetened applesauce", "2 piece Egg, raw", "80 ml Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "100 g Walnuts, chopped (optional)"]

ingredients_json: ["500 g Beef, lean, stewing", "200 g Beetroot, raw", "150 g Carrot", "100 g Onion", "100 g Potato", "50 g Cabbage, white", "2 cloves Garlic", "1.5 l Beef broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp Apple cider vinegar", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dill, dried", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 g Bay leaf", "200 ml Sour cream, 10% fat"]

title: Hearty Beetroot and Beef Borscht
ingredients_json: ["500 g Beef, lean, stewing cuts", "250 g Beetroot, raw", "200 g Carrot, raw", "150 g Onion, raw", "100 g Cabbage, white", "50 g Potato, raw", "2 l Beef broth, low sodium", "30 ml Olive oil", "10 g Garlic, raw", "10 g Parsley, fresh", "5 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Salt, fine sea salt"]

title: Mediterranean Chickpea and Feta Bruschetta

title: Mediterranean Chickpea and Roasted Red Pepper Bruschetta

title: Mediterranean Chickpea and Feta Bruschetta

title: Healthy Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Greek Yogurt Ranch Dip
ingredients_json: ["1 kg Chicken wings, whole", "2 g Baking soda", "1 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "2 dl Hot sauce, cayenne pepper based", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "2 tbsp Apple cider vinegar", "1 tbsp Honey", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "2 tbsp Fresh dill, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh chives, chopped", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Lemon juice", "0.5 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]

title: Baked Honey Buffalo Chicken Wings with Celery Sticks

title: Healthy Lean Beef Bulgogi with Brown Rice and Steamed Greens

title: Creamy Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Sage and Toasted Pepitas

title: Hearty Turkey and Quinoa Stuffed Cabbage Rolls with Tomato Sauce

title: Hearty Turkey and Quinoa Stuffed Cabbage Rolls in Tomato Sauce

title: Whole Wheat Chicken and Vegetable Calzones
ingredients_json: ["400 g Whole wheat flour", "10 g Yeast, dry, instant", "5 g Salt", "250 ml Water, lukewarm", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "100 g Onion, raw", "100 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "100 g Zucchini, raw", "50 g Tomato passata", "1 tsp Oregano, dried", "0.5 tsp Basil, dried", "100 g Mozzarella cheese, part-skim, shredded", "1 Egg, raw"]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, dry yeast, and salt. Gradually add the lukewarm water and olive oil while mixing until a shaggy dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm place for 1-1.5 hours, or until doubled in size. While the dough rises, dice the chicken breast into small pieces. Spoon a quarter of the chicken and vegetable filling onto one half of each dough circle, leaving a border. Sprinkle half of the shredded mozzarella over the filling. Place the calzones on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. In a small bowl, whisk the egg. Brush the tops of the calzones with the beaten egg. Cut a few small slits in the top of each calzone to allow steam to escape. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Let cool for a few minutes before serving.

title: Peruvian Style Sea Bass Ceviche with Sweet Potato
ingredients_json: ["500 g Sea bass fillet, skinless and boneless", "3 dl Fresh lime juice", "1 dl Fresh orange juice", "1 dl Red onion, thinly sliced", "2 tbsp Fresh cilantro, chopped", "1 tsp Fresh ginger, grated", "1/2 tsp Red chili, finely chopped (e.g., aji amarillo)", "1 tsp Salt", "1/2 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 medium Sweet potato, boiled and cubed", "1/2 cup Corn kernels, cooked"]

title: Healthy Chicken Adobo with Brown Rice and Steamed Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["500 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "2 dl Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 dl White vinegar", "0.5 dl Water", "5 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Ginger, grated", "1 tsp Black peppercorns, whole", "2 Bay leaves", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Brown rice, uncooked", "4 dl Water, for rice", "300 g Broccoli florets, fresh"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice thoroughly under cold water. Combine the rinsed brown rice with 4 dl of water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. In a bowl, whisk together 2 dl of low-sodium soy sauce, 1 dl of white vinegar, 0.5 dl of water, minced garlic, grated ginger, whole black peppercorns, and bay leaves. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Add the chicken pieces and sear for 2-3 minutes per side until lightly browned. Pour the adobo sauce mixture over the chicken. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and tender. In the last 5 minutes of cooking, remove the lid to allow the sauce to thicken slightly. While the chicken simmers, steam the broccoli florets until tender-crisp, about 5-7 minutes. Serve the Chicken Adobo over the cooked brown rice, with steamed broccoli on the side. Spoon extra adobo sauce over the chicken and rice.

title: Hearty Whole Wheat Chicken and Vegetable Dumplings

title: Rustic Whole Wheat Pasta with Chicken Cacciatore

title: Healthier Chicken Cordon Bleu with a Light Cream Sauce

title: Healthier Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Dijon Cream Sauce

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Dijon Sauce

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Whole Wheat Crumbs
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless, boneless", "100 g Ham, lean, low sodium", "100 g Cheese, Swiss-type, reduced fat", "50 g Breadcrumbs, whole wheat", "10 g Parsley, fresh, chopped", "5 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Garlic powder", "20 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "50 g Flour, whole wheat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 ml Milk, low fat"]

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Light Bechamel
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "4 slices Ham, lean, cooked", "80 g Cheese, Swiss, low-fat, grated", "50 g Flour, whole wheat", "2 dl Milk, skimmed", "1 tbsp Butter, unsalted", "1 dl Breadcrumbs, whole grain", "1 unit Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]

title: Healthy Chicken Marsala with Whole Wheat Pasta

In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil and sauté the chopped onion until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and red pepper flakes and cook for another minute until fragrant. Pour in the tomato passata and stir in the dried basil. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly. Season with salt and pepper to taste if needed (Parmesan is salty). Return the seared chicken cutlets to the skillet, nestling them into the sauce. Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is bubbling. While the chicken bakes, spiralize the zucchini into noodles. In a separate pan, lightly sauté the zucchini noodles with a tiny bit of olive oil for 2-3 minutes until slightly tender but still crisp. Top the chicken in the skillet with the shredded mozzarella cheese and return to the oven for the last 5 minutes of baking, until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve the baked chicken parmesan immediately over the sautéed zucchini noodles, garnished with fresh chopped basil.

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Parmesan with Whole Wheat Spaghetti

title: Lemon Caper Chicken Piccata with Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "50 g All-purpose flour", "5 ml Salt", "2 ml Black pepper, ground", "45 ml Olive oil", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "120 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "60 ml Dry white wine", "30 ml Fresh lemon juice", "15 g Capers, drained", "15 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "250 g Asparagus, trimmed"]

title: Healthy Lemon Caper Chicken Piccata with Whole Wheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "80 g Whole wheat pasta, dry", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 dl Low-sodium chicken broth", "1 dl Dry white wine", "2 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "2 tbsp Capers, drained", "1 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt", "1 tbsp All-purpose flour"]

title: Lemon Caper Chicken Piccata with Zucchini Noodles
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast fillet, boneless, skinless", "50 g All-purpose flour", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "3 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 dl Dry white wine", "1 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Capers, drained", "3 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tbsp Lemon zest", "2 sprigs Parsley, fresh, chopped", "2 medium Zucchini", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Salt"]

title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken Salad with Mixed Greens and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless and boneless", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Lemon, zest and juice", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "150 g Mixed salad greens", "1 piece Cucumber, medium, sliced", "1 piece Bell pepper, red, medium, sliced", "1 piece Avocado, ripe, sliced", "50 g Cherry tomatoes, halved", "30 g Red onion, thinly sliced", "50 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "2 tbsp Balsamic vinegar", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard"]

title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken Salad with Mixed Greens

title: Grilled Chicken and Avocado Salad with Lime Vinaigrette

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Teriyaki with Brown Rice and Steamed Broccoli

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Teriyaki with Brown Rice and Steamed Broccoli

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Teriyaki with Broccoli and Brown Rice

title: Healthy Baked Chicken Teriyaki with Broccoli and Brown Rice

Serve immediately.

title: Healthy Baked Crab Cakes with Lemon-Dill Aioli
ingredients_json: ["300 g Crab meat, cooked, lump", "60 g Panko breadcrumbs", "30 g Mayonnaise, light", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tsp Fresh dill, chopped", "1/2 tsp Lemon zest", "1/4 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1/4 tsp Salt", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 dl Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "1 tbsp Fresh lemon juice", "1 clove Garlic, minced"]

title: Steamed Chicken and Vegetable Dumplings with Ginger-Soy Dipping Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g Chicken breast, finely minced", "100 g Cabbage, napa, finely chopped", "50 g Carrot, grated", "30 g Spring onion, finely chopped", "15 g Ginger, fresh, grated", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "1/2 tsp Salt", "1/4 tsp Black pepper", "24 units Dumpling wrappers, round", "50 ml Water, for sealing", "For the dipping sauce:", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "1/2 tsp Sugar", "1/4 tsp Ginger, fresh, grated"]

Steam the dumplings over medium-high heat for about 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the wrappers are translucent. title: Whole Wheat Shrimp and Vegetable Dumplings with Ginger-Soy Dipping Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 ml Water, warm", "1 tsp Salt", "300 g Shrimp, peeled and deveined", "100 g Cabbage, finely chopped", "50 g Carrot, grated", "30 g Green onion, thinly sliced", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Ginger, grated", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "1 tbsp Olive oil"]
instructions: To make the dumpling wrappers, combine the whole wheat flour and salt in a bowl. Gradually add the warm water while mixing until a shaggy dough forms. Knead on a lightly floured surface for about 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover with a damp cloth and let rest for 30 minutes. While the dough rests, prepare the filling. Finely chop the shrimp into small pieces. In a bowl, combine the chopped shrimp, finely chopped cabbage, grated carrot, sliced green onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger. Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and 1 teaspoon of sesame oil to the shrimp mixture and mix well to combine. To assemble the dumplings, divide the dough into 16-20 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a thin, round wrapper (about 8-10 cm in diameter). Place about 1-2 teaspoons of filling in the center of each wrapper. Moisten the edges of the wrapper with water, then fold and pleat to seal, creating your desired dumpling shape. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Arrange the dumplings in a single layer, flat side down, and cook for 2-3 minutes until the bottoms are golden brown. Carefully pour about 1 dl of water into the skillet (it will steam), immediately cover with a lid, and reduce heat to medium-low. Steam for 8-10 minutes, or until the wrappers are translucent and the filling is cooked through. Remove the lid and let any remaining water evaporate. Serve immediately with your favorite dipping sauce.

title: Healthy Turkey and Vegetable Steamed Dumplings with Ginger Soy Dipping Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g Ground turkey, lean", "100 g Cabbage, savoy, finely chopped", "50 g Carrot, grated", "50 g Spring onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "15 g Fresh ginger, grated", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "1/2 tsp Black pepper", "24 units Dumpling wrappers, whole wheat", "1 tbsp Olive oil, for pan-searing (optional)", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium, for dipping sauce", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar, for dipping sauce", "1 tsp Honey, for dipping sauce", "1/2 tsp Fresh ginger, grated, for dipping sauce", "1/4 tsp Red pepper flakes (optional)"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the ground turkey, finely chopped cabbage, grated carrot, chopped spring onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger. Place the dumplings in a single layer and cook for 2-3 minutes until the bottoms are golden brown. title: Healthy Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Whole Wheat Dumplings in Vegetable Broth
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g All-purpose flour", "150 ml Water, lukewarm", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "0.5 tsp Salt", "250 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "150 g Spinach, fresh, wilted and squeezed dry", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "0.25 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "1 liter Vegetable broth, low sodium", "1 Carrot, diced", "1 Celery stalk, diced", "1 Onion, finely chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: To make the dumpling dough, combine the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, and salt in a large bowl. Make a well in the center and pour in the lukewarm water and olive oil. Mix until a shaggy dough forms, then turn it out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for about 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes. While the dough rests, prepare the filling. Pour in the low-sodium vegetable broth and bring to a simmer. Roll out the rested dumpling dough thinly on a lightly floured surface. Cut out circles using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass. Place a spoonful of the ricotta-spinach filling in the center of each dough circle. Moisten the edges of the dough with a little water and fold it over to create a half-moon shape, pressing the edges firmly to seal. Alternatively, you can pleat the edges. Carefully drop the dumplings into the simmering vegetable broth. Cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the dumplings float to the surface and are cooked through. Ladle the dumplings and broth into bowls, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve hot.

title: Healthy Chicken and Vegetable Wontons with Ginger-Soy Dipping Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "100 g Cabbage, savoy, finely chopped", "50 g Carrot, grated", "50 g Spring onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Ginger, fresh, grated", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "24 pieces Wonton wrappers", "50 ml Water, for sealing wrappers", "1 tbsp Olive oil, for pan-frying", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium, for dipping sauce", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar, for dipping sauce", "1 tsp Honey, for dipping sauce", "1 tsp Sesame oil, for dipping sauce"]
instructions: Finely mince the chicken breast and place it in a medium bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Carefully place the wontons in the skillet in a single layer, ensuring not to overcrowd the pan. title: Spicy Chicken and Vegetable Egg Rolls with Dipping Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Chicken breast, skinless", "150 g Cabbage, savoy", "100 g Carrot", "50 g Spring onion", "30 g Garlic", "20 g Ginger, fresh", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "0.5 tsp Chilli flakes", "12 sheets Spring roll pastry", "50 ml Vegetable oil, for brushing", "2 tbsp Cornstarch", "1 dl Water", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tsp Honey"]
instructions: Finely chop the chicken breast and set aside. Shred the cabbage and julienne the carrot. Mince the garlic and ginger. Chop the spring onions. Prepare the dipping sauce by whisking together the cornstarch and water in a small bowl until smooth. In a small saucepan, combine the cornstarch mixture, rice vinegar, and honey.
