Place about 2 tablespoons of the chicken and vegetable filling near the bottom corner. Fold the bottom corner over the filling, then fold in the two side corners. Lightly brush the egg rolls with vegetable oil and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy, turning them halfway through. title: Spicy Chicken and Vegetable Egg Rolls with Peanut Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "100 g Cabbage, white, raw", "50 g Carrot, raw", "50 g Onion, yellow, raw", "20 g Spring onion, raw", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "1 piece Ginger, fresh, raw", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "0.5 tsp Chilli flakes", "12 sheets Spring roll pastry", "50 ml Water", "30 ml Vegetable oil, for frying", "50 g Peanuts, unsalted, roasted", "2 tbsp Hoisin sauce", "1 tbsp Lime juice, fresh", "1 tsp Honey"]
instructions: Dice the chicken breast into small pieces. Thinly slice the cabbage, julienne the carrot, and finely chop the onion and spring onion. Mince the garlic and grate the ginger. title: Spicy Shrimp and Vegetable Egg Rolls with Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "100 g Cabbage, shredded", "100 g Carrot, shredded", "50 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "50 g Red bell pepper, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "15 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "10 ml Rice vinegar", "5 ml Sesame oil", "5 ml Sriracha sauce", "2 g Ginger, fresh, grated", "12 sheets Spring roll wrappers", "50 ml Vegetable oil, for frying", "50 g Peanut butter, unsweetened", "15 ml Lime juice", "10 ml Honey", "5 ml Water"]

title: Spicy Chicken and Vegetable Egg Rolls
ingredients_json: ["150 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "1 dl Cabbage, white, shredded", "1 dl Carrot, shredded", "50 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Ginger, fresh, grated", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Sriracha sauce", "0.5 tsp Sesame oil", "8 sheets Spring roll pastry", "2 tbsp Vegetable oil, for frying"]

title: Spicy Shrimp and Vegetable Egg Rolls with Peanut Dipping Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g Shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "100 g Cabbage, white, shredded", "50 g Carrot, shredded", "50 g Red bell pepper, julienned", "25 g Onion, yellow, finely chopped", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Ginger, fresh, grated", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Rice vinegar", "1/2 tsp Sriracha sauce", "10 spring roll wrappers", "2 tbsp Cornstarch", "50 ml Water", "100 ml Peanut oil, for frying", "50 g Peanut butter, smooth", "1 tbsp Lime juice, fresh", "1 tsp Honey", "1 tbsp Water, for sauce"]

Fold the bottom corner up over the filling, then fold in the left and right sides. Roll tightly towards the top corner. Moisten the top corner with a little water to seal the roll. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling. In a small bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons of cornstarch and 50 ml of water to create a slurry. Heat 100 ml of peanut oil in a wok or deep pan over medium-high heat until shimmering. Carefully add the egg rolls, a few at a time, ensuring not to overcrowd the pan. title: Healthy Baked Eggplant Parmesan with Whole Wheat Breadcrumbs
ingredients_json: ["1000 g Eggplant, raw", "200 g Tomato puree, canned, unsweetened", "100 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "100 g Whole wheat breadcrumbs", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "50 g Mozzarella cheese, part-skim, shredded", "2 tbsp Fresh basil, chopped", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/gas mark 6). Slice the eggplants into 1 cm thick rounds. In a large bowl, toss the eggplant slices with 1 tbsp of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Arrange the eggplant slices in a single layer on baking sheets and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until tender and lightly golden. While the eggplant bakes, prepare the sauce. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the tomato puree, dried oregano, and half of the fresh basil. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes. In a small bowl, combine the whole wheat breadcrumbs and grated Parmesan cheese. Assemble the dish by spreading a thin layer of tomato sauce in the bottom of a baking dish. Layer half of the baked eggplant slices over the sauce. Spoon half of the remaining sauce over the eggplant, then sprinkle with half of the shredded mozzarella. Repeat the layers with the remaining eggplant, sauce, and mozzarella. Top with the breadcrumb and Parmesan mixture. Bake for another 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the topping is golden brown. Garnish with the remaining fresh basil before serving.

title: Healthy Baked Eggplant Parmesan with Whole Wheat
ingredients_json: ["1000 g Eggplant", "200 g Whole wheat breadcrumbs", "100 g Grated Parmesan cheese", "50 g Grated Pecorino cheese", "30 g Fresh basil, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "10 g Dried oregano", "5 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Salt", "200 ml Egg whites", "800 g Crushed tomatoes", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Mozzarella cheese, part-skim, shredded"]

Dip each eggplant slice first into the egg whites, ensuring it's fully coated, then press it into the breadcrumb mixture, coating both sides evenly. Arrange the coated eggplant slices in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and tender, flipping halfway through. While the eggplant bakes, heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the fresh basil. To assemble, spread a thin layer of tomato sauce on the bottom of a baking dish. Arrange a layer of the baked eggplant slices over the sauce. Top with more tomato sauce and a sprinkle of shredded mozzarella. Repeat the layers until all eggplant is used, finishing with sauce and mozzarella on top. Reduce oven temperature to 190°C (375°F). Bake for another 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the sauce is heated through. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Healthy Baked Eggplant Parmesan with Whole Wheat Breadcrumbs
ingredients_json: ["2 medium eggplants (approx. 600g total)", "3 dl crushed tomatoes, unsweetened", "1 dl water", "1 dl onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 dl whole wheat breadcrumbs", "0.5 dl grated Parmesan cheese", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp dried basil", "0.25 tsp black pepper", "150 g part-skim mozzarella cheese, thinly sliced", "50 g fresh basil leaves, for garnish"]

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and water. Stir in the oregano, basil, and black pepper. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and let it cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. In a small bowl, combine the whole wheat breadcrumbs, grated Parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Once the eggplant slices are partially baked, remove them from the oven. In a 20x30 cm baking dish, spread a thin layer of the tomato sauce on the bottom. Arrange a layer of the baked eggplant slices over the sauce. Top with another layer of sauce, followed by a layer of mozzarella slices. Repeat the layers: eggplant, sauce, mozzarella, ending with a layer of sauce. Sprinkle the breadcrumb and Parmesan mixture evenly over the top. Bake for another 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly, and the breadcrumb topping is golden brown. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh basil leaves.

title: Healthy Baked Eggplant Parmesan with Whole Wheat Breadcrumbs
ingredients_json: ["2 medium Eggplant, unpeeled", "200 g Whole wheat breadcrumbs", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried basil", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "150 g Flour, whole wheat", "2 large Egg, raw", "2 tbsp Milk, skimmed", "400 g Crushed tomatoes, unsalted", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Mozzarella cheese, part-skim, shredded", "50 g Fresh basil leaves, chopped", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]

In a shallow dish, mix together the whole wheat breadcrumbs, grated Parmesan cheese, dried oregano, dried basil, and garlic powder. In another shallow dish, whisk together the whole wheat flour. In a third shallow dish, beat the eggs with the skimmed milk. Dip each eggplant slice first into the flour, shaking off any excess, then into the egg mixture, and finally coat thoroughly with the breadcrumb mixture. Arrange the breaded eggplant slices in a single layer on baking sheets lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and tender. While the eggplant bakes, prepare the sauce: mince the garlic cloves and sauté them in olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes. In a baking dish, layer half of the baked eggplant slices. Spoon half of the tomato sauce over the eggplant, followed by half of the shredded mozzarella and chopped fresh basil. Repeat the layers. Bake for another 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Healthy Baked Eggplant Parmesan with Whole Wheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["2 medium Eggplant, unpeeled", "300 g Whole wheat spaghetti", "800 g Chopped tomatoes, canned", "150 g Onion, yellow, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Ricotta cheese, skimmed", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "100 g Mozzarella cheese, part-skim", "20 g Fresh basil leaves", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Slice the eggplants into 1 cm thick rounds. Arrange the eggplant slices on baking sheets, brush lightly with olive oil, and bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until tender and lightly golden. While the eggplant bakes, finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Pour in the chopped tomatoes, add the dried oregano, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened slightly. Cook the whole wheat spaghetti according to package directions until al dente. Drain the pasta and return it to the pot. Stir in half of the tomato sauce and half of the fresh basil, chopped. In a small bowl, mix the ricotta cheese with half of the Parmesan cheese. In a large baking dish, spread a thin layer of the remaining tomato sauce. Arrange half of the baked eggplant slices over the sauce. Dollop spoonfuls of the ricotta mixture over the eggplant. Top with the remaining eggplant slices. Pour the rest of the tomato sauce over the eggplant. Sprinkle with the mozzarella cheese and the remaining Parmesan cheese. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the sauce is heated through. Garnish with the remaining fresh basil before serving over the prepared whole wheat pasta.

title: Whole Wheat Chicken and Vegetable Empanadas
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "5 g Salt", "100 g Butter, unsalted, cold", "125 ml Cold water", "300 g Chicken breast, cooked, shredded", "100 g Onion, yellow, finely chopped", "50 g Red bell pepper, finely chopped", "50 g Carrot, finely grated", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Paprika, sweet", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Egg, raw (for egg wash)"]
instructions: To prepare the dough, combine the whole wheat flour and salt in a large bowl. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry blender or your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Gradually add the cold water, mixing until a dough forms. Knead lightly on a floured surface for about 1 minute, then wrap in plastic and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. While the dough chills, prepare the filling. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, red bell pepper, and grated carrot, and sauté until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Cut out circles using a 15cm diameter cutter. Place a portion of the chicken filling onto one half of each dough circle, leaving a small border. Moisten the edges of the dough with water and fold the other half over to create a half-moon shape. Crimp the edges with a fork to seal. Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Whisk the egg with 1 tablespoon of water and brush the tops of the empanadas with the egg wash.
