Stir in the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute until fragrant. Squeeze the lime juice over the mixture. Warm the whole wheat tortillas according to package directions. Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture immediately with the warmed tortillas, topped with sliced avocado, fresh coriander, and a dollop of Greek yogurt.

title: Hearty Chickpea Falafel with Tahini Yogurt Sauce and Quinoa Salad
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chickpeas, canned, drained and rinsed", "1 dl Fresh parsley, chopped", "1 dl Fresh coriander, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Ground coriander", "0.5 tsp Cayenne pepper", "1 dl Onion, finely chopped", "2 tbsp Chickpea flour", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1 dl Olive oil, for frying", "2 dl Quinoa, uncooked", "4 dl Water", "1 dl Cucumber, diced", "1 dl Cherry tomatoes, halved", "0.5 dl Red onion, thinly sliced", "0.5 dl Lemon juice", "3 tbsp Olive oil, for salad dressing", "1 dl Greek yogurt, plain", "2 tbsp Tahini", "1 tbsp Lemon juice", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "2 tbsp Water, or as needed"]
instructions: For the falafel, combine the drained chickpeas, chopped parsley, chopped coriander, minced garlic, ground cumin, ground coriander, cayenne pepper, finely chopped onion, chickpea flour, and baking powder in a food processor. Pulse until the mixture is well combined but still has some texture, do not over-process into a paste. Shape the mixture into small balls or patties, about 2-3 cm in diameter. Heat 1 dl of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Carefully add the falafel in batches, being careful not to overcrowd the pan. Fry for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and crispy. Remove from the skillet and drain on paper towels. While the falafel are frying, cook the quinoa. Rinse the quinoa under cold water. Combine the uncooked quinoa and 4 dl of water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork. In a bowl, combine the cooked quinoa with diced cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, and thinly sliced red onion. In a small bowl, whisk together 0.5 dl lemon juice, 3 tbsp olive oil, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Pour the dressing over the quinoa salad and toss to combine. For the tahini yogurt sauce, whisk together the Greek yogurt, tahini, 1 tbsp lemon juice, minced garlic, and 2 tbsp water (or more, to reach desired consistency) until smooth. Serve the hot falafel alongside the quinoa salad, drizzled with the tahini yogurt sauce.

title: Hearty Chickpea and Vegetable Falafel with Tahini Sauce
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chickpeas, canned, drained and rinsed", "1 dl Fresh parsley, chopped", "0.5 dl Fresh coriander, chopped", "1 medium Onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Ground coriander", "0.5 tsp Cayenne pepper", "1 dl Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Baking powder", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 dl Tahini", "0.5 dl Lemon juice, fresh", "1 dl Water", "1 medium Tomato, diced", "1 dl Cucumber, diced", "1 dl Mixed greens, shredded"]
instructions: In a food processor, combine the drained chickpeas, chopped parsley, chopped coriander, chopped onion, garlic, ground cumin, ground coriander, and cayenne pepper. Pulse until the mixture is finely chopped but not completely puréed. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the whole wheat flour and baking powder until well combined. Form the mixture into small patties, about 5 cm in diameter. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Carefully place the falafel patties into the hot oil, ensuring not to overcrowd the pan. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and heated through. While the falafel are cooking, prepare the tahini sauce. In a small bowl, whisk together the tahini, lemon juice, and water until smooth and creamy. Season with a pinch of salt if desired. Serve the hot falafel immediately, topped with a drizzle of tahini sauce and accompanied by diced tomato, cucumber, and shredded mixed greens.

title: Healthy Baked Chickpea Falafel with Tahini Yogurt Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g Chickpeas, canned, drained and rinsed", "100 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "50 g Fresh parsley, leaves and tender stems", "30 g Fresh cilantro, leaves and tender stems", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "10 g All-purpose flour", "5 g Baking powder", "5 g Ground cumin", "2 g Ground coriander", "1 g Cayenne pepper", "1 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "60 ml Olive oil, for brushing", "150 g Greek yogurt, low-fat", "30 g Tahini", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "10 ml Water, to thin sauce", "1 g Salt, for sauce"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a food processor, combine the drained chickpeas, chopped onion, fresh parsley, fresh cilantro, minced garlic, flour, baking powder, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Pulse until the mixture is finely chopped but not completely puréed, resembling a coarse meal. Form the mixture into small balls or patties, about 2.5 cm in diameter. Arrange the falafel on the prepared baking sheet. Lightly brush the tops with olive oil. Bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and slightly crisp on the outside. While the falafel are baking, prepare the tahini yogurt sauce by whisking together the Greek yogurt, tahini, fresh lemon juice, water, and salt in a small bowl until smooth and creamy. Serve the baked falafel warm with the tahini yogurt sauce.

title: Homemade Whole Wheat Falafel with Tahini Yogurt Sauce
ingredients_json: ["400 g dried chickpeas, soaked overnight", "1 dl fresh parsley, chopped", "1 dl fresh coriander, chopped", "1 medium onion, chopped", "4 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "0.5 tsp cayenne pepper", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "1 dl whole wheat flour", "1 dl water", "1 dl olive oil, for frying", "2 dl plain yogurt, low-fat", "2 tbsp tahini", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 clove garlic, minced"]
instructions: Drain and rinse the soaked chickpeas thoroughly. In a food processor, combine the chickpeas, parsley, coriander, onion, minced garlic, cumin, ground coriander, and cayenne pepper. Pulse until the mixture is finely ground but not a paste. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the baking soda and whole wheat flour until just combined. Add 1 dl of water and mix to form a dough-like consistency. Shape the mixture into small balls or patties (about 3-4 cm in diameter). Heat 1 dl of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Carefully add the falafel in batches, ensuring not to overcrowd the pan. Fry for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Remove the falafel from the skillet and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil. While the falafel are frying, prepare the sauce. In a small bowl, whisk together the yogurt, tahini, lemon juice, and minced garlic until smooth. Serve the hot falafel immediately with the tahini yogurt sauce.

title: Healthy Baked Chickpea Falafel with Tahini Yogurt Dip
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chickpeas, canned, drained and rinsed", "100 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "3 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "50 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "50 g Fresh cilantro, chopped", "2 tbsp Chickpea flour", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "1 tsp Coriander, ground", "0.5 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt, table", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp Olive oil, for brushing", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "2 tbsp Tahini", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 clove Garlic, raw, minced", "2 tbsp Water, for thinning dip", "5 g Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/gas mark 6). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a food processor, combine the drained chickpeas, chopped onion, minced garlic, fresh parsley, fresh cilantro, chickpea flour, ground cumin, ground coriander, baking powder, salt, and pepper. Pulse until the mixture is finely ground but still has a little texture; do not over-process into a paste. Shape the mixture into small balls or patties, about 2.5-3 cm in diameter. Place them on the prepared baking sheet. Brush the tops of the falafel lightly with olive oil. Bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and firm. While the falafel are baking, prepare the tahini yogurt dip. In a small bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, tahini, lemon juice, and minced garlic. Add water, one tablespoon at a time, until the dip reaches your desired consistency. Season with a pinch of salt if needed. Once the falafel are done, remove them from the oven. Serve the hot falafel with the tahini yogurt dip, garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Whole Wheat Fettuccini with Lemon-Garlic Shrimp and Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["250 g Fettuccine, whole wheat", "300 g Shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "200 g Asparagus, trimmed and cut into 3cm pieces", "4 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 dl Lemon juice, fresh", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "30 g Parsley, fresh, chopped", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 pinch Salt"]
instructions: Cook the whole wheat fettuccine according to package directions until al dente. While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and opaque. Add the asparagus pieces and chicken broth to the skillet and cook for another 3-4 minutes, until the asparagus is tender-crisp. Stir in the fresh lemon juice. Drain the cooked fettuccine and add it directly to the skillet with the shrimp and asparagus. Toss to combine. Stir in most of the grated Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley, reserving some for garnish. Season with black pepper and a pinch of salt if needed. Serve immediately, garnished with the remaining Parmesan cheese and parsley.

title: Whole Wheat Fettuccini with Chicken, Broccoli, and Lemon-Garlic Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Fettuccine, whole wheat", "200 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "250 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "3 cloves Garlic, minced", "50 ml Olive oil", "50 ml Vegetable broth", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1/2 Lemon, juiced", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Salt"]
instructions: Cook the whole wheat fettuccine according to package directions until al dente. While the pasta is cooking, dice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Cut the broccoli into small florets. In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. Add the remaining 3 tablespoons of olive oil to the same skillet. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the broccoli florets and vegetable broth to the skillet. Cover and steam for 3-5 minutes until the broccoli is tender-crisp. Return the cooked chicken to the skillet. Drain the cooked fettuccine, reserving about 1/2 cup of the pasta water. Add the drained fettuccine to the skillet with the chicken and broccoli. Pour in the lemon juice and toss everything to combine. If the sauce seems too dry, add a little of the reserved pasta water, a tablespoon at a time, until the desired consistency is reached. Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese and black pepper. Season with salt to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Fettuccine with Spinach, Ricotta, and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["250 g Fettuccine, whole wheat", "300 g Spinach, fresh", "200 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 Lemon, zest and juice", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 dl Pasta water, reserved", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cook the whole wheat fettuccine in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package directions until al dente. While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute, being careful not to burn it. Add the fresh spinach in batches, stirring until it wilts down, about 3-5 minutes. Once the spinach is wilted, reduce the heat to low. Drain the fettuccine, reserving about 1 dl of the pasta water. Add the drained fettuccine to the skillet with the spinach. Add the ricotta cheese, grated Parmesan cheese, lemon zest, and lemon juice to the skillet. Toss everything together gently. Add the reserved pasta water a tablespoon at a time, if needed, to create a creamy sauce that coats the pasta. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Fettuccine with Spinach, Mushroom, and Garlic Cream Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g Fettuccine, whole wheat", "20 ml Olive oil", "250 g Mushrooms, button, sliced", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "150 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "50 ml Cream, light, 18% fat", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "5 g Parsley, fresh, chopped", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cook the whole wheat fettuccine according to package directions in generously salted boiling water until al dente. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the fresh spinach to the skillet and cook, stirring, until it wilts down, about 2-3 minutes. Pour in the milk and light cream, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer. Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese until melted and the sauce thickens slightly. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Drain the cooked fettuccine, reserving about 1 dl of the pasta water. Add the drained fettuccine to the skillet with the sauce. Toss to coat the pasta evenly. If the sauce seems too thick, add a splash of the reserved pasta water to loosen it. Stir in the chopped fresh parsley just before serving. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Spinach and Mushroom Fettuccine with Chicken
ingredients_json: ["400 g Fettuccine, dried", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "300 g Chicken breast fillet, without skin", "1 unit Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "250 g Mushrooms, white, raw", "200 g Spinach, raw", "3 dl Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "1 dl Cream, single, 18% fat", "50 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package directions until al dente. While the pasta cooks, cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the chicken on all sides. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil to the skillet. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Slice the mushrooms. Add the onion to the skillet and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook until the mushrooms have released their liquid and started to brown, about 7-10 minutes. Stir in the fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes. Pour in the milk and cream, bring to a simmer, and cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened slightly. Grate the Parmesan cheese. Stir most of the Parmesan into the sauce, reserving some for garnish. Return the cooked chicken to the skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Drain the cooked fettuccine and add it to the skillet with the sauce. Toss gently to coat the pasta evenly. Serve immediately, garnished with the reserved Parmesan cheese.

title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Asparagus and Roasted Garlic
ingredients_json: ["400 g Filet Mignon, center cut", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "4 cloves Garlic, whole", "500 g Asparagus, trimmed", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1.5 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Toss the trimmed asparagus with 1 tbsp of olive oil, 1 clove of minced garlic (from one of the whole cloves), rosemary, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper on a baking sheet. Arrange the remaining whole garlic cloves amongst the asparagus. Roast for 12-15 minutes, or until the asparagus is tender-crisp and the garlic is softened. While the asparagus roasts, pat the filet mignon steaks completely dry with paper towels. Season generously on all sides with the remaining 1 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Carefully place the steaks in the hot skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes per side, until a deep brown crust forms. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for an additional 4-7 minutes for medium-rare (internal temperature of 52°C), or longer to your desired doneness. Let the steaks rest for 5-10 minutes before serving alongside the roasted asparagus and garlic.

title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Asparagus and Roasted Garlic Mash
ingredients_json: ["400 g Filet mignon, center cut", "30 g Olive oil", "10 g Butter, unsalted", "2 cloves Garlic, whole, unpeeled", "500 g Potatoes, white", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "250 g Asparagus, fresh", "5 g Olive oil", "2 g Salt, fine", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Toss the unpeeled garlic cloves with 5g olive oil and roast in the oven for 20 minutes until soft. While the garlic roasts, peel and dice the potatoes and boil them in salted water until tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain the potatoes and return them to the pot. Mash the potatoes with 100ml semi-skimmed milk and 20g unsalted butter until smooth. Squeeze the roasted garlic from its skin into the mashed potatoes, season with salt and pepper, and mix well. Keep warm. Trim the tough ends off the asparagus. Toss the asparagus with 5g olive oil, salt, and pepper. When the potatoes are done, pat the filet mignon steaks dry with paper towels and season generously with salt and pepper. Heat 30g olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Sear the steaks for 2-3 minutes per side until a deep brown crust forms. Add 10g unsalted butter and the whole peeled garlic cloves to the skillet. Baste the steaks with the melted butter for about 1 minute. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 5-8 minutes for medium-rare, or to your desired doneness. While the steaks are in the oven, roast the seasoned asparagus on a baking sheet for 10-12 minutes until tender-crisp. Let the steaks rest for 5 minutes before serving. Serve the filet mignon with the roasted garlic mashed potatoes and asparagus.

title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Garlic Herb Butter and Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["2 200 g Filet Mignon steak", "30 g Unsalted butter", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Fresh rosemary, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh thyme, chopped", "15 ml Olive oil", "300 g Asparagus, trimmed", "5 g Salt", "3 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Pat the filet mignon steaks dry with paper towels and season generously on all sides with salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Sear the steaks for 2-3 minutes per side, until a deep brown crust forms. Remove the skillet from the heat. In a small bowl, combine the softened butter with the minced garlic, chopped rosemary, and thyme. Spread half of the herb butter over the top of each steak. Place the skillet in the preheated oven and roast for 5-8 minutes for medium-rare, or until desired doneness. While the steaks are in the oven, toss the trimmed asparagus with a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast the asparagus alongside the steaks for the last 5-7 minutes of cooking. Let the steaks rest for 5 minutes before serving with the roasted asparagus.

title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Asparagus and Garlic-Herb Butter
ingredients_json: ["400 g Filet Mignon", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Fresh rosemary, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh thyme, chopped", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Asparagus, trimmed", "5 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Pat the filet mignon steaks completely dry with paper towels. Season generously on all sides with salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a heavy-bottomed skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Carefully place the steaks in the hot skillet and sear for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or adjust time to your desired doneness. While the steaks are searing, melt the unsalted butter in a small bowl. Stir in the minced garlic, chopped rosemary, and chopped thyme. Once the steaks have reached your desired internal temperature (use a meat thermometer for accuracy), remove them from the skillet and let them rest on a cutting board for at least 5-10 minutes. While the steaks are resting, add the trimmed asparagus to the same skillet (pour off excess fat if necessary) and sauté for 3-5 minutes until tender-crisp. Drizzle the garlic-herb butter over the rested filet mignon just before serving alongside the sautéed asparagus.

title: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon with Garlic Herb Butter and Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["2 piece Filet Mignon, 200 g each", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "3 clove Garlic, peeled and smashed", "2 sprig Rosemary, fresh", "2 sprig Thyme, fresh", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "400 g Asparagus, trimmed", "10 g Salt, fine sea salt", "5 g Black pepper, freshly ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Pat the filet mignon steaks completely dry with paper towels and season generously on all sides with salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a heavy-bottomed skillet (cast iron works best) over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Carefully place the steaks in the hot skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes per side, until a deep brown crust forms. Add the butter, smashed garlic cloves, rosemary, and thyme to the skillet. As the butter melts, tilt the pan and spoon the melted butter and aromatics over the steaks continuously for about 1 minute. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 4-6 minutes for medium-rare, or longer depending on your desired doneness. While the steaks are in the oven, toss the trimmed asparagus with a little olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread the asparagus on a baking sheet and roast for 10-12 minutes, or until tender-crisp. Remove the steaks from the oven, tent loosely with foil, and let them rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing. Serve the rested filet mignon alongside the roasted asparagus, drizzled with any remaining pan juices.

title: Grilled Flank Steak with Chimichurri and Roasted Sweet Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["500 g Flank steak, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 tsp Sea salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 medium Sweet potatoes, raw (approx. 400g total)", "1 dl Parsley, fresh", "0.5 dl Oregano, fresh", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 dl Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 tbsp Red wine vinegar", "0.5 tsp Red pepper flakes"]
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat. Pat the flank steak dry with paper towels. Rub the steak all over with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, sea salt, and black pepper. Grill the steak for about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare, adjusting time for your desired doneness. Remove from grill and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing against the grain. While the steak rests, prepare the chimichurri: finely chop the parsley, oregano, and garlic. In a small bowl, whisk together the chopped herbs, garlic, 1 dl of olive oil, red wine vinegar, and red pepper flakes. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper if desired. For the sweet potatoes, preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into 2 cm cubes. Toss with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized. Serve the sliced flank steak topped with a generous amount of chimichurri alongside the roasted sweet potatoes.

title: Marinated Flank Steak with Roasted Asparagus and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["500 g Flank steak", "4 dl Soy sauce", "2 dl Olive oil", "1 dl Balsamic vinegar", "4 cloves Garlic, crushed", "1 tbsp Honey", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "500 g Asparagus, trimmed", "2 dl Quinoa, uncooked", "4 dl Water"]
instructions: Begin by preparing the marinade. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, 1 dl of olive oil, balsamic vinegar, crushed garlic, honey, and black pepper. Place the flank steak in a resealable bag or shallow dish and pour the marinade over it. Ensure the steak is fully coated. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or preferably overnight, turning once. While the steak is marinating, rinse the quinoa thoroughly under cold water. In a saucepan, combine the rinsed quinoa with 4 dl of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until all the water is absorbed. Let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius (400 degrees Fahrenheit). On a baking sheet, toss the trimmed asparagus with the remaining 1 dl of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer. Remove the flank steak from the marinade, discarding the excess marinade. Sear the steak in a hot, oiled skillet over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes per side for medium-rare, or longer to your desired doneness. Let the steak rest for 10 minutes before slicing against the grain. Roast the asparagus in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until tender-crisp. Serve the sliced flank steak alongside the roasted asparagus and fluffy quinoa.

title: Garlic Herb Marinated Flank Steak with Roasted Asparagus and Sweet Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["600 g Flank steak, trimmed of excess fat", "3 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "4 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Fresh rosemary, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh thyme, chopped", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "500 g Sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes", "400 g Asparagus, trimmed", "1 tsp Salt, fine sea salt"]
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons of olive oil, minced garlic, chopped rosemary, chopped thyme, and black pepper to create the marinade. Place the flank steak in a resealable bag or shallow dish and pour the marinade over it, ensuring it's evenly coated. Marinate for at least 30 minutes at room temperature or up to 4 hours in the refrigerator. Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). On a large baking sheet, toss the sweet potato cubes with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread them in a single layer. Roast for 20 minutes. While the sweet potatoes are roasting, remove the flank steak from the marinade, letting any excess drip off. Heat a grill pan or heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the flank steak for 4-6 minutes per side for medium-rare, or longer depending on your desired doneness. Remove the steak from the pan and let it rest on a cutting board for at least 10 minutes before slicing. After the sweet potatoes have roasted for 20 minutes, add the trimmed asparagus to the baking sheet with the sweet potatoes, tossing them together gently. Return the baking sheet to the oven and roast for another 10-15 minutes, or until the asparagus is tender-crisp and the sweet potatoes are fully cooked and slightly caramelized. Slice the rested flank steak against the grain. Serve the sliced steak with the roasted asparagus and sweet potatoes.

title: Pan-Seared Flank Steak with Roasted Asparagus and Garlic-Herb Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["680 g Flank steak", "450 g Asparagus, trimmed", "900 g Potatoes, small, quartered", "4 cloves Garlic, minced", "3 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 tbsp Fresh rosemary, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh thyme, chopped", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius (400 degrees Fahrenheit). Toss the quartered potatoes with 1.5 tablespoons of olive oil, half of the minced garlic, 1 tablespoon of rosemary, 1 teaspoon of thyme, 1/2 teaspoon of salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper on a baking sheet. Spread them in a single layer and roast for 30-35 minutes, or until tender and golden brown, flipping halfway through. While the potatoes are roasting, prepare the asparagus by tossing it with the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, remaining minced garlic, remaining rosemary, remaining thyme, 1/2 teaspoon of salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper on another baking sheet. When the potatoes have about 10-12 minutes left to cook, add the asparagus to the oven. Roast for 10-12 minutes, or until tender-crisp. Meanwhile, pat the flank steak dry with paper towels and season both sides generously with salt and pepper. Heat 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Sear the flank steak for 3-4 minutes per side until a deep brown crust forms. If your skillet is not oven-safe, transfer the steak to an oven-safe pan or baking sheet. Place the skillet with the steak into the preheated oven with the vegetables for 5-7 minutes for medium-rare (internal temperature of 57°C/135°F), or longer for your desired doneness. Let the steak rest for 10 minutes before slicing against the grain. Serve the sliced flank steak with the roasted asparagus and garlic-herb potatoes.

title: Herbed Flank Steak with Roasted Asparagus and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["700 g Flank steak", "400 g Asparagus, raw", "250 g Quinoa, dry", "5 dl Water", "3 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Fresh rosemary, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh thyme, chopped", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Rinse the quinoa thoroughly and cook it according to package directions, typically by combining 250g dry quinoa with 5dl water and simmering for about 15-20 minutes until the water is absorbed. While the quinoa cooks, prepare the flank steak. Pat the steak dry with paper towels. In a small bowl, combine 1 tablespoon of olive oil with the chopped rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper. Rub this mixture all over the flank steak. In a large skillet, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat. Sear the flank steak for 3-4 minutes per side until nicely browned. Transfer the seared steak to a baking sheet. Trim the woody ends off the asparagus and toss them with 1 clove of minced garlic and a drizzle of olive oil. Arrange the asparagus around the flank steak on the baking sheet. Roast in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes, or until the steak reaches your desired doneness (around 55-60°C internal temperature for medium-rare) and the asparagus is tender-crisp. Let the steak rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain. Serve the sliced flank steak with the roasted asparagus and cooked quinoa.

title: Pan-Seared Flat Iron Steak with Garlic-Herb Butter and Roasted Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["400 g Flat iron steak", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "3 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Fresh rosemary, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh thyme, chopped", "1 tsp Black pepper, freshly ground", "500 g Asparagus, trimmed", "1 tbsp Lemon juice", "0.5 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Pat the flat iron steak dry with paper towels and season generously with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, adjusting for your desired doneness. Remove the steak from the skillet and let it rest on a cutting board. While the steak rests, add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil to the same skillet. Add the asparagus and toss to coat. Roast the asparagus in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until tender-crisp. While the asparagus is roasting, melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir in the minced garlic, chopped rosemary, and chopped thyme. Cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, but do not brown the garlic. Once the steak has rested for at least 5 minutes, slice it against the grain. Drizzle the garlic-herb butter over the sliced steak and serve immediately with the roasted asparagus, squeezed with fresh lemon juice.

title: Pan-Seared Flat Iron Steak with Roasted Asparagus and Garlic Mashed Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["400 g Flat iron steak", "500 g Potatoes, white, all purpose", "250 g Asparagus, raw", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "3 cloves Garlic", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Toss the asparagus with 0.5 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper, and spread on a baking sheet. Roast for 10-12 minutes, or until tender-crisp. While the asparagus roasts, peel and chop the potatoes into even chunks. Boil them in salted water until fork-tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain the potatoes well. Mash them with 20g butter, the milk, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Mince two cloves of garlic and stir into the mashed potatoes. Pat the flat iron steak dry with paper towels. Season generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Heat the remaining 0.5 tbsp olive oil and 10g butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the steak for 2-3 minutes per side until a good crust forms. Add the remaining minced garlic clove to the pan and let it cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for another 4-6 minutes for medium-rare, or to your desired doneness. Let the steak rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing. Serve the sliced steak alongside the roasted asparagus and garlic mashed potatoes.

title: Pan-Seared Flat Iron Steak with Garlic Herb Butter and Roasted Asparagus
ingredients_json: ["450 g Flat iron steak", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "115 g Butter, unsalted", "4 cloves Garlic, minced", "2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh rosemary, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh thyme, chopped", "400 g Asparagus, trimmed", "1 tbsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: Pat the flat iron steak completely dry with paper towels. Season generously on both sides with salt and black pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Carefully place the steak in the hot skillet and sear for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or longer depending on desired doneness. While the steak is searing, melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in the chopped parsley, rosemary, and thyme. Remove from heat. Once the steak is cooked, transfer it to a cutting board and let it rest for 5-10 minutes. While the steak rests, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet. Add the trimmed asparagus and sauté for 5-7 minutes, or until tender-crisp. Toss the asparagus with lemon juice. Slice the rested steak against the grain. Drizzle the steak and asparagus with the garlic herb butter. Serve immediately.

title: Pan-Seared Flat Iron Steak with Roasted Asparagus and Garlic Herb Butter
ingredients_json: ["500 g Flat iron steak", "300 g Asparagus, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Fresh rosemary, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh thyme, chopped", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Trim any tough connective tissue from the flat iron steak. Pat the steak dry with paper towels. Season generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Toss the asparagus with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper, and spread them in a single layer on a baking sheet. Roast for 10-12 minutes, or until tender-crisp. While the asparagus roasts, prepare the herb butter. In a small bowl, mash together the softened butter, minced garlic, chopped rosemary, and chopped thyme. Set aside. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Carefully place the seasoned steak in the hot skillet. Sear for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or longer depending on your desired doneness. Once seared, remove the steak from the skillet and let it rest on a cutting board for 5-10 minutes. Spoon the garlic herb butter over the warm, resting steak. Slice the steak against the grain and serve immediately with the roasted asparagus.

title: Pan-Seared Flat Iron Steak with Roasted Asparagus and Garlic Herb Butter
ingredients_json: ["500 g Flat iron steak", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "400 g Asparagus, trimmed", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "1 tbsp Fresh rosemary, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh thyme, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Toss the trimmed asparagus with 1 tbsp of olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet and spread in a single layer. Roast for 12-15 minutes, or until tender-crisp. While the asparagus roasts, pat the flat iron steak dry with paper towels. Season generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Heat the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, adjusting time for desired doneness. Let the steak rest on a cutting board for 5-10 minutes. In a small bowl, combine the softened butter, minced garlic, chopped rosemary, and chopped thyme. Mix well. Slice the rested steak against the grain and top each slice with a dollop of the garlic herb butter. Serve immediately with the roasted asparagus.

title: Mediterranean Whole Wheat Flatbreads with Hummus, Roasted Vegetables, and Feta
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g All-purpose flour", "150 ml Lukewarm water", "5 g Instant yeast", "5 g Salt", "15 ml Olive oil, plus extra for brushing", "100 g Hummus", "150 g Zucchini, sliced", "100 g Red bell pepper, sliced", "100 g Red onion, sliced", "10 ml Olive oil, for roasting", "5 g Dried oregano", "5 g Salt, for roasting", "3 g Black pepper, for roasting", "50 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "30 g Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, instant yeast, and salt. Gradually add the lukewarm water and 15 ml olive oil while mixing to form a shaggy dough. Knead on a lightly floured surface for about 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size. While the dough is rising, preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/gas mark 6). Toss the sliced zucchini, red bell pepper, and red onion with 10 ml olive oil, dried oregano, salt, and pepper. Spread them in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized. Once the dough has risen, punch it down and divide it into 2-3 equal portions. Roll each portion into a thin flatbread, about 0.5 cm thick. Heat a lightly oiled cast-iron skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Cook each flatbread for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown and slightly puffed. Alternatively, bake the flatbreads on a preheated baking stone or tray in the oven for 5-7 minutes. Once cooked, spread each flatbread generously with hummus. Top with the roasted vegetables and crumbled feta cheese. Sprinkle with fresh chopped parsley before serving.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Vegetable Flatbreads with Hummus
ingredients_json: ["400 g Whole wheat flatbreads", "200 g Cooked chicken breast, shredded", "100 g Hummus", "100 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "1 dl Cherry tomatoes, halved", "1 dl Cucumber, diced", "1 dl Red onion, thinly sliced", "1 dl Bell pepper, any color, diced", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 dl Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Lightly brush the flatbreads with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sprinkle with half of the garlic powder and dried oregano. Place them on a baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until lightly golden and warm. While the flatbreads are baking, in a medium bowl, combine the shredded chicken, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, bell pepper, remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, remaining garlic powder, dried oregano, and black pepper. Toss to combine. Remove the flatbreads from the oven. Spread a generous layer of hummus over each warm flatbread. Top with the chicken and vegetable mixture. Sprinkle evenly with crumbled feta cheese and fresh chopped parsley. Serve immediately.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea and Spinach Flatbreads with Feta
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g All-purpose flour", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "200 ml Warm water", "2 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 can (400 g) Chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "100 g Fresh spinach", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "50 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "1 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the warm water and olive oil, mixing until a shaggy dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let it rest for 30 minutes. While the dough rests, prepare the filling: in a medium bowl, lightly mash the chickpeas with a fork. Stir in the fresh spinach (it will wilt from the residual heat of the chickpeas), minced garlic, crumbled feta cheese, chopped parsley, dried oregano, and black pepper. Once the dough has rested, divide it into 2 equal portions. On a lightly floured surface, roll each portion into a thin circle, about 20 cm in diameter. Heat a dry non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Cook each flatbread for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown spots appear. Spoon the chickpea and spinach mixture evenly onto one half of each cooked flatbread. Fold the other half over to create a pocket. Serve immediately.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea and Vegetable Flatbreads
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chickpeas, canned, drained and rinsed", "150 g Red onion, chopped", "200 g Bell pepper, red, chopped", "200 g Courgette, chopped", "100 g Cherry tomatoes, halved", "60 ml Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1/2 tsp Dried thyme", "1/4 tsp Red pepper flakes", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Plain yogurt, low fat", "1/2 tsp Baking powder", "1/4 tsp Salt", "50 ml Water, cold", "100 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "30 g Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). In a large bowl, combine the drained chickpeas, chopped red onion, red bell pepper, courgette, and halved cherry tomatoes. Drizzle with 40 ml of olive oil, add the minced garlic, dried oregano, dried thyme, and red pepper flakes. Season with salt and pepper, and toss everything together to coat evenly. Spread the vegetable and chickpea mixture in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized. While the vegetables are roasting, prepare the flatbread dough. In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, baking powder, and salt. Make a well in the center and add the plain yogurt and 20 ml of cold water. Mix until a shaggy dough forms, then turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for about 5 minutes until smooth and elastic. Divide the dough into 4 equal portions and roll each one out thinly into a flatbread shape. Heat a lightly oiled skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Cook each flatbread for 2-3 minutes per side, until puffed and lightly golden brown. Once the roasted vegetables and chickpeas are done, remove them from the oven. Assemble the flatbreads by spooning a generous amount of the roasted vegetable and chickpea mixture onto each flatbread. Sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese and fresh chopped parsley. Drizzle with the remaining 20 ml of olive oil.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Hummus Flatbreads
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flatbreads", "200 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "100 g Hummus, plain", "1 dl Cherry tomatoes, halved", "0.5 dl Red onion, thinly sliced", "50 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 dl Fresh spinach"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/gas mark 6). While the oven heats, toss the chicken breast pieces with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, minced garlic, dried oregano, and black pepper in a bowl. Season lightly with salt. Spread the chicken in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through and golden. While the chicken bakes, warm the flatbreads slightly according to package instructions, or briefly in a dry pan. Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes. Assemble the flatbreads by spreading a generous layer of hummus over each one. Top with fresh spinach, followed by the cooked chicken pieces, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced red onion, and crumbled feta cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Classic French Onion Soup with Gruyère Croutons
ingredients_json: ["1.5 kg Onions, yellow, sliced", "100 g Butter, unsalted", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, crushed", "200 ml Dry white wine", "1.5 l Beef broth, low sodium", "2 sprigs Thyme, fresh", "1 bay leaf", "Salt, to taste", "Black pepper, ground, to taste", "4 slices Baguette, stale", "150 g Gruyère cheese, grated"]
instructions: Melt the butter and olive oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium-low heat. Add the sliced onions and cook slowly, stirring occasionally, for 30-45 minutes, or until deeply caramelized and a rich brown color. Add the crushed garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Pour in the white wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Let it simmer and reduce by half. Add the beef broth, thyme sprigs, and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Season with salt and pepper to taste. While the soup simmers, toast the baguette slices until golden brown. Ladle the hot soup into oven-safe bowls. Place a toasted baguette slice on top of each bowl of soup. Generously sprinkle the grated Gruyère cheese over the baguette. Place the bowls on a baking sheet and broil for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and lightly browned. Serve immediately.

title: Hearty Beef and Vegetable French Onion Soup
ingredients_json: ["1.5 kg Beef chuck, boneless", "200 g Onions, yellow, sliced", "200 g Leeks, white and light green parts only, thinly sliced", "100 g Carrots, diced", "100 g Celery, diced", "4 cloves Garlic, minced", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 dl Dry white wine", "2 liter Beef broth, low sodium", "500 ml Water", "3 sprigs Thyme, fresh", "2 Bay leaves", "1 tsp Black peppercorns", "200 g Baguette, sliced", "150 g Gruyère cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C (320°F). Sear the beef chuck in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat with 1 tablespoon of olive oil until well browned on all sides. Remove the beef and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the pot and reduce heat to medium. Add the sliced onions and leeks and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and beginning to caramelize, about 15-20 minutes. Add the diced carrots and celery and cook for another 5 minutes until slightly tender. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Deglaze the pot by pouring in the dry white wine and scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Let it simmer and reduce by half. Return the seared beef to the pot. Pour in the beef broth and water. Add the fresh thyme sprigs, bay leaves, and black peppercorns. Bring the soup to a simmer, then cover and transfer to the preheated oven. Braise for 3 to 3.5 hours, or until the beef is fork-tender. Remove the beef from the soup, shred it, and return it to the pot. Discard the thyme sprigs, bay leaves, and peppercorns. Season with salt to taste. Ladle the soup into oven-safe bowls. Top each bowl with a few slices of baguette and a generous portion of grated Gruyère cheese. Broil for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Classic French Onion Soup with Gruyère Crouton
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg Yellow onions, sliced thinly", "100 g Butter, unsalted", "30 ml Olive oil", "2 g Dried thyme", "2 bay leaves", "2.5 l Beef broth, low sodium", "200 ml Dry white wine", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 tsp Salt, fine sea salt", "1/2 tsp Black pepper, ground", "8 slices Baguette, 2 cm thick", "200 g Gruyère cheese, grated"]
instructions: Melt the butter and olive oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, for 30-40 minutes, or until the onions are deeply caramelized and a rich brown color. Do not rush this step, as it develops the soup's flavor. Stir in the dried thyme, bay leaves, and cook for another minute until fragrant. Pour in the dry white wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Let the wine simmer and reduce by half, about 5 minutes. Add the beef broth and Worcestershire sauce. Bring the soup to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and let it cook for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Season with salt and pepper to taste. While the soup simmers, preheat your broiler. Arrange the baguette slices on a baking sheet and toast them lightly under the broiler until golden brown on both sides. Remove from the broiler and set aside. Remove the bay leaves from the soup. Ladle the hot soup into oven-safe bowls. Top each bowl with 1-2 slices of toasted baguette, then generously sprinkle with grated Gruyère cheese. Place the bowls on a baking sheet and broil for 2-4 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and golden brown. Serve immediately, being careful as the bowls will be very hot.

title: Hearty Beef French Onion Soup with Gruyère Croutons
ingredients_json: ["1.5 kg Beef shin, bone in", "2.5 l Water", "500 g Onions, yellow, peeled", "200 g Onions, red, peeled", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "30 ml Olive oil", "30 g All-purpose flour", "200 ml Red wine, dry", "4 sprigs Thyme, fresh", "2 Bay leaves", "10 g Salt", "5 g Black pepper, ground", "4 slices Bread, baguette, stale", "150 g Gruyère cheese, grated"]
instructions: To make the beef broth, place the beef shin in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Skim off any impurities that rise to the surface. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for at least 3 hours, or until the beef is very tender and falling off the bone. Strain the broth, reserving the meat and discarding the bones and impurities. Shred the reserved beef and set aside. For the soup base, thinly slice the yellow and red onions. In a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, melt the butter with the olive oil over medium-low heat. Add the sliced onions and cook slowly, stirring occasionally, for 45-60 minutes, until deeply caramelized and a rich brown color. Be patient, as this step is crucial for flavor. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Pour in the red wine and scrape the bottom of the pot to loosen any browned bits. Cook for 2-3 minutes until the wine has reduced slightly. Add the beef broth, shredded beef, fresh thyme sprigs, and bay leaves. Bring the soup to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Season with salt and ground black pepper. Remove the thyme sprigs and bay leaves. Preheat your broiler. Ladle the hot soup into oven-safe bowls. Top each bowl with a slice of stale baguette, then generously sprinkle with grated Gruyère cheese. Place the bowls on a baking sheet and broil for 2-4 minutes, watching carefully, until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and golden brown.

title: Hearty French Onion Soup with Gruyère Croutons
ingredients_json: ["1.5 kg Yellow onions, sliced thinly", "100 g Butter, unsalted", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "2.5 l Beef broth, low sodium", "2 dl Dry white wine", "2 tbsp All-purpose flour", "2 tsp Thyme, dried", "1 tsp Black pepper, freshly ground", "8 slices Baguette, 1.5 cm thick", "200 g Gruyère cheese, grated"]
instructions: Melt the butter with olive oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are very soft and deeply caramelized, about 45-60 minutes. Do not rush this process, as the slow caramelization is key to the soup's flavor. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Sprinkle the flour over the onions and stir to coat, cooking for 1-2 minutes to cook out the raw flour taste. Gradually pour in the white wine, scraping the bottom of the pot to loosen any browned bits. Let it simmer and reduce slightly for about 5 minutes. Pour in the beef broth and add the dried thyme and black pepper. Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. While the soup simmers, preheat your broiler. Arrange the baguette slices on a baking sheet and toast them lightly under the broiler until golden brown on both sides. Remove from the broiler. Once the soup has simmered, ladle it into oven-safe bowls. Top each bowl with 2-3 toasted baguette slices, ensuring they cover the surface. Generously sprinkle the grated Gruyère cheese over the bread. Carefully place the bowls on a sturdy baking sheet and put them under the broiler for 2-4 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and golden brown. Watch closely to prevent burning. Serve immediately, being careful as the bowls will be very hot.

title: Crispy Baked Chicken Thighs with Herbs and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["800 g Chicken thighs, bone-in, skin-on", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tbsp Dried rosemary", "1 tbsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Garlic powder", "1 tsp Onion powder", "1 tsp Paprika", "0.5 tsp Black pepper", "1 tsp Salt", "1 Lemon, cut into wedges"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/Gas Mark 6). Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. In a large bowl, combine the olive oil, rosemary, thyme, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, black pepper, and salt. Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss them to coat evenly with the spice mixture. Arrange the seasoned chicken thighs in a single layer on a baking sheet. Place the lemon wedges around the chicken. Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until the chicken is golden brown, crispy, and cooked through, with an internal temperature of 75°C (165°F). Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Crispy Baked Chicken Breast with Herbed Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "1 dl Quinoa, uncooked", "2 dl Water", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "50 g Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Paprika", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "0.5 tsp Onion powder", "0.25 tsp Black pepper", "0.5 tsp Salt", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "0.5 dl Parsley, fresh, chopped", "0.5 dl Chives, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Cook the quinoa by rinsing it under cold water, then combining it with 2 dl of water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and stir in 1 tbsp of chopped parsley and chives. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper. While the quinoa cooks, prepare the chicken. In a shallow dish, mix together the whole wheat flour, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, 0.5 tsp salt, and black pepper. In another shallow dish, whisk the egg with the Dijon mustard. Dip each chicken breast first into the egg mixture, ensuring it's fully coated, then dredge it in the seasoned flour mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Drizzle 1 tbsp olive oil on a baking sheet or into a baking dish. Place the coated chicken breasts on the prepared sheet. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and golden brown, with an internal temperature of 75°C (165°F). Serve the crispy chicken immediately alongside the herbed quinoa.

title: Crispy Baked Chicken Breast with Herbs and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["2 piece Chicken breast, skinless, boneless, approx. 150g each", "1 dl Whole wheat flour", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Water", "2 tbsp Olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Prepare a baking sheet by lining it with parchment paper or lightly greasing it. In a shallow dish, combine the whole wheat flour, salt, black pepper, dried oregano, dried thyme, and garlic powder. In another shallow dish, whisk together the egg and water until well combined. Dip each chicken breast first into the flour mixture, ensuring it's evenly coated, then into the egg wash, allowing excess to drip off, and finally back into the flour mixture for a second coating. Place the coated chicken breasts on the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle the olive oil evenly over the top of each chicken breast. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is golden brown, crispy, and cooked through (internal temperature should reach 74°C or 165°F). Let rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Crispy Baked Chicken Breast with Herb Crust
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast fillet, without skin", "1 dl Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Paprika, ground", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "0.5 tsp Onion powder", "0.5 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Dried thyme", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 dl Milk, low fat, 1.5%", "2 dl Whole wheat breadcrumbs", "1 tbsp Olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius. Prepare two shallow dishes: one with the whole wheat flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, thyme, and black pepper. In the second dish, whisk together the egg and milk. Place the whole wheat breadcrumbs in a third shallow dish. Dip each chicken breast fillet first into the seasoned flour, shaking off any excess. Then, dip it into the egg and milk mixture, allowing excess to drip off. Finally, coat thoroughly with the breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere. Drizzle the olive oil into a baking dish and place the coated chicken breasts in the dish. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the coating is golden brown and crispy.

title: Crispy Baked Chicken Breast with Herbs and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "60 g Whole wheat flour", "2 unit Eggs, raw", "50 g Panko breadcrumbs", "10 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "5 g Fresh thyme, chopped", "3 g Garlic powder", "2 g Onion powder", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Salt, fine", "15 ml Olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a shallow dish, whisk the eggs. In another shallow dish, combine the whole wheat flour, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. In a third shallow dish, mix the panko breadcrumbs with the chopped parsley and thyme. Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels. Dredge each chicken breast first in the flour mixture, ensuring it's evenly coated, then dip it into the beaten eggs, allowing any excess to drip off. Finally, press the chicken into the panko mixture, coating all sides well. Arrange the coated chicken breasts on the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle the olive oil evenly over the top of the chicken. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is golden brown, crispy, and cooked through (internal temperature should reach 74°C/165°F). Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Chicken and Broccoli Fried Rice with Ginger and Garlic
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "200 g Rice, white, long-grain, cooked and chilled", "150 g Broccoli florets, raw", "1 medium Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Ginger, fresh, raw", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Sesame oil", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Carrot, raw", "1 piece Egg, raw", "50 ml Water"]
instructions: Dice the chicken fillet into small, bite-sized pieces. Finely chop the onion, mince the garlic, and grate the ginger. Cut the carrot into small cubes. If the broccoli florets are large, cut them into smaller, bite-sized pieces. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. Add the chopped onion to the pan and stir-fry until softened, about 3 minutes. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the cubed carrots and broccoli florets to the pan, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until they are tender-crisp. Push the vegetables to one side of the pan. Crack the egg into the empty space and scramble it quickly until cooked. Break up the scrambled egg and mix it with the vegetables. Add the cooked and chilled rice to the pan. Pour in the soy sauce and sesame oil. Stir well to combine everything, breaking up any clumps of rice, and ensure the rice is heated through, about 5-7 minutes. Return the cooked chicken to the pan and stir to combine. If the fried rice seems too dry, add 50 ml of water and stir until it reaches your desired consistency. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken and Broccoli Fried Rice with Ginger
ingredients_json: ["200 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "3 dl Cooked rice, white, long grain", "1 dl Broccoli florets, frozen", "1 piece Egg, raw", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Sesame oil", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, fresh", "1 tbsp Ginger, fresh, grated", "0.5 dl Spring onions, fresh, chopped", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Dice the chicken fillet into bite-sized pieces. Mince the garlic and grate the fresh ginger. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, stir-frying for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the diced chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Push the chicken to one side of the pan and crack the egg into the empty space. Scramble the egg with a spatula until cooked, then mix it with the chicken. Add the cooked rice, frozen broccoli florets, soy sauce, and sesame oil to the pan. Stir well to combine everything, breaking up any clumps of rice. Continue to stir-fry for another 3-5 minutes, or until the rice is heated through and the broccoli is tender-crisp. Stir in the chopped spring onions and black pepper. Serve hot.

title: Chicken and Broccoli Brown Rice Stir-Fry
ingredients_json: ["200 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "300 g Cooked brown rice, cold", "150 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "1 dl Carrots, raw, julienned", "1 dl Peas, frozen", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Ginger, fresh, grated", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Sesame oil", "1 tbsp Vegetable oil", "1 piece Egg, raw", "15 g Spring onion, raw, chopped"]
instructions: Dice the chicken breast into small, bite-sized pieces. Mince the garlic and grate the ginger. Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside. Add the broccoli florets and julienned carrots to the wok and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until they are tender-crisp. Add the frozen peas and cook for another minute. Push the vegetables to the side of the wok, crack the egg into the empty space, and scramble it until cooked. Add the cold cooked brown rice to the wok, breaking up any clumps. Stir in the cooked chicken, minced garlic, and grated ginger. Pour the soy sauce and sesame oil over the mixture and toss everything together to combine, ensuring the rice and vegetables are evenly coated. Stir-fry for another 3-5 minutes until the rice is heated through. Stir in most of the chopped spring onions, reserving some for garnish. Serve immediately, garnished with the remaining spring onions.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Brown Rice Stir-Fry
ingredients_json: ["200 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "150 g Brown rice, cooked", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Sesame oil", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "150 g Broccoli florets", "100 g Carrot, raw", "50 g Peas, frozen", "2 large Eggs, raw", "0.5 tsp Ginger, fresh, grated"]
instructions: Dice the chicken breast into small, bite-sized pieces and toss with 1/2 tablespoon of soy sauce and 1/2 tablespoon of sesame oil. Set aside to marinate for at least 10 minutes. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Cut the broccoli into small florets and dice the carrot into small cubes. Whisk the eggs in a small bowl. Heat 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the whisked eggs and scramble them until just cooked. Remove from the wok and set aside. Add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of olive oil to the wok. Add the diced chicken and stir-fry until it's cooked through and lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside. Add the chopped onion and diced carrot to the hot wok. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until the onion is softened and the carrot is tender-crisp. Add the broccoli florets and minced garlic, and cook for another 3-4 minutes until the broccoli is bright green and tender-crisp. Add the cooked brown rice, remaining 1/2 tablespoon of soy sauce, and the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of sesame oil. Stir in the grated ginger. Toss everything together well, breaking up any clumps of rice, and cook for 2-3 minutes until the rice is heated through. Return the cooked chicken and scrambled eggs to the wok. Add the frozen peas and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes, or until the peas are heated through and the chicken and eggs are well distributed. Serve hot.

title: Healthy Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, skinless", "300 g Brown rice, cooked", "1 dl Frozen peas", "1 dl Frozen corn", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Ginger, fresh, grated", "3 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Sesame oil", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Finely chop the onion. Mince the garlic. Grate the fresh ginger. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil to the wok. Add the chopped onion and stir-fry until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and stir-fry for another minute until fragrant. Add the cooked brown rice, frozen peas, and frozen corn to the wok. Stir-fry for 5-7 minutes, breaking up any clumps of rice, until the vegetables are tender and the rice is heated through. Return the cooked chicken to the wok. Pour in the low-sodium soy sauce and sesame oil. Stir well to combine and coat all ingredients evenly. Cook for another 2 minutes. Season with black pepper. Serve hot.

title: Spinach and Ricotta Gnocchi with Brown Butter Sage Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g Ricotta cheese, drained", "100 g Spinach, cooked and squeezed dry", "1 large Egg, raw", "200 g All-purpose flour", "100 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "50 g Unsalted butter", "10 g Fresh sage leaves", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "10 ml Lemon juice", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the drained ricotta cheese, finely chopped cooked spinach, and the raw egg. Mix thoroughly until well combined. Gradually add the all-purpose flour and grated Parmesan cheese, mixing until a soft dough forms. Be careful not to overmix. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and gently knead a few times until it just comes together. Divide the dough into portions and roll each portion into a long rope about 1.5 cm in diameter. Cut the ropes into 2 cm pieces. You can press the gnocchi with a fork for ridges if desired. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully drop the gnocchi into the boiling water in batches. Cook until they float to the surface, about 2-3 minutes. While the gnocchi are cooking, melt the unsalted butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the fresh sage leaves and minced garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the butter turns a nutty brown color and the sage leaves are crispy, about 3-5 minutes. Be careful not to burn the garlic. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked gnocchi from the boiling water directly into the skillet with the brown butter sauce. Add the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Gently toss the gnocchi to coat them evenly in the sauce. Serve immediately, garnished with extra grated Parmesan if desired.

title: Whole Wheat Gnocchi with Spinach and Ricotta
ingredients_json: ["400 g Whole wheat flour", "200 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "1 large Egg, raw", "1 tsp Salt", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 dl Vegetable broth"]
instructions: On a clean surface, mix the whole wheat flour and salt. Make a well in the center and add the ricotta cheese and the egg. Gradually mix the ingredients from the center outwards until a dough forms. Knead lightly for about 5 minutes until smooth. Divide the dough into 4 portions and roll each portion into a long rope, about 2 cm thick. Cut the ropes into 2 cm pieces. You can gently press each piece with a fork to create ridges, or leave them as is. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Carefully drop the gnocchi into the boiling water in batches. Cook until they float to the surface, about 3-5 minutes. While the gnocchi are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the fresh spinach and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a simmer. Drain the cooked gnocchi and add them directly to the skillet with the spinach mixture. Gently toss to coat the gnocchi. Stir in most of the grated Parmesan cheese, reserving some for garnish. Serve immediately, garnished with the remaining Parmesan cheese.

title: Spinach and Ricotta Gnocchi with Lemon-Herb Butter Sauce
ingredients_json: ["400 g Potato, cooked and mashed", "150 g Ricotta cheese, drained", "50 g Spinach, cooked and finely chopped", "1 unit Egg, large", "150 g Flour, all-purpose", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "100 g Butter, unsalted", "1 unit Lemon, zest and juice", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "30 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "15 g Fresh basil, chopped", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Salt"]
instructions: Combine the mashed potatoes, drained ricotta cheese, finely chopped spinach, egg, and half of the grated Parmesan cheese in a large bowl. Gradually add the all-purpose flour and mix until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms. Be careful not to overmix. Season with salt and pepper. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and gently knead for a minute or two until just combined. Roll the dough into long ropes, about 2 cm in diameter. Cut the ropes into 2 cm pieces. You can leave them as is or roll them gently over the tines of a fork to create ridges. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully drop the gnocchi into the boiling water in batches. Cook until they float to the surface, then let them cook for another 1-2 minutes. Remove the cooked gnocchi with a slotted spoon and set aside. In a large skillet, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in the lemon zest and juice. Add the cooked gnocchi to the skillet, along with the chopped parsley and basil. Toss gently to coat the gnocchi in the sauce. Sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan cheese and serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Gnocchi with Spinach and Ricotta
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "250 g Ricotta cheese, drained", "1 piece Egg, large, raw", "100 g Spinach, fresh", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "1 pinch Nutmeg, ground", "1 pinch Salt", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground"]

Gently mix the ingredients together with your hands or a fork until a soft dough forms. Be careful not to overmix. On a lightly floured surface, turn out the dough and knead it briefly until it just comes together. Divide the dough into four portions and roll each portion into a long rope, about 1.5 cm thick. Cut each rope into 2 cm pieces. You can leave them as is or gently roll them on a fork to create ridges. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully add the gnocchi in batches, ensuring not to overcrowd the pot. Cook until the gnocchi float to the surface, which should take about 2-3 minutes. While the gnocchi are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Mince the garlic clove and add it to the hot oil, sautéing for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the fresh spinach to the skillet and cook, stirring, until it wilts, about 1-2 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer the cooked gnocchi directly from the boiling water into the skillet with the spinach and garlic. Add the grated Parmesan cheese and gently toss everything together to coat the gnocchi and spinach. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Gnocchi with Spinach, Cherry Tomatoes, and Ricotta
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "150 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "1 large Egg, raw", "75 g Spinach, raw", "250 g Cherry tomatoes", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 dl Low-fat milk", "1 tbsp Fresh basil, chopped", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: For the gnocchi, combine the whole wheat flour and ricotta cheese in a large bowl. Make a well in the center and crack in the egg. Gradually mix the flour and ricotta into the egg, using your hands, until a soft dough forms. Be careful not to overwork the dough. Knead lightly for 1-2 minutes. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and divide it into 4 portions. Roll each portion into a long rope about 2 cm thick. Cut the ropes into 2 cm pieces. You can press each piece with a fork to create ridges if desired. Set aside on a lightly floured baking sheet. Meanwhile, blanch the spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds, then drain and finely chop. Halve the cherry tomatoes. Mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 5-7 minutes, until they start to soften and burst. Stir in the chopped spinach and cook for another 2 minutes. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully add the gnocchi in batches, ensuring not to overcrowd the pot. Cook until the gnocchi float to the surface, which should take about 3-5 minutes. Remove the cooked gnocchi with a slotted spoon and add them directly to the skillet with the tomato and spinach mixture. Gently toss to combine. In a small bowl, whisk together the low-fat milk and grated Parmesan cheese until smooth. Pour the sauce over the gnocchi and vegetables, and stir gently to coat. Heat through for 1-2 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Stir in the fresh basil just before serving. Serve immediately.

title: Hearty Turkey and Root Vegetable Goulash
ingredients_json: ["1000 g Turkey thigh, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 large Onions, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Paprika, sweet, ground", "1 tbsp Paprika, hot, ground", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "1 tsp Marjoram, dried", "2 large Carrots, raw", "2 medium Parsnips, raw", "1 large Sweet potato, raw", "1 liter Low-sodium beef broth", "400 g Canned tomatoes, diced", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp Apple cider vinegar", "1 Bay leaf, dried", "Salt, unspecified", "Black pepper, ground, unspecified", "200 g Plain yogurt, 0.5% fat"]
instructions: Cut the turkey thigh into 3-4 cm cubes. Season generously with salt and pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the turkey cubes in batches, ensuring not to overcrowd the pot, and set aside. Reduce the heat to medium, add the chopped onions to the pot, and cook until softened and translucent, about 8-10 minutes. Add the minced garlic, sweet paprika, hot paprika, cumin, and marjoram. Stir and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the cubed carrots, parsnips, and sweet potato to the pot. Stir to coat the vegetables with the spices. Return the browned turkey to the pot. Pour in the beef broth, add the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, apple cider vinegar, and the bay leaf. Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and let it cook for at least 1.5 to 2 hours, or until the turkey is tender and the vegetables are soft. Stir occasionally. Before serving, remove the bay leaf and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Ladle the goulash into bowls and serve with a dollop of plain yogurt.

title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Goulash
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 large Onions, yellow, unspecified, chopped", "4 cloves Garlic, raw, unspecified, minced", "2 medium Carrots, raw, unspecified, diced", "2 stalks Celery, raw, unspecified, diced", "1 kg Beef, lean, stewing cuts, unspecified, cubed", "2 tbsp Paprika, sweet", "1 tbsp Paprika, smoked", "1 tsp Caraway seeds, ground", "1 tsp Marjoram, dried", "1 litre Beef broth, low sodium", "400 g Tomatoes, crushed", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "2 Bay leaves", "150 g Lentils, brown, dried, rinsed", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]

Stir in the sweet paprika, smoked paprika, ground caraway seeds, and dried marjoram, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the beef broth, add the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, and bay leaves. Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 1.5 hours, stirring occasionally, until the beef is tender. Add the rinsed brown lentils to the pot, stir well, and continue to simmer, covered, for another 30-40 minutes, or until the lentils are cooked through and the goulash has thickened. Remove the bay leaves. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve hot.

title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Goulash
ingredients_json: ["300 g Brown lentils, dry", "1.5 l Vegetable broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 large Onions, yellow, chopped", "3 cloves Garlic, minced", "2 medium Carrots, peeled and diced", "2 medium Parsnips, peeled and diced", "1 large Red bell pepper, deseeded and diced", "1 tbsp Paprika, sweet", "1 tsp Paprika, smoked", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Marjoram, dried", "1 can (400 g) Tomatoes, crushed", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "200 g Potato, peeled and cubed", "50 g Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish)"]
