Add the diced carrots, parsnips, and red bell pepper to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in the sweet paprika, smoked paprika, cumin, and dried marjoram, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the vegetable broth, crushed tomatoes, and tomato paste. Add the rinsed lentils, salt, and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes. Add the cubed potatoes to the pot, stir, and continue to simmer, covered, for another 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils and vegetables are tender and the potatoes are cooked through. If the goulash becomes too thick, add a little more vegetable broth or water. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Serve hot, garnished with fresh chopped parsley.

title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Goulash
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 large Onions, yellow, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 medium Carrots, raw", "2 stalks Celery, raw", "1.5 kg Tomatoes, canned, chopped", "1 dl Red lentils, dry", "1 l Vegetable broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Paprika, sweet", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Marjoram, dried", "1 Bay leaf", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 dl Parsley, fresh, chopped"]

title: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Goulash
ingredients_json: ["1 kg Beef chuck, trimmed and cubed", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "3 large Onions, sliced", "4 cloves Garlic, minced", "3 tbsp Paprika, sweet", "1 tbsp Paprika, smoked", "1 tsp Caraway seeds, ground", "1 tsp Marjoram, dried", "1 litre Beef broth, low sodium", "400 g Tomatoes, chopped, canned", "3 Carrots, peeled and sliced", "2 Parsnips, peeled and sliced", "1 Red bell pepper, seeded and chopped", "1 Green bell pepper, seeded and chopped", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp All-purpose flour", "Salt, to taste", "Black pepper, to taste"]

title: Spicy Ground Chicken and Vegetable Stir-Fry

title: Spiced Ground Lamb Skillet with Quinoa and Roasted Vegetables

title: Hearty Vegetable and Lentil Lasagna

Spread the sweet potato, black bean, and corn mixture evenly over the chips. Place the platter back in the oven for 5-7 minutes, just until the chips are warmed through and the toppings are hot. While the nachos are warming, whisk together the Greek yogurt and lime juice in a small bowl until smooth. Remove the nachos from the oven. Top generously with the cilantro, diced avocado, and halved cherry tomatoes. Drizzle with the lime-yogurt sauce before serving.

title: Spicy Black Bean and Corn Nachos with Avocado Crema
ingredients_json: ["150 g Tortilla chips, whole grain", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, red, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "400 g Black beans, canned, rinsed and drained", "200 g Corn, sweet, canned, drained", "1 tsp Chili powder", "0.5 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.25 tsp Cayenne pepper", "150 ml Tomato passata", "100 g Cheese, cheddar, grated", "1 whole Avocado", "2 tbsp Lime juice, fresh", "50 ml Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "25 g Fresh cilantro, chopped", "1 whole Tomato, diced", "50 g Red onion, finely diced"]

Add the rinsed black beans, drained corn, chili powder, cumin, and cayenne pepper. Stir well to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes. title: Spicy Black Bean and Corn Nachos with Avocado Crema
ingredients_json: ["300 g Corn tortilla chips, baked", "400 g Black beans, canned, rinsed and drained", "200 g Sweet corn, canned or frozen", "1 medium Red onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Chili powder", "0.5 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.25 tsp Cayenne pepper", "150 g Monterey Jack cheese, shredded", "100 g Cheddar cheese, shredded", "1 medium Avocado", "60 ml Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "1 tbsp Lime juice", "1 dl Fresh cilantro, chopped", "1 medium Tomato, diced", "0.5 medium Jalapeno pepper, thinly sliced (optional)"]

title: Spicy Black Bean and Corn Nachos with Avocado Crema
ingredients_json: ["200 g Corn tortillas, baked", "400 g Black beans, canned, rinsed and drained", "150 g Sweetcorn, canned, drained", "150 g Red onion, finely chopped", "1 g Red chili, fresh, finely chopped", "10 g Coriander, fresh, chopped", "2 g Cumin, ground", "2 g Chili powder", "200 g Avocado", "50 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "10 ml Lime juice", "50 g Cherry tomatoes, halved", "25 g Jalapenos, pickled, sliced", "1 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper"]

Once the nachos are out of the oven, top them with the halved cherry tomatoes, sliced pickled jalapenos, and drizzle generously with the avocado crema.

title: Healthy Chicken and Black Bean Nachos with Avocado Salsa
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, cooked, shredded", "400 g Black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "150 g Corn kernels, frozen or canned", "150 g Red onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Chili powder", "0.25 tsp Cayenne pepper", "150 g Tomato, ripe, diced", "1 Avocado, ripe, diced", "0.5 dl Cilantro, fresh, chopped", "1 Lime, juiced", "100 g Bell pepper, red, diced", "100 g Bell pepper, yellow, diced", "50 g Jalapeno pepper, fresh, sliced (optional)", "150 g Low-fat cheese, grated (e.g., Monterey Jack or Cheddar)", "1 dl Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "1 tsp Smoked paprika"]

title: Healthy Whole Wheat Pasta Bake with Chicken and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat pasta, penne", "300 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless", "150 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "1 dl Low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "1 dl Low-sodium chicken broth", "50 g Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 tbsp Nutritional yeast", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "100 g Low-fat cottage cheese, unripened"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius. Cook the whole wheat pasta according to package directions until al dente, then drain and set aside. While the pasta cooks, chop the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken pieces and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. In the same skillet, add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the broccoli florets to the skillet and stir for 2 minutes. Pour in the low-fat milk and low-sodium chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer. Stir in the nutritional yeast, dried oregano, and black pepper. Add the cooked pasta and the cooked chicken back into the skillet. Stir everything together to coat evenly with the sauce. Dollop the low-fat cottage cheese over the mixture. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbling and the cottage cheese is lightly golden. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Pasta Bake with Lean Turkey and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat pasta, uncooked", "400 g Turkey mince, lean", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow, medium", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "500 g Broccoli florets, frozen", "400 g Chopped tomatoes, canned", "2 dl Low-fat milk", "2 tbsp Corn flour", "100 g Cheese, low-fat, grated", "0.5 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Dried basil", "Salt, to taste", "Black pepper, ground, to taste"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (170°C fan/gas mark 5). Cook the whole wheat pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside. While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large ovenproof pan or skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the lean turkey mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Add the frozen broccoli florets, chopped tomatoes, oregano, and basil. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes. In a small bowl, whisk together the low-fat milk and corn flour until smooth. Pour this mixture into the pan with the turkey and broccoli, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens. Stir in the cooked pasta. If your pan is not ovenproof, transfer the mixture to a suitable baking dish. Sprinkle the grated low-fat cheese evenly over the top. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and golden brown and the casserole is bubbling.

title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Noodle Bake
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat pasta, penne", "1 dl Olive oil", "2 pieces Onion, yellow, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Carrots, raw", "200 g Zucchini, raw", "400 g Tomatoes, crushed, canned", "200 g Lentils, green, cooked", "7 dl Vegetable broth", "2 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried basil", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "100 g Low-fat cheese, grated", "50 g Breadcrumbs, whole wheat"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/gas mark 6). Cook the whole wheat penne according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside. While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet or pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic, diced carrots, and chopped zucchini, and cook for another 5 minutes until the vegetables start to soften. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, cooked green lentils, vegetable broth, oregano, basil, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld. Add the drained cooked pasta to the skillet and stir to combine everything well. Sprinkle the grated low-fat cheese evenly over the top, followed by the whole wheat breadcrumbs. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is bubbling. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Turkey and Vegetable Noodle Bake
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat pasta, uncooked", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "400 g Turkey breast, lean, minced", "1 medium Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Broccoli florets, raw", "150 g Carrot, raw, chopped", "400 g Tomatoes, chopped, canned", "2 dl Low-sodium chicken broth", "1 dl Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "2 tbsp Cornstarch", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Cook the whole wheat pasta according to package directions until al dente, then drain and set aside. While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the minced turkey and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned. Remove the turkey from the skillet and set aside, leaving any drippings. Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the broccoli florets and chopped carrots, and cook for 5 minutes until slightly tender. Return the cooked turkey to the skillet. Stir in the canned chopped tomatoes and chicken broth. Bring the mixture to a simmer. In a small bowl, whisk together the milk and cornstarch until smooth. Pour this mixture into the skillet, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens. Stir in the oregano and black pepper. Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and stir gently to combine with the turkey and vegetables. Sprinkle the grated Parmesan cheese evenly over the top. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is bubbly.

title: Whole Wheat Pasta Bake with Spinach, Ricotta, and Chicken
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat pasta, penne", "400 g Chicken breast, skinless, cooked, shredded", "300 g Spinach, fresh", "400 g Tomatoes, crushed, canned", "250 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "100 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "150 ml Vegetable broth"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). Cook the whole wheat penne according to package directions until al dente. While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the fresh spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 3-5 minutes. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, shredded cooked chicken, vegetable broth, dried oregano, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes. Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the sauce. Stir to combine everything thoroughly. In a small bowl, mix the ricotta cheese with half of the grated Parmesan cheese. Spoon the pasta and chicken mixture into a 2-liter baking dish. Dollop spoonfuls of the ricotta mixture evenly over the top of the pasta. Sprinkle the remaining Parmesan cheese over the ricotta. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the casserole is heated through and the cheese on top is golden brown and bubbly.

title: Healthy Chicken and Vegetable Pad Thai
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice noodles, dried", "200 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, reduced sodium", "1 tbsp Fish sauce", "1 tbsp Tamarind paste", "1 tbsp Brown sugar", "1 tsp Sriracha sauce", "2 tbsp Peanut butter, natural", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 piece Ginger, fresh, grated", "150 g Firm tofu, firm", "1 medium Carrot, julienned", "1 medium Red bell pepper, thinly sliced", "100 g Broccoli florets", "50 g Bean sprouts", "2 Spring onions, chopped", "2 tbsp Peanuts, roasted, unsalted, chopped", "1 Lime, cut into wedges", "1 large Egg, raw"]
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water to prevent sticking. In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, fish sauce, tamarind paste, brown sugar, sriracha sauce, and peanut butter. Set aside. Cut the chicken into thin strips and toss with half of the prepared sauce. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil to the wok. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the julienned carrot, sliced red bell pepper, and broccoli florets. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Push the vegetables to one side of the wok. Pour the egg into the empty side and scramble until almost cooked. Add the cooked noodles, cooked chicken, and the remaining sauce to the wok. Toss everything together to combine and heat through, about 2-3 minutes. Stir in the bean sprouts and half of the chopped spring onions. Serve immediately, garnished with chopped peanuts, the remaining spring onions, and lime wedges.

title: Healthy Chicken and Vegetable Pad Thai
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice noodles, dried", "150 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless", "2 tbsp Peanut butter, unsalted", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tbsp Maple syrup", "1 tsp Sriracha sauce", "1 dl Water", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 cm Ginger, grated", "100 g Firm tofu, drained and pressed", "1 medium Carrot, julienned", "1 Red bell pepper, julienned", "100 g Broccoli florets", "50 g Bean sprouts", "2 Spring onions, sliced", "30 g Peanuts, roasted and chopped", "1 Lime, cut into wedges"]
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package directions until al dente, then drain and rinse with cold water. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the wok. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the firm tofu, julienned carrot, julienned red bell pepper, and broccoli florets to the wok. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Return the cooked chicken to the wok. Cook for another 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until everything is heated through. Stir in the bean sprouts and half of the sliced spring onions, cooking for 30 seconds more. title: Healthy Shrimp and Tofu Pad Thai with Brown Rice Noodles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Brown rice noodles", "150 g Shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "150 g Firm tofu, pressed and cubed", "2 tbsp Tamarind paste, unsweetened", "2 tbsp Fish sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Maple syrup", "1 tsp Sriracha sauce", "2 tbsp Rice vinegar", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 cm Ginger, grated", "1 tbsp Coconut oil", "1 medium Carrot, julienned", "1 Red bell pepper, thinly sliced", "100 g Bean sprouts", "50 g Green onions, chopped", "30 g Peanuts, roasted, unsalted, chopped", "1 Lime, cut into wedges", "1 tbsp Cilantro, fresh, chopped"]

Heat the coconut oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the shrimp and tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp is pink and cooked through and the tofu is lightly browned, about 3-5 minutes. Add the julienned carrot and sliced red bell pepper to the wok and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until slightly tender-crisp. Add the cooked noodles and the prepared sauce to the wok. Toss everything together to coat the noodles and ingredients evenly. Cook for another 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until heated through. Stir in most of the bean sprouts and green onions, reserving some for garnish. title: Healthy Chicken and Vegetable Pad Thai
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice noodles, dried", "200 g Chicken breast, raw", "2 tbsp Peanut oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 cm Ginger, fresh", "100 g Firm tofu, drained and pressed", "2 medium Carrots", "100 g Red bell pepper", "100 g Broccoli florets", "50 g Spring onion", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, reduced sodium", "1 tbsp Fish sauce", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tsp Brown sugar", "0.5 tsp Chili flakes", "2 large Eggs, raw", "30 g Peanuts, roasted, unsalted", "1 Lime"]

Add the minced garlic and ginger and stir-fry for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the tofu cubes and stir-fry until golden brown on all sides. Toss everything together to combine and heat through, ensuring the noodles are coated in the sauce. Stir in the white parts of the spring onions. Serve the Pad Thai immediately, garnished with the roasted peanuts, green parts of the spring onions, and wedges of lime.

title: Healthy Chicken and Vegetable Pad Thai
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rice noodles, dried", "150 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Fish sauce", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tbsp Brown sugar", "1 tsp Chili flakes, dried", "2 tbsp Peanut oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Ginger, fresh, grated", "150 g Firm tofu, drained and pressed", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Red bell pepper, raw", "50 g Spring onions, raw", "30 g Peanuts, roasted, unsalted", "1 Lime, fresh"]
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water. Prepare your vegetables by julienning the carrot and bell pepper, and slicing the spring onions. Cube the firm tofu. Heat 1 tablespoon of peanut oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry until cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove chicken from the wok and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of peanut oil to the wok. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and stir-fry until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Add the julienned carrots and bell peppers to the wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly tender-crisp. Add the cooked noodles, chicken, and the prepared sauce to the wok. Toss everything together until well combined and heated through, about 2-3 minutes. Stir in most of the sliced spring onions and roasted peanuts. Serve immediately, garnished with the remaining spring onions, peanuts, and a wedge of lime.

title: Healthy Seafood and Vegetable Paella
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 Red bell pepper, raw", "1 Green bell pepper, raw", "200 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "300 g Arborio rice", "1 litre Vegetable broth, low sodium", "0.5 tsp Saffron threads", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "200 g Mussels, raw, in shell", "200 g Shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "100 g Peas, frozen", "50 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or a wide, shallow skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the diced red and green bell peppers and cook for 5-7 minutes until slightly tender. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook until they begin to burst. Stir in the Arborio rice, coating it well with the oil and vegetables, and toast for 1-2 minutes. Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a simmer. Add the saffron threads and smoked paprika, stirring to combine. Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan, and let it simmer gently for about 15 minutes, or until most of the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is starting to cook. Arrange the mussels and shrimp on top of the rice. Cover again and cook for another 5-7 minutes, or until the seafood is cooked through and the mussels have opened. Stir in the frozen peas and cook for 2 minutes more until heated through. Remove from heat and let it rest for 5 minutes. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving.

title: Healthy Seafood and Vegetable Paella
ingredients_json: ["300 g Bomba rice", "1 L Vegetable broth, low sodium", "150 g Shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "150 g Mussels, raw, cleaned", "100 g Squid, cleaned and cut into rings", "1 Red bell pepper, deseeded and diced", "1 Green bell pepper, deseeded and diced", "1 Onion, yellow, finely chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "100 g Peas, frozen", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1/2 tsp Turmeric powder", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 Lemon, cut into wedges for serving", "10 g Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, shallow paella pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the diced red and green bell peppers and cook for about 5 minutes until they begin to soften. Stir in the Bomba rice, smoked paprika, and turmeric powder, ensuring the rice is evenly coated. Pour in the low-sodium vegetable broth and bring to a simmer. Arrange the shrimp, mussels, and squid evenly over the rice. Add the frozen peas. Do not stir from this point onwards. Let it simmer gently for 15-18 minutes, or until the rice has absorbed most of the liquid and is tender. The seafood should be cooked through and the mussels opened. If the rice is still too firm, add a splash more broth and continue to cook. Remove from heat, cover the pan loosely with foil, and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Healthy Seafood and Vegetable Paella
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "150 g Red bell pepper, raw", "150 g Green bell pepper, raw", "200 g Brown rice, uncooked", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Turmeric", "1 dl Dry white wine", "1 L Low-sodium vegetable broth", "300 g Mussels, raw", "200 g Shrimp, raw, shell removed", "100 g Peas, frozen", "50 g Cherry tomatoes, halved", "1 Lemon, cut into wedges", "2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, shallow paella pan or skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the diced red and green bell peppers and cook until tender-crisp, about 5 minutes. Stir in the uncooked brown rice, smoked paprika, and turmeric, ensuring the rice is well coated with the spices. Pour in the white wine and let it bubble and reduce by half. Pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a simmer. Arrange the mussels and shrimp on top of the rice mixture. Cover the pan and reduce the heat to low. Simmer gently for about 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid is mostly absorbed. Stir in the frozen peas and cherry tomatoes during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Once cooked, remove from heat, let stand for 5 minutes, then garnish with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges.

title: Seafood Paella with Saffron and Mixed Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["3 dl Bomba rice", "1 liter Fish stock, hot", "200 g Shrimp, raw, peeled and deveined", "150 g Mussels, cleaned", "150 g Squid, cleaned and cut into rings", "1 unit Onion, yellow, medium", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 unit Red bell pepper, medium", "1 unit Green bell pepper, medium", "200 g Tomatoes, ripe, chopped", "0.5 tsp Saffron threads", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "6 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "1 dl Dry white wine", "1 bunch Parsley, fresh", "1 unit Lemon", "1 pinch Salt", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Begin by finely chopping the onion, garlic, and both bell peppers. Heat 4 tablespoons of olive oil in a wide, shallow paella pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the bell peppers and cook for another 7-10 minutes until tender. Stir in the chopped tomatoes and smoked paprika, cooking for 2-3 minutes until the tomatoes have broken down slightly. Pour in the white wine and let it bubble and reduce for a minute. Add the Bomba rice and stir it well to coat the grains with the vegetables and oil for about 1-2 minutes. Dissolve the saffron threads in a little hot fish stock and pour this mixture into the pan, along with the remaining hot fish stock. Season with salt and pepper. Bring the liquid to a simmer, then reduce the heat to medium-low, cover loosely with foil, and cook for 10 minutes without stirring. Arrange the shrimp, mussels, and squid evenly over the rice. Continue to cook, uncovered, for another 8-10 minutes, or until the rice has absorbed most of the liquid and the seafood is cooked through. title: Healthy Seafood Paella with Brown Rice

instructions: Cook whole wheat pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water according to package directions until al dente. While pasta is cooking, cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Add the crushed garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and milk, bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low. Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese until melted and the sauce has thickened slightly. Add broccoli florets, julienned carrots, diced zucchini, and sliced red bell pepper to the skillet. Cover and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in chopped fresh basil, lemon juice, dried oregano, black pepper, and salt. Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the vegetables and chicken. Toss gently to combine everything, ensuring the pasta is well coated with the sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Mediterranean Chickpea and Quinoa Pasta Salad with Lemon-Herb Vinaigrette
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat pasta, penne", "150 g Quinoa, cooked", "400 g Chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "200 g Cherry tomatoes, halved", "100 g Cucumber, diced", "75 g Red onion, finely chopped", "50 g Black olives, pitted and sliced", "60 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "30 ml Olive oil, extra virgin", "30 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Dried basil", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Cook the whole wheat penne pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain the pasta and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking process and cool it down. In a large bowl, combine the cooked penne, cooked quinoa, drained chickpeas, halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, finely chopped red onion, and sliced black olives. In a small bowl, whisk together the extra virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, minced garlic, dried oregano, dried basil, and ground black pepper to create the vinaigrette. Pour the vinaigrette over the pasta and vegetable mixture and toss gently to combine. Add the crumbled feta cheese and chopped fresh parsley, and toss again to distribute evenly. For best flavor, let the pasta salad chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Pasta Salad with Chickpeas and Lemon-Herb Vinaigrette

ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat pasta", "1 can (400 g) Chickpeas, drained and rinsed", "1 can (150 g) Tuna in brine, drained", "150 g Cherry tomatoes, halved", "100 g Cucumber, diced", "50 g Red onion, finely chopped", "50 g Kalamata olives, pitted and halved", "30 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tbsp Lemon juice", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "0.5 tsp Dried oregano", "0.25 tsp Black pepper"]

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Pasta Salad with Lemon-Herb Vinaigrette
ingredients_json: ["250 g Quinoa pasta", "1 dl Olive oil, extra virgin", "0.5 dl Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Dried basil", "150 g Cherry tomatoes, halved", "1 dl Cucumber, diced", "1 dl Red onion, finely chopped", "1 dl Kalamata olives, pitted and halved", "100 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "0.5 dl Fresh parsley, chopped", "0.25 dl Fresh mint, chopped", "1 g Salt, fine", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cook the quinoa pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain well and rinse with cold water to cool it down. title: Chicken and Vegetable Lentil Pasties
ingredients_json: ["400 g Wholewheat flour", "150 g Butter, unsalted, cold", "75 ml Cold water", "200 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "100 g Brown lentils, dried", "150 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Onion, raw", "50 g Celery, raw", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt", "1 piece Egg, raw, for egg wash"]
instructions: To make the pastry, combine the wholewheat flour and cold butter in a large bowl, rubbing the butter into the flour with your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Gradually add the cold water, mixing until a dough forms. Knead lightly, then wrap in cling film and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. For the filling, rinse the dried lentils under cold water. Place them in a saucepan with 500 ml of water and bring to a boil, then simmer for 20-25 minutes until tender. Drain well. While the lentils cook, finely dice the chicken breast, carrot, onion, celery, and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and celery and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and carrot and cook for another 5 minutes. Add the diced chicken and cook until browned on all sides. Stir in the cooked lentils, dried thyme, black pepper, and salt. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring, until everything is well combined and heated through. Allow the filling to cool completely. Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/Gas Mark 6). Divide the chilled pastry into 4 equal portions. On a lightly floured surface, roll out each portion into a circle about 18-20 cm in diameter. Spoon a quarter of the cooled filling onto one half of each pastry circle, leaving a border around the edge. Moisten the edges with water, then fold the other half of the pastry over the filling to create a semi-circle. Crimp the edges firmly with a fork to seal. Place the pasties on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Beat the egg and brush it over the top of each pasty to create an egg wash. Make a small slit in the top of each pasty to allow steam to escape. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is heated through.

title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Pasties
ingredients_json: ["500 g All-purpose flour", "250 g Butter, unsalted, cold, cubed", "150 ml Cold water", "1 tsp Salt", "500 g Brown lentils, dry", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 medium Onions, chopped", "3 cloves Garlic, minced", "2 medium Carrots, diced", "2 medium Parsnips, diced", "200 g Mushrooms, sliced", "10 g Fresh thyme, chopped", "5 g Fresh rosemary, chopped", "1 litre Vegetable stock", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 piece Egg, beaten (for egg wash)"]
instructions: For the pastry, combine the flour and salt in a large bowl. Add the cold cubed butter and rub it into the flour using your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Gradually add the cold water, mixing until a dough forms. Knead briefly on a lightly floured surface, then wrap in cling film and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. While the pastry chills, cook the lentils according to package directions. Drain and set aside. Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the diced carrots and parsnips, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the chopped thyme and rosemary. Add the cooked lentils, vegetable stock, tomato paste, and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the sauce has thickened. Season with black pepper. Taste and add more salt if needed, though the stock and Worcestershire sauce may provide sufficient saltiness. Let the filling cool completely. Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/Gas Mark 6). Divide the chilled pastry into 4 equal portions. On a lightly floured surface, roll out each portion into a circle about 20-25 cm in diameter. Spoon a generous amount of the cooled lentil and vegetable filling onto one half of each pastry circle, leaving a border around the edge. Brush the edge of the pastry with the beaten egg. Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling to create a semi-circle, and press the edges firmly to seal. Crimp the edges with a fork or your fingers. Place the pasties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush the tops with the remaining beaten egg for an egg wash. Cut a small slit in the top of each pasty to allow steam to escape. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and crisp.

title: Lean Turkey and Vegetable Pasties
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey breast, raw, ground", "150 g Onion, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Celery, raw", "50 g Peas, frozen", "20 g Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt", "300 g Whole wheat flour", "150 g Butter, unsalted, chilled", "100 ml Water, cold", "1 piece Egg, raw (for egg wash)"]

Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is heated through.

title: Whole Wheat Chicken and Vegetable Pasties
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "125 g Butter, unsalted, cold", "50 ml Ice water", "300 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "100 g Onion, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Peas, frozen", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt", "1 piece Egg, raw, for egg wash"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius (180 degrees Celsius fan/Gas mark 6). In a large bowl, rub the cold butter into the whole wheat flour with your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Fold the other half of the dough over the filling to create a semi-circle, then crimp the edges firmly with a fork to seal. Place the pasties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush the tops with the remaining beaten egg. Cut a small slit in the top of each pasty to allow steam to escape. title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Pasties
ingredients_json: ["300 g Wholewheat flour", "150 g Butter, cold, unsalted", "75 ml Cold water", "1 g Salt", "200 g Brown lentils, dried", "8 dl Vegetable broth", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow, medium", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Carrots, raw", "150 g Swede, raw", "100 g Celery, raw", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 egg yolk"]

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Ricotta Pierogies with Brown Butter Sage Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Salt", "150 ml Warm water", "500 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "200 g Fresh spinach, cooked and squeezed dry", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 large Egg, raw", "1/4 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "100 g Unsalted butter", "12 leaves Sage, fresh", "1 clove Garlic, minced"]
instructions: For the dough, combine the whole wheat flour and salt in a large bowl. Gradually add the warm water while mixing until a shaggy dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover with a damp cloth and let rest for 30 minutes. While the dough rests, prepare the filling: In a medium bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, squeezed spinach, grated Parmesan cheese, egg, and nutmeg. Mix well until thoroughly combined. For the sauce, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Once melted, add the fresh sage leaves and minced garlic. Cook, swirling the pan occasionally, until the butter turns a golden brown and smells nutty, about 3-5 minutes. Be careful not to burn it. Remove from heat and set aside. To assemble the pierogies, roll out the dough thinly on a floured surface. Use a round cutter (about 3 inches in diameter) to cut out circles. Place about 1 tablespoon of the filling onto the center of each dough circle. Fold the dough over to create a half-moon shape, pressing the edges firmly to seal. Crimp the edges with a fork. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully drop the pierogies into the boiling water, working in batches if necessary. Cook until they float to the surface, about 3-5 minutes. Remove the cooked pierogies with a slotted spoon and transfer them directly to the skillet with the brown butter sage sauce. Gently toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Ricotta Pierogi with Brown Butter Sage Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "120 ml Warm water", "1 tsp Salt", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "250 g Ricotta cheese, low fat", "100 g Fresh spinach, cooked and finely chopped", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1/4 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "1 large Egg, beaten", "100 g Unsalted butter", "10 leaves Fresh sage", "1 clove Garlic, minced"]

Be careful not to burn the butter. Add the boiled pierogi to the brown butter sauce and gently toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Ricotta Pierogi with Sage Butter
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "125 ml Water, warm", "1/2 tsp Salt", "1 large Egg, raw", "250 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "100 g Spinach, fresh, uncooked", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "10 leaves Sage, fresh", "1 tbsp Olive oil"]

Add the fresh sage leaves and cook until the butter is lightly browned and the sage is crispy, about 2-3 minutes. title: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Whole Wheat Pierogi with Sautéed Onions and Sage

title: Spinach and Ricotta Whole Wheat Pierogi with Brown Butter Sage Sauce

title: Whole Wheat Veggie Pizza with Lean Chicken
ingredients_json: ["300 g Whole wheat flour", "150 ml Warm water", "10 g Fresh yeast", "5 g Salt", "15 ml Olive oil", "150 g Tomato sauce, no added sugar", "150 g Chicken breast, cooked, shredded", "100 g Bell pepper, mixed colors, sliced", "75 g Onion, red, sliced", "50 g Mushroom, white, sliced", "50 g Zucchini, sliced", "100 g Mozzarella cheese, part-skim, shredded", "1 g Dried oregano"]
instructions: In a large bowl, dissolve the fresh yeast in the warm water. Add the whole wheat flour, salt, and olive oil. Mix until a cohesive dough forms, then knead on a lightly floured surface for about 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F). Punch down the risen dough and shape it into a pizza base on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a small border for the crust. Distribute the shredded cooked chicken, sliced bell peppers, red onion, mushrooms, and zucchini over the sauce. Sprinkle the shredded mozzarella cheese over the toppings. Dust with dried oregano. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is bubbly and melted.

title: Whole Wheat Veggie Delight Pizza
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "7 g Dry yeast", "150 ml Lukewarm water", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "200 g Tomato passata, unsalted", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 g Dried oregano", "100 g Mozzarella cheese, low-fat", "50 g Bell pepper, red, sliced", "50 g Bell pepper, yellow, sliced", "50 g Onion, red, thinly sliced", "50 g Zucchini, thinly sliced", "20 g Mushrooms, sliced", "10 g Fresh basil leaves, chopped"]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, dry yeast, and salt. Gradually add the lukewarm water and olive oil, mixing until a dough forms. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for about 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size. While the dough is rising, preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F). title: Creamy Polenta with Sautéed Mushrooms and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["150 g Cornmeal, fine", "7 dl Water", "1 dl Milk, low-fat", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "300 g Mushrooms, mixed, sliced", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "150 g Spinach, fresh", "10 g Butter", "Salt, unspecified, to taste", "Black pepper, ground, to taste"]
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil. Gradually whisk in the cornmeal to prevent lumps. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring occasionally, for about 20-25 minutes, or until thickened and creamy. Stir in the milk and Parmesan cheese until melted and well combined. Season with salt and pepper. While the polenta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and tender, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Add the fresh spinach and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Stir in the butter until melted. Season the mushroom and spinach mixture with salt and pepper. Serve the creamy polenta topped with the sautéed mushrooms and spinach.

title: Creamy Polenta with Roasted Mediterranean Vegetables and Feta
ingredients_json: ["150 g Polenta, instant", "7 dl Water", "3 dl Milk, whole, unspecified", "0.5 tsp Salt", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Red onion, medium", "1 piece Bell pepper, red", "1 piece Zucchini", "100 g Cherry tomatoes", "50 g Feta cheese", "1 tbsp Fresh basil, chopped", "0.5 tsp Dried oregano"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Chop the red onion, bell pepper, and zucchini into bite-sized pieces. Halve the cherry tomatoes. Toss the chopped vegetables and cherry tomatoes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, dried oregano, and a pinch of salt and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized. While the vegetables are roasting, prepare the polenta. Bring the water and milk to a boil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Gradually whisk in the polenta and salt, reducing the heat to low. Cook, stirring frequently, for 5-7 minutes, or until thickened and creamy.  Once the polenta is cooked and the vegetables are roasted, spoon the creamy polenta into bowls. Top with the roasted Mediterranean vegetables and crumble feta cheese over the top. Garnish with fresh chopped basil.

title: Creamy Polenta with Roasted Mushrooms and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["150 g Polenta, instant", "7.5 dl Water", "1 dl Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "300 g Mushrooms, mixed, sliced", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "1 sprig Fresh thyme, leaves stripped", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/Gas mark 6). In a large bowl, toss the sliced mushrooms with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, minced garlic, thyme leaves, salt, and pepper. Spread them in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 15-20 minutes, or until tender and slightly browned. While the mushrooms are roasting, bring the water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Gradually whisk in the polenta, ensuring there are no lumps. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring frequently, for 5-7 minutes, or until thickened. Stir in the milk, remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and grated Parmesan cheese until the polenta is creamy and smooth. Season with additional salt and pepper to taste. Serve the creamy polenta immediately, topped with the roasted mushrooms.

title: Creamy Polenta with Sautéed Mushrooms and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["150 g Polenta, instant", "7 dl Water", "3 dl Milk, whole, unspecified", "1 tsp Salt", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "300 g Mushrooms, white, unspecified", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "150 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tbsp Butter, unsalted", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Bring the water and milk to a simmer in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Gradually whisk in the polenta and salt. While the polenta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and tender, about 5-7 minutes. Season the mushroom and spinach mixture with black pepper. Spoon the creamy polenta into serving bowls. Top with the sautéed mushroom and spinach mixture. Serve immediately.

title: Creamy Polenta with Sautéed Mushrooms and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["1.5 dl Polenta, instant", "7 dl Water", "1 dl Milk, whole, unspecified", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "300 g Mushrooms, mixed, sliced", "1 clove Garlic, raw, minced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Spinach, fresh", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
