title: Whole Wheat Chicken and Black Bean Quesadillas with Avocado Salsa
ingredients_json: ["250 g Chicken breast, cooked, shredded", "200 g Black beans, canned, rinsed and drained", "100 g Corn, frozen or canned, drained", "150 g Onion, yellow, finely chopped", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Chili powder", "2 tbsp Coriander, fresh, chopped", "4 whole Wheat tortillas, 20 cm diameter", "100 g Cheese, reduced-fat, shredded", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 unit Avocado, ripe, diced", "1 unit Tomato, ripe, diced", "0.5 unit Red onion, finely diced", "1 unit Lime, juice of", "1 tbsp Cilantro, fresh, chopped", "Salt, to taste", "Black pepper, to taste"]
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic, cumin, and chili powder, and cook for another minute until fragrant. In a bowl, combine the shredded chicken, black beans, corn, cooked onion mixture, chopped coriander, and season with salt and pepper. Divide the filling evenly between two tortillas, spreading it over one half of each. Sprinkle shredded cheese over the filling. Fold the other half of the tortilla over the filling. Cook the quesadillas in a lightly oiled skillet or on a griddle over medium heat for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and the cheese is melted. While the quesadillas are cooking, prepare the salsa by combining the diced avocado, tomato, red onion, lime juice, and chopped cilantro in a small bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Cut the cooked quesadillas into wedges and serve immediately with the avocado salsa.

title: Spicy Black Bean and Corn Whole Wheat Quesadillas
ingredients_json: ["2 large whole wheat tortillas", "200 g black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "100 g corn, frozen or canned, drained", "100 g cheese, Monterey Jack, shredded", "50 g red onion, finely chopped", "1/2 piece jalapeño pepper, seeded and minced", "1 tbsp cilantro, fresh, chopped", "1/2 tsp cumin, ground", "1/4 tsp chili powder", "1 tbsp olive oil"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the rinsed black beans, corn, chopped red onion, minced jalapeño, chopped cilantro, cumin, and chili powder. Mix well to ensure all ingredients are evenly distributed. Lightly brush one side of each whole wheat tortilla with olive oil. Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat. Place one tortilla, oiled side down, in the skillet. Sprinkle half of the shredded Monterey Jack cheese over the tortilla, leaving a small border. Spoon half of the black bean and corn mixture evenly over the cheese. Top with the remaining cheese. Place the second tortilla, oiled side up, on top of the filling. Cook for 3-4 minutes, or until the bottom tortilla is golden brown and the cheese is starting to melt. Carefully flip the quesadilla using a spatula and cook the other side for another 3-4 minutes until golden brown and the cheese is fully melted and gooey. Remove from skillet, let cool slightly, then cut into wedges. Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make the second quesadilla.

title: Spicy Black Bean and Corn Quesadillas with Avocado Crema
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat tortillas", "400 g Black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "150 g Corn kernels, frozen or canned, drained", "100 g Red onion, finely chopped", "1 piece Red bell pepper, finely chopped", "10 g Jalapeno, finely chopped, seeds removed for less heat", "200 g Monterey Jack cheese, shredded", "10 g Olive oil", "5 g Cumin, ground", "3 g Chili powder", "2 g Garlic powder", "1 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper", "150 g Avocado", "50 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "10 ml Lime juice", "5 g Cilantro, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the drained black beans, corn, chopped red onion, bell pepper, and jalapeno. Stir in the cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Set aside.  Warm the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Place one tortilla in the skillet. Sprinkle half of the shredded cheese over one half of the tortilla. Spoon half of the black bean and corn mixture evenly over the cheese. Fold the other half of the tortilla over the filling. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and the cheese is melted and gooey. Remove from skillet and repeat with the remaining tortilla and filling.  While the quesadillas are cooking, prepare the avocado crema. In a small bowl, mash the avocado until smooth. Stir in the Greek yogurt, lime juice, and chopped cilantro until well combined. Season with a pinch of salt if desired. Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve immediately with the avocado crema on the side.

title: Black Bean and Corn Chicken Quesadillas
ingredients_json: ["200 g Chicken fillet, skinless", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Chili powder", "1 dl Canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "1 dl Canned sweetcorn, drained", "100 g Cheese, cheddar, grated", "4 whole Wheat tortillas", "1 dl Salsa, tomato-based", "0.5 dl Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "1 dl Lettuce, shredded"]
instructions: Dice the chicken breast into small cubes and season with cumin and chili powder. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside. In the same skillet, warm the tortillas one at a time for about 30 seconds per side until pliable. Lay a tortilla flat, sprinkle half with grated cheese, then top with cooked chicken, black beans, and corn. Fold the tortilla in half. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling. Return the folded quesadillas to the skillet over medium heat. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and the cheese is melted. Cut each quesadilla in half and serve immediately with salsa and a dollop of Greek yogurt, garnished with shredded lettuce.

title: Spicy Black Bean and Corn Chicken Quesadillas
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Whole wheat tortillas", "200 g Cooked chicken breast, shredded", "100 g Black beans, canned, rinsed and drained", "100 g Corn kernels, frozen or canned", "1 dl Red onion, finely chopped", "1 dl Bell pepper, red, finely chopped", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Chili powder", "0.5 tsp Cumin powder", "100 g Monterey Jack cheese, shredded", "50 g Cheddar cheese, shredded", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 dl Fresh cilantro, chopped"]
instructions: In a medium skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped red onion and bell pepper and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic, chili powder, and cumin powder and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the shredded chicken, black beans, corn kernels, and half of the chopped cilantro. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring to combine. Remove from heat. Lay out the whole wheat tortillas. Sprinkle half of the shredded Monterey Jack and cheddar cheeses onto one half of each tortilla. Spoon the chicken and bean mixture evenly over the cheese. Top with the remaining shredded cheeses and the rest of the cilantro. Fold the tortillas in half. Wipe the skillet clean and place it back over medium heat. Cook each quesadilla for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown and the cheese is melted and gooey. Slice into wedges and serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli with Cherry Tomato Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour, unspecified", "2 large Eggs, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "250 g Ricotta cheese, full fat", "150 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "1 pinch Nutmeg, ground", "300 g Cherry tomatoes", "1 tbsp Balsamic vinegar", "1 tbsp Extra virgin olive oil", "1 sprig Fresh basil"]
instructions: To make the pasta dough, combine the whole wheat flour and a pinch of salt on a clean work surface. Make a well in the center and crack the two eggs into it. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Gradually mix the flour into the eggs with a fork, then use your hands to knead the dough for about 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for at least 30 minutes at room temperature. While the dough rests, prepare the filling. Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, then immediately plunge it into ice water. Squeeze out as much water as possible, then finely chop. In a bowl, mix the ricotta cheese, chopped spinach, grated Parmesan cheese, a pinch of nutmeg, and salt and pepper to taste. For the sauce, heat 1 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add one minced clove of garlic and sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the cherry tomatoes and balsamic vinegar. Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 10-15 minutes, until the tomatoes have softened and burst, creating a sauce. Season with salt and pepper. Roll out the pasta dough thinly using a pasta machine or a rolling pin. Cut out circles or squares. Place a teaspoon of the ricotta filling in the center of each pasta shape. Moisten the edges with water and fold the dough over, pressing firmly to seal and create ravioli. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully add the ravioli and cook for 3-5 minutes, or until they float to the surface. Gently remove the ravioli with a slotted spoon and toss them with the cherry tomato sauce. Garnish with fresh basil leaves before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli with Cherry Tomato Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "2 large Eggs", "50 g Semolina flour", "250 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "150 g Spinach, fresh, baby", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 clove Garlic, unpeeled", "500 g Cherry tomatoes", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "5 g Fresh basil leaves", "1 pinch Salt", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: For the ravioli dough, whisk together the whole wheat flour and semolina flour on a clean surface. Make a well in the center and crack in the two large eggs. Gradually incorporate the flour into the eggs using a fork, then switch to your hands and knead for about 10 minutes until a smooth, elastic dough forms. Cover with cling film and let it rest for 30 minutes. While the dough rests, prepare the filling. Blanch the baby spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds, then immediately refresh in ice water. Squeeze out as much moisture as possible and finely chop. In a bowl, mix the chopped spinach with the part-skim ricotta cheese and grated Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Roll out the rested dough thinly using a pasta machine or a rolling pin. Place small spoonfuls of the ricotta-spinach filling about 2-3 cm apart on one half of the dough sheet. Brush the dough around the filling with a little water. Fold the other half of the dough over the filling and press down gently around each mound of filling to seal, ensuring no air pockets remain. Use a ravioli cutter or a knife to cut out individual ravioli. For the sauce, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the unpeeled garlic clove and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant, then remove and discard the garlic. Add the cherry tomatoes to the pan and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they burst and soften, forming a rustic sauce. Season with salt and pepper. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully add the ravioli and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they float to the surface and the pasta is al dente. Gently remove the cooked ravioli with a slotted spoon and add them to the cherry tomato sauce. Toss gently to coat. Serve immediately, garnished with fresh basil leaves.

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli with Marinara Sauce
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour, unspecified", "2 large Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "100 g Spinach, raw", "250 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "0.5 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "800 g Tomatoes, canned, crushed", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "0.5 tsp Oregano, dried", "0.25 tsp Red pepper flakes, unspecified"]
instructions: For the ravioli dough, combine the whole wheat flour and 2 eggs in a bowl. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and mix until a dough forms. Knead on a lightly floured surface for 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes. While the dough rests, prepare the filling. Finely chop the raw spinach and sauté in a dry pan over medium heat until wilted. Squeeze out any excess water. In a bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, Parmesan cheese, wilted spinach, nutmeg, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Mix well. For the marinara sauce, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add 1 clove of minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in the crushed tomatoes, oregano, and red pepper flakes. Season with salt and pepper. Simmer for at least 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Roll out the ravioli dough very thinly. Place dollops of the ricotta filling onto one sheet of dough, leaving space between them. Cover with another sheet of dough and press around the filling to seal, cutting out the ravioli. Cook the ravioli in boiling salted water for 3-5 minutes, or until they float to the surface and are cooked through. Drain the ravioli and toss gently with the marinara sauce.

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli with Lemon-Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "3 large Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "250 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "150 g Spinach, fresh, raw", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "1 Lemon, zest and juice", "2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh basil, chopped", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "100 ml Vegetable broth", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: For the pasta dough, mound the whole wheat flour on a clean work surface and create a well in the center. Crack the eggs into the well and add the olive oil. Gently whisk the eggs and oil with a fork, gradually incorporating the flour from the sides until a shaggy dough forms. Knead the dough for about 8-10 minutes until it is smooth and elastic. Wrap the dough tightly in plastic wrap and let it rest at room temperature for at least 30 minutes. While the dough rests, prepare the filling. Finely chop the fresh spinach (or blanch and squeeze dry if using frozen). In a medium bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, chopped spinach, grated Parmesan cheese, and a pinch of black pepper. Mix well. Once the dough has rested, divide it into two portions. On a lightly floured surface, roll out each portion of dough very thinly (about 1-2 mm thick) using a pasta machine or a rolling pin. Place small spoonfuls of the ricotta filling about 1 inch apart on one sheet of pasta dough. Brush a little water around each mound of filling. Carefully place the second sheet of pasta dough over the top, pressing down gently around each mound of filling to seal and remove any air pockets. Use a ravioli cutter or a knife to cut out individual ravioli. For the sauce, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. Add the lemon zest, lemon juice, vegetable broth, chopped parsley, and chopped basil to the skillet. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Cook the ravioli in a large pot of boiling salted water for 3-5 minutes, or until they float to the surface and are tender. Carefully remove the cooked ravioli from the water using a slotted spoon and add them directly to the skillet with the sauce. Gently toss the ravioli in the sauce to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Whole Wheat Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli with Lemon-Herb Butter Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "3 large Egg, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1/2 tsp Salt", "250 g Ricotta cheese, part-skim", "150 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1/4 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground", "115 g Unsalted butter", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 Lemon, zest and juice", "2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh basil, chopped"]
instructions: To make the pasta dough, combine the whole wheat flour, 2 of the eggs, olive oil, and salt in a large bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms, then turn it out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for about 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest for at least 30 minutes. While the dough rests, prepare the filling. Finely chop the raw spinach. In a medium bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, chopped spinach, grated Parmesan cheese, nutmeg, the remaining egg, and a pinch of black pepper. Mix well until thoroughly combined.  On a lightly floured surface, roll out the pasta dough into thin sheets, about 1/16 inch thick. Place spoonfuls of the ricotta filling about 1 inch apart on one sheet of dough. Brush the edges around the filling with a little water. Place the second sheet of dough over the top and press down around each mound of filling to seal, removing any air pockets. Cut the ravioli using a ravioli cutter or a knife.  Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Carefully add the ravioli in batches, ensuring not to overcrowd the pot. Cook for 3-5 minutes, or until they float to the surface and are tender. While the ravioli cook, prepare the sauce. In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute, being careful not to burn it. Stir in the lemon zest and lemon juice. Add the chopped parsley and basil. Once the ravioli are cooked, drain them and carefully add them to the skillet with the lemon-herb butter sauce. Toss gently to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Healthy Homestyle Refried Beans with Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g Dried pinto beans, uncooked", "20 dl Water", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 unit Onion, yellow, medium", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 unit Red bell pepper, medium", "1 unit Green bell pepper, medium", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Chili powder", "1 tsp Oregano, dried", "5 dl Vegetable broth", "1 dl Cilantro, fresh, chopped", "1 dl Lime juice, fresh"]
instructions: Rinse the dried pinto beans thoroughly and pick out any stones or debris. Place the rinsed beans in a large bowl and cover with plenty of cold water. Let them soak for at least 8 hours or overnight. Drain and rinse the soaked beans. In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic, diced red bell pepper, and diced green bell pepper, and cook for another 5 minutes until the peppers begin to soften. Stir in the ground cumin, chili powder, and dried oregano, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the drained beans and vegetable broth to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 to 2 hours, or until the beans are very tender. Mash the beans using a potato masher or an immersion blender, leaving some beans whole for texture. Stir in the fresh chopped cilantro and fresh lime juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste (optional, as the broth may be salty). Simmer uncovered for another 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the refried beans reach your desired consistency. Serve hot.

title: Hearty Vegetarian Refried Beans with Roasted Poblano
ingredients_json: ["400 g Dried pinto beans", "2 liters Water", "1 piece Poblano pepper", "1 medium Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 dl Vegetable broth", "1 g Salt", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Rinse the dried pinto beans thoroughly and soak them in plenty of cold water overnight. The next day, drain and rinse the beans again. Place the soaked beans in a large pot and cover with 2 liters of fresh water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for about 1.5 to 2 hours, or until the beans are very tender. While the beans are cooking, preheat your oven broiler or grill. Place the poblano pepper on a baking sheet and broil, turning occasionally, until the skin is blackened and blistered all over. Place the pepper in a bowl, cover tightly with plastic wrap, and let it steam for 10 minutes. Once cooled, peel off the blackened skin, remove the stem and seeds, and finely chop the flesh. Finely chop the onion and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika, and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the chopped poblano pepper. Drain the cooked beans, reserving about 2 dl of the cooking liquid. Add the tender beans to the skillet with the onion and pepper mixture. Mash the beans with a potato masher or the back of a spoon until they reach your desired consistency. Add the reserved bean liquid and the vegetable broth, stirring to combine. Simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring frequently, until the refried beans have thickened. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve hot.

title: Hearty Skillet Refried Beans with Chorizo and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["500 g Dried pinto beans", "2 liters Water", "100 g Chorizo sausage, cured, fatty", "1 unit Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Chili powder", "1 dl Vegetable broth", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 dl Fresh cilantro, chopped", "2 units Avocado, ripe", "2 dl Lime juice, fresh"]
instructions: Rinse the dried pinto beans and soak them overnight in plenty of water. Drain and rinse the beans. Place the beans in a large pot and cover with 2 liters of fresh water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1.5 to 2 hours, or until tender. Drain the beans, reserving about 2 dl of the cooking liquid. While the beans are cooking, dice the chorizo and chop the onion and garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced chorizo and cook until browned and slightly crispy, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chorizo with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving the rendered fat in the skillet. Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic, cumin, and chili powder, and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the cooked beans and the reserved cooking liquid to the skillet. Mash the beans with a potato masher or the back of a fork until they reach your desired consistency. Stir in the cooked chorizo and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through and the flavors meld. Stir in half of the chopped cilantro. For the avocado topping, dice the ripe avocados and toss them with the fresh lime juice and the remaining chopped cilantro. Serve the refried beans hot, topped generously with the avocado mixture.

title: Hearty Vegetarian Refried Beans with Avocado Salsa
ingredients_json: ["500 g Dried pinto beans, soaked overnight", "1.5 l Water", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "150 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Chili powder", "0.25 tsp Cayenne pepper", "1 dl Vegetable broth", "1 Lime, juiced", "150 g Avocado, diced", "50 g Red onion, finely chopped", "30 g Cilantro, chopped", "1 Tomato, medium, diced"]
instructions: Drain the soaked pinto beans and rinse them thoroughly. Place the beans in a large pot and cover with 1.5 liters of fresh water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 to 2 hours, or until the beans are very tender. Drain the beans, reserving about 2 dl of the cooking liquid. While the beans are cooking, heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped yellow onion and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic, cumin, chili powder, and cayenne pepper, and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the cooked beans to the skillet with the onions and spices. Mash the beans using a potato masher or the back of a fork, adding some of the reserved bean liquid or vegetable broth as needed to reach a creamy consistency. Stir in the lime juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste. For the salsa, gently mix the diced avocado, finely chopped red onion, chopped cilantro, and diced tomato in a small bowl. Serve the refried beans warm, topped with the fresh avocado salsa.

title: Hearty Black Bean Refried Beans with Smoky Chipotle
ingredients_json: ["500 g Black beans, dried", "1.5 l Water", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 large Onion, yellow, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Coriander, ground", "1-2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped (adjust to heat preference)", "1 tbsp adobo sauce from can", "100 ml Vegetable broth", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Rinse the dried black beans thoroughly. Place them in a large pot, cover with 1.5 liters of water, and soak overnight or for at least 4 hours. Drain the beans and refill the pot with fresh water, enough to cover the beans by about 5 cm. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 to 2 hours, or until the beans are very tender. Drain the beans, reserving about 200 ml of the cooking liquid. While the beans are cooking, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic, cumin, and coriander, and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the chopped chipotle peppers and adobo sauce. Reduce the heat to medium-low. Add the cooked beans to the skillet along with the reserved cooking liquid and the vegetable broth. Mash the beans with a potato masher or the back of a spoon until they reach your desired consistency. Season with salt and pepper. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, for about 10-15 minutes, or until the refried beans have thickened and are heated through. Adjust seasoning if necessary.

title: Healthy Baked Pork Ribs with Apple Cider Glaze
ingredients_json: ["1.5 kg Pork spare ribs", "1 dl Apple cider vinegar", "0.5 dl Maple syrup", "2 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Garlic powder", "1 tsp Onion powder", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.5 tsp Salt", "2 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 150 degrees Celsius. Pat the pork ribs dry with paper towels. In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, maple syrup, Dijon mustard, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, salt, and olive oil to create the glaze. Place the ribs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Pour half of the glaze over the ribs, ensuring they are evenly coated. Pour the chicken broth into the bottom of the baking pan to create steam. Cover the baking sheet tightly with aluminum foil. Bake for 2.5 to 3 hours, or until the pork is tender and easily pulls away from the bone. Remove the foil, increase the oven temperature to 200 degrees Celsius, and brush the remaining glaze over the ribs. Bake for another 15-20 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized and slightly sticky. Let the ribs rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Slow Cooker Balsamic Glazed Pork Ribs
ingredients_json: ["1500 g Pork spare ribs, trimmed", "1 dl Balsamic vinegar", "0.5 dl Soy sauce, low sodium", "2 tbsp Maple syrup", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 medium Onions, sliced", "2 dl Chicken broth, low sodium"]
instructions: Place the sliced onions on the bottom of your slow cooker. Arrange the pork ribs on top of the onions. In a small bowl, whisk together the balsamic vinegar, soy sauce, maple syrup, minced garlic, smoked paprika, and black pepper. Pour this mixture evenly over the ribs. Add the chicken broth to the slow cooker. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours, or on high for 3-4 hours, until the ribs are tender and cooked through. For a thicker glaze, you can remove the ribs and reduce the cooking liquid on the stovetop for a few minutes. Serve hot.

title: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Pork Ribs with Roasted Sweet Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["1500 g Pork ribs, spare ribs", "100 ml Honey", "100 ml Soy sauce, low sodium", "60 ml Ketchup", "4 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Ginger, grated", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 medium Sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Rosemary, dried"]
instructions: Place the pork ribs in a slow cooker. In a bowl, whisk together honey, soy sauce, ketchup, minced garlic, grated ginger, smoked paprika, and black pepper. Pour the sauce over the ribs, ensuring they are well coated. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours, or on high for 3-4 hours, until the ribs are tender. In the meantime, preheat your oven to 200°C (400°F). Toss the cubed sweet potatoes with olive oil, dried rosemary, and a pinch of salt and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 25-30 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized. Once the ribs are cooked, you can either shred the meat off the bone or serve them whole. If desired, you can broil the ribs for a few minutes to crisp up the edges. Serve the honey garlic ribs alongside the roasted sweet potatoes.

title: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Pork Ribs
ingredients_json: ["1.5 kg Pork ribs, pork loin ribs", "1 dl Soy sauce, low sodium", "0.5 dl Honey", "0.5 dl Ketchup", "2 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tbsp Sesame oil", "2 cloves Garlic, fresh, minced", "1 tsp Ginger, fresh, grated", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Place the pork ribs in your slow cooker. In a medium bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, ketchup, rice vinegar, sesame oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, and black pepper. Pour the sauce evenly over the ribs, ensuring they are well coated. Cover the slow cooker and cook on low for 6-8 hours, or on high for 3-4 hours, until the pork is tender and easily pulls away from the bone. For a slightly caramelized finish, you can transfer the ribs to a baking sheet and broil them for 2-3 minutes under a preheated broiler, watching carefully to prevent burning.

title: Honey-Glazed Pork Ribs with Roasted Sweet Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["1.2 kg Pork spare ribs", "2 medium Sweet potatoes", "1 dl Olive oil", "0.5 dl Honey", "0.3 dl Soy sauce", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Peel and cube the sweet potatoes into bite-sized pieces, toss them with half of the olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet, and roast for 20 minutes. While the potatoes roast, prepare the rib glaze by whisking together honey, soy sauce, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, smoked paprika, and the remaining olive oil in a small bowl. Place the pork ribs on a rack over a baking sheet. Brush generously with half of the honey glaze. Once the sweet potatoes have roasted for 20 minutes, add the ribs to the oven. Continue roasting for another 30-40 minutes, brushing the ribs with the remaining glaze every 10 minutes, until the ribs are cooked through and nicely caramelized. The sweet potatoes should be tender and slightly browned. Serve the ribs immediately with the roasted sweet potatoes.

title: Healthy Chicken and Broccoli Rice Bake
ingredients_json: ["250 g Brown rice, uncooked", "600 ml Vegetable broth", "400 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "300 g Broccoli florets, fresh or frozen", "150 g Low-fat cottage cheese", "100 ml Unsweetened almond milk", "1 clove Garlic, fresh", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "100 g Low-fat cheddar cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (170°C fan/gas mark 5). Rinse the uncooked brown rice under cold water and drain well. In a large oven-safe dish or casserole pan, combine the rinsed rice and vegetable broth. Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 25 minutes, or until the rice is almost tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. While the rice is baking, dice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Mince the garlic. If using fresh broccoli, cut it into small florets. Remove the foil from the rice. Add the diced chicken, broccoli florets, minced garlic, dried oregano, and black pepper to the dish with the rice. Stir everything together to combine. In a separate bowl, whisk together the low-fat cottage cheese and unsweetened almond milk until smooth. Pour this mixture evenly over the rice, chicken, and broccoli. Sprinkle the grated low-fat cheddar cheese over the top. Return the dish to the oven, uncovered, and bake for another 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through, the broccoli is tender, and the cheese is melted and lightly golden. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Rice Bake
ingredients_json: ["200 g Basmati rice, uncooked", "400 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 dl Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 pc Red bell pepper, raw", "1 dl Cherry tomatoes", "1 dl Kalamata olives, pitted", "1 dl Feta cheese, low fat", "2 dl Vegetable broth", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 dl Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Cook the basmati rice according to package directions, then set aside. While the rice is cooking, dice the chicken fillet into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet or casserole dish over medium-high heat. Add the diced chicken and cook until lightly browned. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. Add the finely chopped onion and minced garlic to the same skillet and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Chop the red bell pepper into small pieces and add it to the skillet along with the cherry tomatoes, halved, and the pitted Kalamata olives. Cook for another 5 minutes until the vegetables are slightly tender. Stir in the cooked basmati rice, the browned chicken, vegetable broth, dried oregano, and black pepper. Mix everything well. Crumble the feta cheese over the top and bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving.

title: Creamy Chicken and Broccoli Rice Casserole
ingredients_json: ["250 g Brown rice, uncooked", "1 liter Chicken broth, low sodium", "400 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "300 g Broccoli florets, fresh or frozen", "200 g Mushroom, button, sliced", "100 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "30 g Olive oil", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "50 g Cream cheese, light", "30 g Grated cheese, low-fat cheddar", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish)"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). Cook the brown rice according to package directions, using low-sodium chicken broth instead of water. While the rice is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until browned, another 5-7 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces, to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides. Stir in the broccoli florets, thyme, and black pepper. Once the rice is cooked, stir it into the skillet with the chicken and vegetables. In a small bowl, whisk together the semi-skimmed milk and light cream cheese until smooth. Pour this mixture over the rice and chicken, stirring to combine everything evenly. Sprinkle the grated cheese over the top. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the casserole is bubbly and the cheese is melted and lightly golden. Let it rest for 5 minutes before garnishing with fresh parsley and serving.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken and Brown Rice Casserole
ingredients_json: ["250 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "200 g Brown rice, uncooked", "7 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 dl Onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 dl Broccoli florets, frozen", "0.5 dl Parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "0.5 tsp Dried thyme", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2%", "50 g Cheese, mozzarella, shredded, part-skim"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C. Cook the brown rice according to package directions. While the rice cooks, dice the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with dried thyme and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. Add the chopped onion to the same skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the cooked brown rice, chicken broth, and frozen broccoli florets. Bring to a simmer. Return the browned chicken to the skillet. Stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice. Top the mixture with dollops of Greek yogurt and sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese over the top. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the casserole is heated through.

title: One-Pan Lemon Herb Chicken and Broccoli Rice Casserole
ingredients_json: ["250 g Brown rice, uncooked", "500 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow, medium", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "400 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "300 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "1 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "2 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tsp Thyme, dried", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "0.25 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius. Cook the brown rice according to package directions, but slightly undercook it (about 5-10 minutes less than recommended). While the rice is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and add them to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned on all sides. Stir in the undercooked brown rice, broccoli florets, low-sodium chicken broth, semi-skimmed milk, fresh lemon juice, chopped parsley, dried thyme, black pepper, and salt. Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the skillet tightly with a lid or aluminum foil. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is fully cooked, the chicken is cooked through, and the broccoli is tender. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Pilaf with Chickpeas and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["2 dl Quinoa, white, dry", "4 dl Vegetable broth, low sodium", "1 tbsp Olive oil, extra virgin", "150 g Red onion, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "200 g Bell pepper, red, diced", "150 g Zucchini, diced", "400 g Chickpeas, canned, drained and rinsed", "50 g Kalamata olives, pitted and halved", "30 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "2 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "5 g Salt"]
instructions: Rinse the quinoa thoroughly under cold water and drain well. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped red onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the diced bell pepper and zucchini and cook for 5-7 minutes, until they begin to soften. Stir in the rinsed quinoa and toast for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly. Pour in the vegetable broth, add the drained chickpeas, dried oregano, salt, and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the quinoa is cooked and the liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat and let it stand, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff the pilaf with a fork, then stir in the halved Kalamata olives, chopped fresh parsley, and fresh lemon juice. Serve hot.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken and Vegetable Rice Pilaf
ingredients_json: ["200 g Basmati rice", "400 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "150 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless, cut into 1 cm cubes", "1 medium Carrot, diced", "100 g Green beans, fresh, trimmed and chopped", "50 g Peas, frozen", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Dried thyme", "Zest of 1 lemon", "2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped", "Salt, to taste", "Black pepper, freshly ground, to taste"]
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until the water runs clear. In a medium saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the cubed chicken breast and cook until lightly browned on all sides. Stir in the diced carrot and chopped green beans and cook for 2-3 minutes. Add the rinsed rice to the saucepan and stir to combine with the vegetables and chicken. Pour in the low-sodium chicken broth and add the dried oregano, dried thyme, and lemon zest. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan tightly, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender. Stir in the frozen peas during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Once cooked, let the pilaf stand, covered, for 5 minutes off the heat. Fluff the rice with a fork, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste, and stir in the fresh chopped parsley before serving.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken and Vegetable Rice Pilaf
ingredients_json: ["250 g Basmati rice, uncooked", "500 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow, small, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "200 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless, diced", "150 g Broccoli florets, fresh or frozen", "100 g Carrots, diced", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until the water runs clear, then drain well. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan or pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. title: Lemon Herb Asparagus Risotto with Pan-Seared Chicken
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "300 g Arborio rice", "150 ml White wine, dry", "1.2 liter Chicken broth, low sodium", "200 g Asparagus, fresh", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tbsp Lemon zest", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "10 g Butter"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the finely chopped onion to the same pan and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the Arborio rice and toast it for 1-2 minutes, ensuring each grain is coated with oil and slightly translucent. Pour in the white wine and stir until it's completely absorbed. title: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Risotto with Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["1.5 l Vegetable broth", "30 g Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "300 g Arborio rice", "150 ml Dry white wine", "250 g Mushrooms, raw", "150 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Parmesan cheese, hard", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Salt"]
instructions: Warm the vegetable broth in a saucepan and keep it simmering over low heat. Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the Arborio rice to the pan and toast it for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the grains are slightly translucent around the edges. Pour in the white wine and stir until it has been completely absorbed by the rice. Begin adding the simmering vegetable broth, one ladleful at a time, stirring frequently. Wait until each addition of broth is almost completely absorbed before adding the next. Continue this process for about 18-20 minutes, or until the rice is creamy and al dente. While the risotto is cooking, sauté the sliced mushrooms in a separate pan with a little olive oil until golden brown. In the last 5 minutes of cooking the risotto, stir in the sautéed mushrooms and the fresh spinach, cooking until the spinach has wilted. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the grated Parmesan cheese, unsalted butter, salt, and pepper. Stir vigorously for about a minute to emulsify the fats and create a creamy texture. Let the risotto rest for 1-2 minutes before serving.

title: Mushroom and Asparagus Risotto with Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["30 g Olive oil", "200 g Onion, brown, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "300 g Arborio rice", "150 ml Dry white wine", "1.2 l Vegetable broth, low sodium", "200 g Mushrooms, white, raw", "200 g Asparagus, raw", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "2 sprigs Parsley, fresh"]

title: Mushroom and Spinach Risotto with Lemon Zest

title: Lean Turkey Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy and Mashed Cauliflower
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, extra lean", "50 g Onion, raw", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "30 g Egg, raw", "30 g Oats, rolled", "15 ml Worcestershire sauce", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "15 ml Olive oil", "150 g Mushrooms, white", "2 dl Low-sodium beef broth", "15 ml Cornstarch", "10 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "500 g Cauliflower florets, raw", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g Butter, unsalted", "Salt, table, to taste", "Black pepper, ground, to taste"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the turkey mince, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, egg, rolled oats, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are softened and browned, about 5-7 minutes. Sprinkle the cornstarch over the mushrooms and stir well to coat. Gradually whisk in the low-sodium beef broth, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the gravy has thickened. Return the turkey patties to the skillet, nestling them into the gravy. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the patties are cooked through. title: Mediterranean Grilled Chicken and Hummus Sandwich

Mash the ripe avocado in another small bowl. Spread the mashed avocado evenly onto one slice of the toasted bread. Layer the fresh spinach leaves over the avocado. Thinly slice the red onion and place it on top of the spinach. Slice the cooked turkey breast and arrange it over the red onion. Spread the prepared yogurt-mustard mixture onto the other slice of toasted bread and place it on top to complete the sandwich. Slice the sandwich in half if desired and serve immediately.

title: Mediterranean Grilled Chicken and Veggie Wrap
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "0.25 tsp Black pepper", "4 whole Wheat tortillas", "100 g Mixed greens", "1 dl Cucumber, chopped", "1 dl Red bell pepper, chopped", "0.5 dl Red onion, thinly sliced", "50 g Feta cheese, crumbled", "2 tbsp Hummus"]
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or outdoor grill to medium-high heat. In a bowl, toss the chicken breast with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, oregano, garlic powder, and black pepper. Grill the chicken for about 6-8 minutes per side, or until cooked through and no longer pink in the center. Let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly. While the chicken is grilling, warm the tortillas slightly on the grill or in a dry skillet until pliable. In a separate bowl, combine the mixed greens, cucumber, red bell pepper, and red onion. To assemble the wraps, spread 1 tablespoon of hummus evenly over each tortilla. Top with a portion of the mixed greens and vegetables, followed by sliced grilled chicken and crumbled feta cheese. Fold in the sides of the tortilla and then roll it up tightly from the bottom to create a wrap. Serve immediately.

title: Hearty Sausage and Lentil Stew with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g Pork sausage, lean", "200 g Brown lentils, dried", "150 g Onion, brown", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Carrot, raw", "200 g Parsnip, raw", "100 g Celery, stalk, raw", "1 dl Tomato puree, unsweetened", "1.5 l Vegetable broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "5 g Salt"]
instructions: Remove the sausage meat from its casings and break it into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the sausage meat and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned. Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside, leaving any rendered fat in the pot. Add the chopped onion, carrots, parsnips, and celery to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, for about 8-10 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the tomato puree, dried thyme, and dried rosemary, cooking for 1-2 minutes. Rinse the dried lentils under cold water and add them to the pot along with the vegetable broth and the browned sausage. Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45-60 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the vegetables are cooked through. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Stir well before serving.

title: Spicy Italian Sausage and White Bean Skillet with Kale
ingredients_json: ["400 g Italian sausage, spicy, raw", "1 dl Olive oil, extra virgin", "2 dl Onion, yellow, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 g Red pepper flakes", "800 g White beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "200 g Kale, fresh, stems removed", "2 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 dl Parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Remove the sausage meat from the casings and crumble it into a large skillet. Cook over medium-high heat, breaking up the meat with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside, leaving the drippings in the pan. Add the olive oil to the skillet if needed. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Add the drained and rinsed white beans, kale, and chicken broth to the skillet. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook for 10 minutes, or until the kale is wilted and tender. Stir the cooked sausage back into the skillet. Cook for another 2-3 minutes to heat through. Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese just before serving.

title: Hearty Lentil and Sausage Casserole with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["400 g Pork sausage, raw", "200 g Lentils, brown, dry", "150 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 medium Carrots", "1 large Parsnip", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "8 dl Vegetable broth", "2 dl Crushed tomatoes, canned", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "0.5 tsp Dried rosemary", "Salt, to taste", "Black pepper, ground, to taste"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Remove the sausage meat from its casings and crumble it into a large, oven-safe pot or Dutch oven. Cook over medium-high heat, breaking up the meat with a spoon, until browned. Remove the sausage meat and set aside, leaving the rendered fat in the pot. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil to the pot if needed. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Mince the garlic and add it to the pot, cooking for another minute until fragrant. Peel and dice the carrots and parsnip into bite-sized pieces. Add them to the pot with the onions and garlic and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften slightly. Stir in the rinsed dry lentils, browned sausage meat, vegetable broth, crushed tomatoes, dried thyme, and dried rosemary. Season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer on the stovetop, then cover the pot tightly with a lid. Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 45-60 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and the vegetables are cooked through. Stir occasionally during baking to prevent sticking. Adjust seasoning to taste before serving.

title: Hearty Sausage and Lentil Casserole with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g Pork sausages, unsmoked", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 large Onions, yellow, chopped", "4 cloves Garlic, unpeeled, crushed", "3 medium Carrots, peeled and diced", "2 parsnips, peeled and diced", "1 dl Red wine", "800 g Chopped tomatoes, canned", "5 dl Vegetable broth", "250 g Brown lentils, dried", "2 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "Salt, to taste", "Black pepper, to taste", "200 g Kale, destemmed and chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (160°C fan/Gas Mark 4). Remove the sausages from their casings and break them up into a large, oven-safe casserole dish. Add the olive oil and place over medium-high heat on the stovetop. Cook the sausage meat, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned all over. Remove the browned sausage meat and set aside, leaving the rendered fat in the dish. Add the chopped onions and cook for about 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly golden. Add the crushed garlic cloves, diced carrots, and diced parsnips, and cook for another 5 minutes until slightly tender. Pour in the red wine and let it bubble and reduce by half, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the dish. Return the browned sausage meat to the dish. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, vegetable broth, dried lentils, dried thyme, and smoked paprika. Season with salt and pepper. Bring the mixture to a simmer on the stovetop, then cover the casserole dish with a lid or foil. Transfer to the preheated oven and bake for 40-50 minutes, or until the lentils and vegetables are tender and the liquid has mostly been absorbed. Stir in the chopped kale during the last 10 minutes of cooking until wilted. Check seasoning before serving.

title: Hearty Lentil and Smoked Sausage Stew
ingredients_json: ["400 g Smoked sausage, pork", "200 g Lentils, brown, dried", "1 dl Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 medium Carrots, raw", "2 stalks Celery, raw", "1.5 l Vegetable broth", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 pinch Salt"]
instructions: Rinse the dried lentils thoroughly under cold water. Chop the smoked sausage into bite-sized pieces. Finely dice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the carrots and celery. Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the sausage pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the sausage with a slotted spoon and set aside. Add the diced onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until softened, about 8-10 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Return the sausage to the pot. Add the rinsed lentils, vegetable broth, dried thyme, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 45-60 minutes, or until the lentils are tender. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed. Serve hot.

title: Hearty Seitan Stew with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g Seitan, plain", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 large Onions, yellow, chopped", "4 cloves Garlic, minced", "3 Carrots, medium, peeled and chopped", "2 Parsnips, medium, peeled and chopped", "300 g Potatoes, waxy, peeled and cubed", "1 dl Red wine, dry", "8 dl Vegetable broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "1 Bay leaf", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "Salt, to taste", "Black pepper, freshly ground, to taste", "2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the seitan and brown it on all sides, working in batches if necessary, then remove from the pot and set aside. Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until softened and lightly browned, about 8-10 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the chopped carrots, parsnips, and cubed potatoes to the pot. Pour in the red wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Let the wine simmer and reduce for about 5 minutes. Return the browned seitan to the pot. Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, thyme, rosemary, and bay leaf. Stir everything to combine. Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for at least 45-60 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the seitan has absorbed the flavors. Stir in the soy sauce. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Remove the bay leaf before serving. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley.

title: Spicy Seitan Stir-fry with Mixed Vegetables and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g Seitan, firm, cut into strips", "150 g Brown rice, uncooked", "2 dl Water", "1 tbsp Sesame oil", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Cornstarch", "1 dl Broccoli florets", "1 dl Carrot, sliced diagonally", "1 dl Bell pepper, red, sliced", "1 dl Snow peas, trimmed", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 piece Ginger, fresh, grated (approx. 1 cm)", "1/2 tsp Red pepper flakes", "1 tbsp Olive oil"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to package directions. While the rice is cooking, prepare the seitan. In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and cornstarch until smooth. Add the seitan strips to the bowl and toss to coat. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the coated seitan and stir-fry for about 5-7 minutes, until lightly browned and heated through. Remove the seitan from the skillet and set aside. Add the sesame oil to the same skillet. Add the minced garlic, grated ginger, and red pepper flakes, and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the broccoli, carrot, bell pepper, and snow peas to the skillet. Stir-fry the vegetables for 5-7 minutes, until they are tender-crisp. Return the seitan to the skillet with the vegetables. Stir everything together to combine and heat through. Serve the spicy seitan stir-fry immediately over the cooked brown rice.

title: Spicy Seitan Stir-Fry with Mixed Vegetables and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g Seitan, firm, unsweetened", "1 dl Soy sauce, light", "2 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tbsp Maple syrup", "1 tsp Sriracha sauce", "1 piece Garlic, fresh, peeled", "1 piece Ginger, fresh, peeled", "2 tbsp Sesame oil", "1 dl Broccoli florets, raw", "1 dl Carrot, raw, cut into matchsticks", "1 dl Bell pepper, red, raw, sliced", "1 dl Snow peas, raw", "1 dl Onion, yellow, raw, sliced", "1 dl Mushrooms, white, raw, sliced", "2 dl Brown rice, cooked"]
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, and sriracha sauce. Finely mince the garlic and ginger, then add them to the sauce mixture. Cut the seitan into bite-sized pieces. Heat 1 tbsp of sesame oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the seitan and stir-fry until lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the seitan from the wok and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tbsp of sesame oil to the wok. Add the broccoli, carrots, bell pepper, snow peas, onion, and mushrooms. Stir-fry for 5-8 minutes, until the vegetables are tender-crisp. Return the seitan to the wok. Pour the sauce mixture over the seitan and vegetables. Stir well to coat everything. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly. Serve the stir-fry hot over cooked brown rice.

title: Hearty Seitan Stew with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["400 g Seitan, natural", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 large Onion, yellow, unspecified", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 medium Carrots, raw", "2 medium Parsnips, raw", "1 medium Celeriac, raw", "1 litre Vegetable broth, low sodium", "200 ml Red wine, dry", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "2 Bay leaves", "Salt, sea salt", "Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cut the seitan into bite-sized cubes. Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the seitan cubes in batches until golden brown on all sides, then remove and set aside. Add the chopped onion to the pot and sauté until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly. Add the peeled and diced carrots, parsnips, and celeriac to the pot. Pour in the vegetable broth and red wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Return the browned seitan to the pot along with the dried thyme, rosemary, and bay leaves. Bring the stew to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and let it cook for at least 45 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the flavors have melded. Season generously with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste. Remove the bay leaves before serving.

title: Spicy Seitan Stir-Fry with Mixed Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["400 g Seitan, plain, cut into strips", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "1 tsp Cornstarch", "2 tbsp Peanut oil", "1 medium Onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Ginger, fresh, grated", "1 medium Red bell pepper, sliced", "1 medium Broccoli, florets", "1 medium Carrot, julienned", "1 dl Snap peas", "50 ml Vegetable broth", "1/2 tsp Red pepper flakes"]
instructions: In a bowl, combine the seitan strips with soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and cornstarch. Toss to coat evenly and let it marinate for at least 10 minutes. Heat the peanut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the marinated seitan and stir-fry until browned and slightly crispy, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the seitan from the skillet and set aside. Add the chopped onion to the skillet and stir-fry until softened, about 2-3 minutes. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the sliced red bell pepper, broccoli florets, julienned carrot, and snap peas to the skillet. Stir-fry the vegetables for about 5-7 minutes, until they are tender-crisp. Pour in the vegetable broth and add the red pepper flakes. Bring to a simmer and cook for 1-2 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken slightly. Return the seitan to the skillet and toss everything together to coat with the sauce. Cook for another minute to heat through. Serve hot.

title: Lentil and Vegetable Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Topping
ingredients_json: ["500 g Lentils, brown, dry", "1.5 l Vegetable broth", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Onion, brown, chopped", "200 g Carrot, chopped", "200 g Celery stalk, chopped", "100 g Mushroom, button, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "200 ml Red wine, dry", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, dark", "30 g Parsley, fresh, chopped", "800 g Sweet potato, peeled and cubed", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "1/2 tsp Salt", "1/4 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions:
Rinse the brown lentils thoroughly. In a large pot or Dutch oven, combine the rinsed lentils and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes, or until lentils are tender. Drain any excess liquid. 
 While the lentils are simmering, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened. Add the chopped mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes until browned. Stir in the minced garlic, tomato paste, dried thyme, and dried rosemary, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 
 Pour in the dry red wine and scrape the bottom of the skillet to loosen any browned bits. Let it simmer and reduce by half, about 5 minutes. Stir in the cooked lentils, dark soy sauce, and chopped fresh parsley. Season with salt and pepper to taste. 
 Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). 
 While the filling simmers, place the cubed sweet potatoes in a pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain well. Return the sweet potatoes to the pot and mash them with the milk, butter, salt, and pepper until smooth and creamy. 
 Pour the lentil and vegetable mixture into a large ovenproof dish. Spread the mashed sweet potato evenly over the top. Use a fork to create ridges on the surface for extra crispiness. 
 Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Let it rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.

title: Lean Turkey and Vegetable Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Topping
ingredients_json: ["750 g Sweet potatoes, raw", "100 g Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "1 pinch Salt, table", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground", "700 g Turkey mince, raw, unspecified", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 large Onions, raw", "4 Carrots, raw", "2 Celery stalks, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "150 g Peas, frozen", "150 g Corn kernels, frozen", "30 g Tomato purée", "5 dl Vegetable broth, low sodium", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "2 tbsp Fresh thyme leaves, chopped", "1 tbsp Fresh rosemary leaves, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200 degrees Celsius (180 degrees Celsius fan/Gas mark 6). Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 3cm chunks. Place them in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to the boil. Cook for 15-20 minutes, or until tender. Drain thoroughly and return to the pot. Add the milk, butter, salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth and creamy, then set aside. While the sweet potatoes are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large ovenproof frying pan or casserole dish over medium-high heat. Add the turkey mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned. Remove the mince from the pan and set aside. Add the chopped onions, carrots, and celery to the same pan and cook for 8-10 minutes, until softened. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the tomato purée and cook for 1 minute. Return the browned turkey mince to the pan. Add the vegetable broth, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, and rosemary. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat and cook for 10 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly. Stir in the frozen peas and corn. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Spread the turkey and vegetable mixture evenly in the bottom of your ovenproof dish (if not already cooked in one). Spoon the mashed sweet potato evenly over the top, sealing the edges. Roughen the surface with a fork to create texture. Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Mash
ingredients_json: ["200 g Brown lentils, dried", "1 l Vegetable broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, yellow, chopped", "2 medium Carrots, diced", "2 stalks Celery, diced", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "150 g Mushrooms, white, sliced", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "500 g Sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed", "50 ml Unsweetened almond milk", "1 tbsp Nutritional yeast", "1/2 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1/4 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Rinse the dried lentils thoroughly. In a large pot or Dutch oven, combine the rinsed lentils and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered for 25-30 minutes, or until lentils are tender. Drain any excess liquid. While the lentils are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, diced carrots, and diced celery. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes until the vegetables have softened. Add the minced garlic and sliced mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes until the mushrooms have released their liquid and started to brown. Stir in the dried thyme, dried rosemary, tomato paste, and soy sauce. Cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Add the cooked lentils to the skillet with the vegetables and stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper to taste. In a separate pot, boil the cubed sweet potatoes in water until very tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain the sweet potatoes well. Mash them with the almond milk and nutritional yeast until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper. Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). Spoon the lentil and vegetable mixture into a baking dish. Spread the sweet potato mash evenly over the top of the lentil mixture. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the topping is lightly golden and the filling is bubbling around the edges.

title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Topping
ingredients_json: ["500 g Sweet potato, raw", "100 ml Milk, whole, unspecified", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "1 tsp Salt, table", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 large Carrots, raw", "2 stalks Celery, raw", "1 large Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "300 g Lentils, brown, dry", "750 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "1 dl Frozen peas, unspecified"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C. Peel and chop the sweet potatoes into roughly equal chunks. Place them in a pot, cover with cold water, add 0.5 tsp of salt, and bring to a boil. Cook for 15-20 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain the sweet potatoes well, return them to the pot, and mash them with the milk, butter, remaining 0.5 tsp salt, and black pepper until smooth and creamy. Set aside. While the sweet potatoes are cooking, finely dice the carrots, celery, and onion. Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pan or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced vegetables and cook, stirring occasionally, for about 8-10 minutes, until softened. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Stir in the dry lentils, tomato paste, thyme, and rosemary. Pour in the vegetable broth, bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for 30-40 minutes, or until the lentils are tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Stir in the frozen peas and cook for another 5 minutes. If the mixture is too wet, let it simmer uncovered for a few minutes to thicken. Spoon the lentil and vegetable filling into a baking dish (if your pan isn't oven-safe). Spread the mashed sweet potato evenly over the top of the filling, ensuring it reaches the edges to seal. You can create a decorative pattern with a fork if desired. Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hearty Lentil and Vegetable Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Topping
ingredients_json: ["200 g Green lentils, dried", "1.5 l Water", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 medium Onions, yellow, chopped", "3 Carrots, medium, chopped", "2 Celery stalks, chopped", "3 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 dl Red wine, dry", "800 g Chopped tomatoes, canned", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "2 tbsp Soy sauce", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "500 g Sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "1 dl Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 pinch Nutmeg, ground", "25 g Parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions:
Rinse the dried green lentils thoroughly under cold water. In a large pot, combine the lentils with 1.5 liters of water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes, or until tender. Drain any excess water and set aside.

While the lentils are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the chopped onions, carrots, and celery. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes until softened. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.

Pour in the red wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Let it simmer for 2-3 minutes until most of the liquid has evaporated.

Stir in the chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, soy sauce, dried thyme, and dried rosemary. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for at least 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, allowing the flavors to meld. If the mixture becomes too thick, add a splash of water.

Meanwhile, cook the cubed sweet potatoes in boiling salted water for 15-20 minutes, or until very tender. Drain well. Mash the sweet potatoes with butter and milk until smooth. Season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg.

Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/Gas Mark 6). Stir the cooked lentils into the vegetable and tomato mixture in the skillet. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary. Spread the mashed sweet potato evenly over the lentil mixture.

Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving.

title: Creamy Cajun Shrimp and Grits with Bell Peppers
ingredients_json: ["2 dl Water", "2 dl Milk, low fat, 1.5% fat", "1 dl Corn grits, coarse", "0.5 tsp Salt", "2 tbsp Butter, unsalted", "200 g Shrimp, peeled and deveined", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 clove Garlic, minced", "1 dl Onion, yellow, chopped", "1 dl Bell pepper, red, chopped", "1 dl Bell pepper, green, chopped", "1 tsp Cajun seasoning", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Bring water and milk to a boil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Gradually whisk in the corn grits and 0.25 tsp salt. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer, whisking occasionally, until thickened, about 20-25 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp butter and the remaining 0.25 tsp salt. Keep warm. While grits are cooking, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and cook for 1-2 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through. Remove shrimp from skillet and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tbsp butter to the skillet. Add onion and bell peppers and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in minced garlic and Cajun seasoning and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Return the shrimp to the skillet and stir to coat with the vegetable mixture. Cook for 1-2 minutes to heat through. Spoon the grits into serving bowls. Top with the shrimp and vegetable mixture. Garnish with fresh parsley.

title: Creamy Cajun Shrimp and Grits with Smoked Gouda
ingredients_json: ["2 dl Stone-ground corn grits", "1 dl Milk, whole, unspecified", "6 dl Water", "1 tsp Salt, table", "100 g Butter, unsalted", "200 g Smoked Gouda cheese, grated", "400 g Shrimp, peeled and deveined", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow, medium, chopped", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, minced", "1 dl Bell pepper, red, chopped", "1 dl Celery, raw, chopped", "1 tsp Cajun seasoning", "1 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "50 g Parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Bring 6 dl of water and 1 dl of milk to a boil in a medium saucepan. Gradually whisk in the grits and 1/2 tsp of salt. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened and tender. Stir in 50 g of butter and 100 g of grated smoked gouda cheese until melted and smooth. Keep warm. While the grits are cooking, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the shrimp and cook for 1-2 minutes per side until pink and opaque. Remove shrimp from skillet and set aside. Add 50 g of butter to the same skillet. Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and celery and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and Cajun seasoning and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Pour in 1 dl of chicken broth and bring to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Return the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until heated through and coated in the sauce. Stir in the remaining 100 g of grated smoked gouda cheese and chopped parsley. To serve, spoon the creamy grits into bowls and top with the shrimp and sauce mixture.

title: Creamy Cajun Shrimp and Grits with Smoked Gouda
ingredients_json: ["2 dl Water", "4 dl Milk, whole, unspecified", "1.5 dl Corn grits, coarse", "0.5 tsp Salt, refined", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp Butter, unsalted", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw, 100 g", "2 cloves Garlic, raw, 10 g", "400 g Shrimp, raw, peeled, deveined", "1.5 tsp Cajun seasoning", "1 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 dl Cream, whipping", "50 g Gouda cheese, smoked, grated", "1 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped"]

ingredients_json: ["320 g Spaghetti, whole wheat", "400 g Turkey breast, lean, minced", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Carrots, raw", "150 g Celery, raw", "400 g Tomatoes, canned, crushed", "200 ml Vegetable broth, low sodium", "1 tsp Oregano, dried", "1/2 tsp Basil, dried", "Salt, iodized", "Black pepper, ground"]

title: One-Pan Chicken and Chorizo Spanish Rice
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp Olive oil", "300 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "150 g Chorizo sausage, cured", "1 large Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 red Bell pepper", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Cumin, ground", "250 g Arborio rice", "8 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 dl White wine, dry", "1 can (400 g) Diced tomatoes, unsalted", "50 g Peas, frozen", "1 Lemon", "30 g Fresh parsley"]

Slice the chorizo into rounds and add them to the skillet, cooking until slightly crisped and the fat has rendered, about 3-4 minutes. Remove the chorizo and set aside with the chicken. Dice the onion, mince the garlic, and chop the bell pepper. Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, and cumin, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the Arborio rice to the skillet and stir to coat it with the oil and spices, toasting for about 2 minutes. Pour in the dry white wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Let it simmer until the wine has mostly evaporated. Add the low-sodium chicken broth and the can of diced tomatoes, stirring to combine. Bring the mixture to a simmer. Return the browned chicken and chorizo to the skillet, nestling them into the rice mixture. Cover the skillet tightly with a lid or foil and transfer it to the preheated oven. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Stir in the frozen peas during the last 5 minutes of baking. Once cooked, remove from the oven and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff the rice with a fork. Garnish generously with chopped fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges on the side.

title: Healthy Chicken and Vegetable Spanish Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "200 g Brown rice", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 large Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 Red bell pepper, raw", "1 Green bell pepper, raw", "400 g Tomatoes, chopped, canned", "500 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Dried oregano", "100 g Peas, frozen", "50 g Cilantro, fresh", "1 Lime, juice"]
