Mince the garlic and chop the bell peppers. Add the garlic, red bell pepper, and green bell pepper to the skillet and cook for another 5-7 minutes until the peppers are tender-crisp. Stir in the brown rice, cumin, smoked paprika, and oregano. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until fragrant. Pour in the canned tomatoes and chicken broth, and bring to a simmer. Return the browned chicken to the skillet. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30-40 minutes, or until the rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Stir in the frozen peas during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Remove from heat, stir in the fresh cilantro and lime juice. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hearty Chicken and Chorizo Spanish Rice
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp Olive oil", "200 g Chicken thigh, boneless, skinless", "100 g Chorizo, cured, semi-dry", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Red bell pepper", "1 piece Green bell pepper", "200 g Rice, short-grain, uncooked", "7 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.25 tsp Saffron threads", "100 g Peas, frozen", "50 g Olives, green, pitted", "2 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped"]

Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. Add the chorizo slices to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes until slightly rendered. Remove the chorizo and set aside with the chicken. Add the chopped onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Stir in the uncooked rice and toast for 1-2 minutes, ensuring it's coated in the oil and vegetable mixture. Pour in the chicken broth and stir in the smoked paprika, cumin, and saffron threads. Bring the mixture to a simmer, then return the browned chicken and chorizo to the pan. Stir everything together, ensuring the rice is mostly submerged. Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan tightly, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Do not stir during this time. Stir in the frozen peas and pitted olives during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Once the rice is cooked, remove from heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff the rice with a fork and garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving.

title: One-Pan Chicken and Chorizo Spanish Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "150 g Chorizo sausage, raw, cured", "200 g Long-grain rice", "1 large Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 red Bell pepper", "1 green Bell pepper", "400 g Chopped tomatoes, canned", "500 ml Chicken broth, low sodium", "100 ml Dry white wine", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Turmeric, ground", "1 Bay leaf", "50 g Peas, frozen", "2 tbsp Fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Remove the casing from the chorizo and slice or crumble it. Dice the onion and bell peppers. Mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large, oven-safe skillet or paella pan over medium-high heat. Add the chorizo and cook until it renders some of its fat and becomes slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove the chorizo with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving the rendered fat in the pan. Add the chicken pieces to the pan and brown them on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove the chicken and set aside with the chorizo. Add the diced onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook until softened, about 8-10 minutes. Pour in the white wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Let it bubble and reduce for about 2 minutes. Add the chopped tomatoes, chicken broth, and bay leaf. Bring the mixture to a simmer. Return the chicken and chorizo to the pan. Stir everything together. Season with salt and pepper if needed (chorizo and broth can be salty). Cover the pan tightly with foil or a lid and transfer it to a preheated oven at 190°C (375°F). Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Stir in the frozen peas during the last 5 minutes of baking. Once cooked, let the Spanish rice rest for 5 minutes, covered. Remove the bay leaf and fluff the rice gently with a fork. Garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving.

title: Hearty Chicken and Chorizo Spanish Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken thigh, boneless and skinless", "150 g Chorizo sausage, cured", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 large Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 Red bell pepper", "1 Green bell pepper", "200 g Rice, long-grain, uncooked", "6 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Cumin, ground", "1 dl Frozen peas", "50 g Fresh parsley, chopped", "1 Lemon, juice of"]

title: Hearty Ham and Split Pea Soup
ingredients_json: ["400 g Split peas, green, dried", "2.5 l Water", "1 piece Smoked ham hock", "200 g Onion, yellow", "150 g Carrot", "100 g Celery stalk", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tsp Thyme, dried", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Olive oil"]
instructions: Rinse the dried split peas under cold water. In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery and sauté until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Pour in the water and add the rinsed split peas, smoked ham hock, dried thyme, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for at least 1.5 to 2 hours, or until the peas are very tender and the ham is falling off the bone. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Remove the ham hock, shred the meat from the bone, discard the bone and skin, and return the shredded meat to the soup. title: Hearty Ham and Split Pea Soup
ingredients_json: ["500 g Split peas, dried, green", "2000 ml Water", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "2 stalks Celery, raw", "2 medium Carrots, raw", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "150 g Ham, cooked, lean", "20 ml Olive oil", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Salt"]

Pour in the water and add the rinsed split peas and the lean cooked ham. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 to 2 hours, or until the peas are very tender and have broken down, thickening the soup. title: Hearty Split Pea Soup with Ham Hock
ingredients_json: ["500 g Dried green split peas, unsoaked", "2000 ml Water", "1 piece Ham hock, smoked", "200 g Carrot, raw", "150 g Onion, raw", "100 g Celery stalk, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "5 g Dried thyme", "5 g Bay leaf, dried", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Rinse the dried green split peas thoroughly under cold running water. In a large pot or Dutch oven, combine the rinsed split peas, ham hock, and 2000 ml of water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the ham hock is tender. While the peas are simmering, finely chop the carrots, onion, and celery to create a mirepoix. Mince the garlic. Heat 10 ml of olive oil in a separate skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped carrots, onion, and celery, and sauté until softened, about 8-10 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Remove the ham hock from the soup pot and set aside to cool slightly. Skim off any excess fat from the surface of the soup. Add the sautéed vegetables, dried thyme, and bay leaf to the soup pot. Continue to simmer for another 30-45 minutes, or until the split peas have broken down and the soup has thickened. Remove the skin and bone from the ham hock, shred the meat, and return the shredded ham to the soup. Season with 2 g of ground black pepper. Remove the bay leaf before serving. Serve hot.

title: Hearty Ham and Split Pea Soup
ingredients_json: ["500 g Green split peas, dried", "2000 ml Water", "200 g Smoked ham hock", "150 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Leek, raw", "100 g Celery, raw", "50 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 bay leaf", "1 sprig Thyme, fresh", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]

title: Hearty Ham and Split Pea Soup

Pour in the water, add the rinsed split peas, the smoked ham hock, thyme, black pepper, and bay leaf. title: Honey-Sesame Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "250 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "150 g Carrot, peeled and julienned", "100 g Red bell pepper, thinly sliced", "50 g Onion, yellow, thinly sliced", "2 cloves Garlic, minced", "1 tbsp Ginger, fresh, grated", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Honey", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "1 tsp Cornstarch", "2 tbsp Water", "1 tbsp Vegetable oil", "1 tbsp Sesame seeds, toasted, for garnish", "50 g Brown rice, cooked, for serving"]

Add the chicken and stir-fry until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside. Add the onion, bell pepper, and carrots to the skillet and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until they start to soften. Pour the sauce mixture over the chicken and vegetables. Bring to a simmer and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook, stirring, until the sauce thickens, about 1-2 minutes. Serve immediately over cooked brown rice, garnished with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Spicy Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Brown Rice Noodles
ingredients_json: ["250 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "150 g Broccoli florets, fresh", "100 g Carrot, peeled", "50 g Red bell pepper, seedless", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Ginger, fresh", "3 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tsp Sesame oil", "0.5 tsp Chili flakes, dried", "2 tbsp Vegetable oil", "100 g Brown rice noodles", "1 dl Water"]

title: Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Brown Rice

title: Spicy Ginger-Garlic Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Brown Rice

title: Lean Turkey and Quinoa Stuffed Bell Peppers

title: Hearty Turkey and Quinoa Stuffed Bell Peppers

title: Hearty Quinoa and Black Bean Stuffed Bell Peppers

title: Salmon and Avocado Sushi Rolls with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["250 g Brown rice, uncooked", "3 dl Water", "3 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tbsp Sugar, white", "1 tsp Salt, fine", "4 sheets Nori, roasted", "200 g Salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "1 piece Avocado", "1/2 Cucumber", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Wasabi paste", "1 tsp Ginger, pickled, sliced"]

Let the rice cool to room temperature. Prepare your sushi fillings by slicing the salmon into thin strips. Peel and pit the avocado, then slice it into thin strips. Carefully roll the mat up, tucking in the filling as you go, and applying gentle pressure to create a firm roll. Moisten the top border of the nori with a little water to seal the roll. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Slice each roll into 6-8 pieces using a sharp, wet knife. Serve immediately with low-sodium soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

title: Salmon and Avocado Sushi Rolls
ingredients_json: ["250 g Sushi rice", "3 dl Water", "50 ml Rice vinegar", "2 tbsp Sugar", "1 tsp Salt", "4 sheets Nori, roasted seaweed", "150 g Salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "1 dl Cucumber, julienned", "1 dl Avocado, julienned", "5 g Wasabi paste", "50 ml Soy sauce, low sodium"]

title: Salmon and Avocado Sushi Rolls
ingredients_json: ["300 g Sushi rice", "350 ml Water", "50 ml Rice vinegar", "20 g Sugar", "5 g Salt", "4 sheets Nori, roasted seaweed sheets", "150 g Salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "100 g Avocado", "50 g Cucumber", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, low sodium", "1 tsp Wasabi paste", "10 g Pickled ginger"]

title: Hearty Mushroom and Barley Swiss Steak
ingredients_json: ["800 g Beef round steak, trimmed of visible fat", "100 g Flour, all-purpose", "30 g Olive oil", "300 g Onion, yellow, chopped", "200 g Carrot, peeled and diced", "200 g Celery, stalks, diced", "400 g Mushrooms, cremini, sliced", "4 cloves Garlic, minced", "8 dl Beef broth, low sodium", "1 dl Red wine, dry", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "2 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary, crushed", "1 bay leaf", "100 g Pearled barley", "15 g Fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish"]
instructions: Lightly pound the beef steak to about 1 cm thickness. Dredge each piece in flour seasoned with salt and pepper, shaking off any excess. Heat olive oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the floured steak in batches until deeply browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove the steak and set aside. Add the chopped onion, diced carrot, and diced celery to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 7-10 minutes. Stir in the sliced mushrooms and minced garlic, and cook for another 5 minutes until the mushrooms have released their liquid and started to brown. Pour in the red wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Let it simmer for 2 minutes to reduce slightly. Stir in the tomato paste, dried thyme, dried rosemary, and bay leaf. Return the seared steak to the pot. Pour in the beef broth, ensuring the steak is mostly submerged. Bring to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and cook for 1.5 hours. Add the pearled barley to the pot, stir, and continue to simmer, covered, for another 45-60 minutes, or until the barley is tender and the steak is fork-tender. Remove the bay leaf. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper as needed. Serve hot, garnished with fresh chopped parsley.

title: Healthy Lean Beef Swiss Steak with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["800 g Beef round steak, lean", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 medium Onions, yellow", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "4 large Carrots, raw", "4 medium Parsnips, raw", "400 g Canned tomatoes, diced", "5 dl Beef broth, low sodium", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "2 Bay leaves", "Salt, to taste", "Black pepper, ground, to taste", "2 tbsp Cornstarch", "2 dl Water, cold"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C (325°F). Pat the beef dry and season generously with salt and pepper. In a large, oven-safe pot or Dutch oven, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat. Sear the beef on all sides until browned. Remove the beef and set aside. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the pot. Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the carrots and parsnips, stirring to combine. Pour in the diced tomatoes, beef broth, tomato paste, and Worcestershire sauce. Add the thyme, rosemary, and bay leaves. Bring the mixture to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Return the seared beef to the pot, ensuring it's mostly submerged in the liquid. Cover the pot tightly and transfer it to the preheated oven. Bake for 2.5 to 3 hours, or until the beef is very tender and easily shreds. In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and cold water to create a slurry. Remove the pot from the oven, discard the bay leaves, and stir the cornstarch slurry into the liquid to thicken the sauce. Return the pot to the stovetop over medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce has thickened to your desired consistency. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed. Serve hot.

title: Hearty Beef Swiss Steak with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["700 g Beef round steak, lean", "2 tbsp All-purpose flour", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 medium Onions, yellow, peeled", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 large Carrots, raw", "2 medium Parsnips, raw", "400 g Tomatoes, canned, diced", "5 dl Beef broth, low sodium", "1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce", "1 sprig Thyme, fresh"]

Bake for 2 to 2.5 hours, or until the beef is very tender and easily shreds with a fork. Remove the thyme sprig before serving. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed.

title: Hearty Beef Swiss Steak with Root Vegetables

title: Hearty Whole Wheat Swiss Steak with Root Vegetables

title: Shredded Chicken and Black Bean Tamales with Salsa Verde
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, raw", "1 piece Onion, white, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 dl Chicken broth, low sodium", "1 tsp Cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp Oregano, dried", "1 dl Salsa verde", "400 g Black beans, canned, drained and rinsed", "3 dl Masa harina", "1 dl Vegetable oil", "1 dl Warm water", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Baking powder", "24 pieces Corn husks, dried"]
instructions: First, prepare the shredded chicken filling. Place the chicken breast in a saucepan, cover with water, and simmer until cooked through, about 15-20 minutes. Drain the chicken and shred it using two forks. In a skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat. Add half of the chopped onion and 1 clove of minced garlic, and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the shredded chicken, 1 dl of chicken broth, cumin, oregano, and salsa verde. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld. Stir in the drained black beans and cook for another 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Remove from heat and set aside. Next, prepare the tamale dough (masa). In a large bowl, combine the masa harina, 1 dl of vegetable oil, 0.5 teaspoon salt, and 0.25 teaspoon baking powder. Gradually add 1 dl of warm water, mixing until a soft, cohesive dough forms. The dough should be moist but not sticky. Prepare the corn husks by soaking them in warm water for at least 30 minutes until pliable. Drain them well. To assemble the tamales, spread about 2 tablespoons of masa dough onto the wider end of a soaked corn husk, spreading it evenly into a rectangular shape. Spoon about 1-2 tablespoons of the chicken and bean filling onto the center of the masa. Fold the sides of the corn husk over the filling, then fold the bottom up to enclose the tamale. Repeat with the remaining masa, filling, and corn husks. Arrange the tamales upright in a steamer basket over boiling water, ensuring they don't touch the water. Cover the steamer tightly with a lid and steam for 45-60 minutes, or until the masa is firm and easily pulls away from the husk. Serve hot with extra salsa verde if desired.

title: Healthy Turkey and Black Bean Tamales with Corn Masa

title: Lean Turkey and Vegetable Tater Tot Casserole

title: Healthy Turkey and Vegetable Stir-fry with Brown Rice

title: Lemon Herb Roasted Turkey Breast with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["1 kg Turkey breast, boneless, skinless", "500 g Carrots, raw", "500 g Parsnips, raw", "200 g Red onion, raw", "4 cloves Garlic, raw", "3 tbsp Olive oil", "2 tbsp Fresh rosemary, chopped", "2 tbsp Fresh thyme, chopped", "1 Lemon, zest and juice", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1.5 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 200°C (180°C fan/gas mark 6). Peel and chop the carrots and parsnips into roughly 2.5cm chunks. Peel and quarter the red onion. Mince the garlic. Roast in the preheated oven for 45-55 minutes, or until the turkey is cooked through and golden brown, and the vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized. title: Lemon Herb Roasted Turkey Breast with Root Vegetables

title: Light and Airy Lemon Angel Food Cake with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["225 g Egg whites, pasteurized", "150 g Granulated sugar, white", "75 g Cake flour, unsifted", "1 tsp Cream of tartar", "1/2 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 tbsp Lemon zest, fresh", "150 g Fresh berries, mixed (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries)"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit). Ensure your angel food cake pan is clean and dry, but do not grease it. In a large, grease-free bowl, whip the egg whites with an electric mixer on medium speed until foamy. Gradually add the cream of tartar and continue to whip until soft peaks form. Slowly add the granulated sugar, about 2 tablespoons at a time, while continuing to beat on high speed until stiff, glossy peaks form and the sugar is dissolved. Gently fold in the vanilla extract and lemon zest. Sift the cake flour over the egg white mixture in three additions, folding gently after each addition until just combined, being careful not to deflate the batter. Pour the batter into the prepared angel food cake pan and smooth the top. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the cake is golden brown, springs back when lightly touched, and a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Immediately invert the pan onto a wire rack or bottle to cool completely, this prevents the cake from collapsing. Once completely cool, carefully run a thin knife around the edges and center tube to release the cake. Serve sliced with fresh mixed berries.

title: Light Lemon Angel Food Cake with Fresh Berries

title: Light and Airy Raspberry Angel Food Cake

title: Light Lemon Angel Food Cake with Fresh Berries

title: Light & Airy Lemon Angel Food Cake with Fresh Berries

title: Whole Wheat Almond Biscotti with Cranberries

title: Healthy Vanilla Bean Sweet Potato Flan
ingredients_json: ["200 g Sweet potato, cooked and mashed", "200 ml Milk, low-fat, 1.5% fat", "200 ml Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "50 g Honey", "2 large Egg, raw", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/2 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "Pinch Nutmeg, ground"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C (320°F). In a medium bowl, thoroughly mash the cooked sweet potato until very smooth. Mix until just combined. Pour the mixture into a 1-liter ovenproof dish or individual ramekins. Place the dish or ramekins in a larger baking pan. Carefully pour hot water into the larger pan, reaching about halfway up the sides of the flan dish(es) to create a water bath. Bake for 45-60 minutes, or until the flan is set around the edges but still slightly wobbly in the center. Remove from the oven and water bath. Let it cool completely at room temperature, then chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, before serving.

title: Light Coconut Milk Flan with Lime Zest
ingredients_json: ["400 ml Coconut milk, light", "3 Whole eggs, raw", "2 large Egg yolks, raw", "75 g Erythritol", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 tbsp Lime zest, fresh", "100 g Unsweetened shredded coconut"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C (320°F). Toast the shredded coconut in a dry skillet over medium-low heat until lightly golden and fragrant, stirring frequently. Set aside to cool. In a medium bowl, whisk together the light coconut milk, whole eggs, egg yolks, erythritol, vanilla extract, and lime zest until well combined and smooth. Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean bowl to remove any solids and ensure a silky texture. Divide the toasted coconut evenly among 4 individual ramekins (about 100 ml capacity each). Pour the coconut milk mixture over the coconut in each ramekin. Arrange the ramekins in a larger baking dish. Carefully pour hot water into the baking dish, creating a water bath that comes halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the flan is just set but still slightly jiggly in the center. Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool completely on a wire rack. Once cooled, cover each ramekin with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, to allow the flan to firm up and the flavors to meld. To serve, run a thin knife around the edge of each ramekin and invert onto a serving plate.

title: Light Coconut Milk Flan with Mango Coulis
ingredients_json: ["100 g Granulated sugar", "400 ml Coconut milk, light", "4 piece Egg, raw", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "200 g Mango, ripe", "1 tbsp Lime juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C (320°F). In a small saucepan, heat the granulated sugar over medium heat, swirling occasionally, until it melts and turns into a golden amber caramel. Be careful not to burn it. Pour the caramel immediately into a 1-liter capacity ovenproof dish, tilting to coat the bottom and sides. Set aside to cool and harden. In a separate bowl, whisk together the light coconut milk, eggs, and vanilla extract until well combined. Pour the mixture gently into the caramel-lined dish. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. Place the dish in a larger baking pan and carefully pour hot water into the larger pan to come halfway up the sides of the flan dish, creating a water bath. Bake for 45-55 minutes, or until the flan is set but still slightly jiggly in the center. Remove from the oven and water bath, then let it cool completely at room temperature before chilling in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight. While the flan chills, prepare the mango coulis. Peel and chop the ripe mango, then blend it with the lime juice until smooth. You can strain it for a smoother texture if desired. To serve, run a knife around the edge of the flan, then invert it onto a serving plate, allowing the caramel to drizzle over the top. Serve chilled, with a generous spoonful of the mango coulis on the side.

title: Light Vanilla Bean and Greek Yogurt Flan
ingredients_json: ["150 g Caster sugar", "1 dl Water", "500 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "150 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "3 whole Egg, raw", "2 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/2 tsp Vanilla bean seeds"]
instructions: First, prepare the caramel by heating the caster sugar and water in a saucepan over medium heat until the sugar dissolves and turns into a golden amber color. Be careful not to burn it. In a separate bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, milk, whole eggs, vanilla extract, and vanilla bean seeds until well combined and smooth. Pour this mixture carefully over the set caramel in each ramekin. Place the ramekins in a larger baking dish and fill the baking dish with hot water until it comes halfway up the sides of the ramekins. title: Light Coconut Milk and Lime Flan
ingredients_json: ["500 ml Coconut milk, light", "150 g Erythritol", "4 large Egg yolks", "1 whole Egg", "50 ml Lime juice, fresh", "1 tsp Lime zest", "1 pinch Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 150°C. In a saucepan, gently heat the light coconut milk, but do not boil. In a separate bowl, whisk together the erythritol, egg yolks, whole egg, and salt until well combined. Gradually temper the egg mixture by slowly whisking in about half of the warm coconut milk. Pour the tempered egg mixture back into the saucepan with the remaining coconut milk. Stir in the fresh lime juice and lime zest. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, until the mixture thickens slightly and coats the back of the spoon. Do not let it boil. Strain the custard mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl to remove any solids. Pour the strained custard into 6 small ramekins. Place the ramekins in a larger baking dish. Carefully pour hot water into the baking dish to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until the flan is set but still has a slight wobble in the center. Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool completely on a wire rack. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, before serving.

title: Spiced Apple and Walnut Whole Wheat Fruitcake

title: Decadent Avocado Chocolate Fudge

title: Creamy Avocado and Lime Ice Cream

title: Creamy Avocado Lime Ice Cream

title: Creamy Avocado Lime Ice Cream
ingredients_json: ["400 g Avocado, ripe", "200 ml Coconut milk, full-fat", "100 g Maple syrup", "80 ml Lime juice, fresh", "1 tsp Lime zest", "1 g Vanilla extract"]

Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker and churn according to the manufacturer's instructions until it reaches a soft-serve consistency. If you don't have an ice cream maker, pour the mixture into a freezer-safe container, cover tightly, and freeze for at least 4-6 hours, stirring vigorously with a fork every hour to break up ice crystals. Scoop into bowls and enjoy immediately or store in the freezer.

title: Creamy Avocado Lime Ice Cream
ingredients_json: ["300 g Avocado, ripe", "150 ml Coconut milk, full fat", "100 ml Lime juice, fresh", "70 g Maple syrup", "1 tsp Lime zest"]

title: Creamy Avocado and Lime No-Churn Ice Cream
ingredients_json: ["400 g Avocado, ripe", "200 ml Coconut milk, full-fat, canned", "100 ml Maple syrup, 100%", "60 ml Lime juice, fresh", "1 tsp Lime zest", "0.5 tsp Vanilla extract"]

title: Healthy Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almond flour", "50 g Unsalted butter, melted", "2 tbsp Maple syrup", "4 large Egg yolks", "150 ml Fresh lime juice", "100 g Greek yogurt, 2%", "75 g Honey", "1 tsp Lime zest", "1/4 tsp Salt"]

title: Healthy Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie
ingredients_json: ["200 g Graham crackers, whole wheat", "50 g Butter, unsalted, melted", "15 g Honey", "500 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "100 g Lime juice, fresh", "80 g Erythritol", "20 g Cornstarch", "2 large Egg yolks", "1 tsp Lime zest"]

title: Lightened-Up Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie
ingredients_json: ["200 g Graham crackers, whole wheat", "60 g Butter, unsalted, melted", "500 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "150 g Sweetened condensed milk, reduced fat", "120 ml Fresh lime juice", "2 tbsp Lime zest", "2 pieces Egg, large, pasteurized", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "30 g Powdered sugar"]

title: Lightened-Up Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie
ingredients_json: ["150 g Graham crackers, whole wheat", "30 g Butter, unsalted, melted", "30 g Erythritol", "500 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "150 g Lime juice, fresh", "100 g Erythritol", "2 large Egg yolks", "15 g Cornstarch", "5 ml Lime zest, fresh", "1 g Salt"]

title: Healthier Key Lime Pie with Whole Wheat Crust
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats", "40 g Coconut oil, melted", "15 g Maple syrup", "400 g Low-fat cottage cheese", "150 g Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "100 g Fresh lime juice", "70 g Honey", "10 g Cornstarch", "1 tsp Lime zest"]

title: Wholesome Lemon and Oat Bars
ingredients_json: ["150 g Rolled oats", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almond flour", "75 g Coconut oil, melted", "50 g Maple syrup", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "300 g Silken tofu", "100 g Lemon juice, fresh", "50 g Agave nectar", "2 tbsp Cornstarch", "1 tsp Lemon zest", "Pinch Salt"]

Press this mixture evenly into the bottom of the prepared baking pan to form the crust. Bake for 15 minutes, or until lightly golden. While the crust bakes, prepare the lemon filling. Return the pan to the oven and bake for another 25-30 minutes, or until the filling is set and the edges are lightly golden. title: Whole Wheat Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "75 g Almond flour", "50 g Erythritol", "1 g Salt", "100 g Unsalted butter, cold, cut into cubes", "2 large Eggs", "150 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "100 g Fresh lemon juice", "50 g Honey", "1 tsp Lemon zest", "15 g Cornstarch"]

In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, honey, 50g erythritol, lemon zest, and cornstarch until smooth and well combined. Pour the lemon filling over the hot crust. Return the pan to the oven and bake for another 20-25 minutes, or until the filling is set but still has a slight wobble in the center. title: Wholesome Lemon & Almond Flour Bars
ingredients_json: ["150 g Almond flour", "75 g Rolled oats, finely ground", "50 g Coconut oil, melted", "25 g Maple syrup", "1 g Salt", "200 g Lemon juice, fresh", "100 g Erythritol", "3 large Egg yolks", "1 large Egg", "1 tbsp Lemon zest", "10 g Cornstarch"]

title: Whole Wheat Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt Frosting
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almond flour", "100 g Unsalted butter, cold, cubed", "50 g Maple syrup", "2 large Eggs, room temperature", "150 g Granulated sugar", "80 ml Fresh lemon juice", "2 tsp Lemon zest", "150 g Plain Greek yogurt, 0% fat", "30 g Powdered sugar", "1 tsp Vanilla extract"]

Chill the bars in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour to allow the frosting to set before cutting into squares. Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Wholesome Lemon Raspberry Oat Bars
ingredients_json: ["200 g Rolled oats", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "75 g Almond flour", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "150 g Unsalted butter, melted", "100 g Maple syrup", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "4 large Eggs", "200 g Fresh raspberries", "150 g Granulated sugar", "80 ml Fresh lemon juice", "2 tbsp Lemon zest", "2 tbsp Cornstarch"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C (350°F) and lightly grease and line a 20x20 cm (8x8 inch) baking pan with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, combine the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, almond flour, baking powder, and salt for the crust. Pour in the melted butter, maple syrup, and vanilla extract, stirring until just combined to form a crumbly mixture. Press about two-thirds of this mixture evenly into the bottom of the prepared baking pan. Bake the crust for 12-15 minutes, or until lightly golden. While the crust bakes, prepare the filling. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, granulated sugar, lemon juice, and lemon zest until smooth. Whisk in the cornstarch until fully dissolved. Pour the lemon filling over the partially baked crust. Gently scatter the fresh raspberries over the lemon filling. Top with the remaining oat mixture, crumbling it evenly over the raspberries. Return the pan to the oven and bake for another 30-35 minutes, or until the filling is set and the top is golden brown. Let the bars cool completely in the pan on a wire rack before cutting into squares. For cleaner cuts, you can chill the bars in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour before slicing.

title: Almond Flour Coconut Macaroons with Orange Zest
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour, blanched", "100 g Unsweetened shredded coconut", "75 g Maple syrup", "50 g Coconut oil, melted", "1 tbsp Orange zest", "1/2 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/4 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 160°C (320°F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, shredded coconut, orange zest, and salt. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until thoroughly combined. The mixture should be moist and sticky. Drop rounded tablespoons of the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving some space between each macaroon. Gently flatten the tops with a damp finger if desired. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the macaroons are lightly firm to the touch. Let them cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Almond Flour Coconut Macaroons with Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour, blanched", "100 g Unsweetened shredded coconut", "75 g Maple syrup", "50 g Coconut oil, melted", "1 tbsp Lemon zest, fresh", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/4 tsp Salt"]

The mixture should be moist but not sticky. Drop rounded tablespoons of the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, shaping them gently into mounds. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the macaroons are lightly toasted. Let them cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Almond Flour Coconut Macaroons with Maple Glaze
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour, blanched", "100 g Shredded unsweetened coconut", "100 g Maple syrup, pure", "50 g Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/4 tsp Sea salt", "30 g Maple syrup, pure (for glaze)", "15 g Coconut oil, melted (for glaze)"]

Roll the dough into small balls, about 2.5 cm (1 inch) in diameter, and place them on the prepared baking sheet, leaving a little space between each one. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the tops are lightly toasted. While the macaroons are baking, prepare the glaze by whisking together the 30g of maple syrup and 15g of melted coconut oil in a small bowl until well combined. Once the macaroons are out of the oven, let them cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. Drizzle the maple glaze over the cooled macaroons before serving.

title: Almond Flour Coconut Macaroons
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour, blanched", "100 g Unsweetened shredded coconut", "100 g Maple syrup", "50 g Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/4 tsp Salt"]

In a separate small bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined and a sticky dough forms. Drop rounded tablespoons of the dough onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 2 cm (1 inch) between each macaroon. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden and the macaroons are set. Let them cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Almond Flour Coconut Macaroons with Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["100 g Almond flour, blanched", "100 g Shredded unsweetened coconut", "75 g Maple syrup", "1 large Egg white", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 tsp Lemon zest, fresh"]

In a separate small bowl, whisk together the maple syrup, egg white, vanilla extract, and lemon zest until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix with a spatula until a thick, cohesive dough forms. Drop rounded tablespoons of the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 2 cm between each macaroon. Bake for 15-18 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown and the macaroons are firm to the touch. Let them cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Light Avocado Chocolate Mousse
ingredients_json: ["2 ripe medium Avocados, pitted and flesh scooped out", "100 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids, melted", "60 ml Maple syrup, clear", "60 ml Unsweetened almond milk", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 pinch Sea salt"]
instructions: Ensure your avocados are ripe but not overly brown. In a food processor or high-speed blender, combine the avocado flesh, melted dark chocolate, maple syrup, almond milk, vanilla extract, and sea salt. Blend on high speed until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. This may take 1-2 minutes. Once smooth, spoon the mousse into individual serving dishes or glasses. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour to allow the mousse to set and flavors to meld. Serve cold.

title: Avocado Chocolate Mousse with Raspberry Coulis
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces Avocado, ripe", "60 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "120 ml Maple syrup, pure", "80 ml Coconut milk, full fat", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 pinch Salt", "150 g Raspberries, fresh or frozen", "1 tbsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: For the mousse, halve the avocados, remove the pits, and scoop the flesh into a food processor. Add the cocoa powder, maple syrup, coconut milk, vanilla extract, and a pinch of salt. Process until completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. Taste and adjust sweetness if necessary. Spoon the mousse into individual serving glasses or bowls. For the coulis, combine the raspberries and lemon juice in a small saucepan. Heat gently over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until the raspberries have broken down and the mixture is slightly thickened, about 5-7 minutes. If desired, strain the coulis through a fine-mesh sieve to remove seeds. Chill the mousse for at least 30 minutes before serving. Drizzle with the raspberry coulis just before serving.

title: Silken Tofu Chocolate Mousse with Raspberry Coulis
ingredients_json: ["300 g Silken tofu, firm", "100 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids", "50 g Maple syrup", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "150 g Raspberries, frozen", "1 tbsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: Melt the dark chocolate gently in a heatproof bowl set over a saucepan of simmering water, stirring occasionally until smooth. Remove from heat and let it cool slightly. In a blender or food processor, combine the silken tofu, melted dark chocolate, maple syrup, and vanilla extract. Blend until completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. Spoon the mousse into individual serving glasses or ramekins. For the raspberry coulis, combine the frozen raspberries and lemon juice in a small saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring and mashing the raspberries, until they break down and the sauce thickens slightly, about 5-7 minutes. Strain the coulis through a fine-mesh sieve to remove seeds, if desired. Chill the mousse in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or until set. Serve the chocolate mousse topped with a drizzle of the raspberry coulis.

title: Decadent Avocado Chocolate Mousse
ingredients_json: ["200 g Ripe avocado, flesh", "50 g Unsweetened cocoa powder", "100 ml Maple syrup", "80 ml Unsweetened almond milk", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 pinch Salt"]
instructions: Combine the avocado flesh, unsweetened cocoa powder, maple syrup, almond milk, vanilla extract, and salt in a food processor or high-speed blender. Process until completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed to ensure no avocado lumps remain. Taste and adjust sweetness if desired by adding a little more maple syrup. Spoon the mousse into individual serving dishes or ramekins. Cover with plastic wrap, pressing the wrap directly onto the surface to prevent a skin from forming. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour to allow the mousse to set and the flavors to meld before serving.

title: Avocado Chocolate Mousse with Raspberry Swirl
ingredients_json: ["2 medium Avocados, ripe", "60 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "100 g Maple syrup", "120 ml Almond milk, unsweetened", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 pinch Salt", "100 g Raspberries, fresh or frozen"]
instructions: Halve the avocados, remove the pits, and scoop the flesh into a food processor. Add the cocoa powder, maple syrup, almond milk, vanilla extract, and salt to the food processor. Blend until completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. If the mixture is too thick, add a little more almond milk, 1 tablespoon at a time, until it reaches your desired consistency. Spoon the mousse into serving glasses or bowls. Gently swirl in the raspberries, either by pressing them into the top or by using a toothpick to create patterns. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld and the mousse to set.

title: Hearty Whole Wheat Oatmeal Cookies with Walnuts and Raisins
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats, uncooked", "75 g Walnuts, chopped", "50 g Raisins", "100 g Unsalted butter, softened", "75 g Brown sugar", "50 g Maple syrup", "1 large Egg, raw", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/2 tsp Baking soda", "1/4 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit). Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking soda, and salt. In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter, brown sugar, and maple syrup until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until well combined. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Stir in the chopped walnuts and raisins. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the prepared baking sheets, leaving about 5 cm between cookies. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are set. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Wholesome Almond & Cranberry Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients_json: ["150 g Rolled oats, whole", "100 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almond flour", "80 g Unsalted butter, softened", "70 g Maple syrup", "1 large Egg, raw", "1 tsp Baking soda", "1/2 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1/4 tsp Salt", "80 g Dried cranberries", "50 g Chopped almonds"]

Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Stir in the dried cranberries and chopped almonds. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving some space between each cookie. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are set. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Healthy Banana Oat Cookies

Drop rounded tablespoons of the dough onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving about 2 inches between each cookie. Flatten each cookie slightly with the back of a spoon or your palm. Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are set. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Wholesome Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
ingredients_json: ["225 g Rolled oats, whole", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Baking soda", "0.5 tsp Ground cinnamon", "0.25 tsp Ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp Salt", "170 g Unsalted butter, softened", "150 g Coconut sugar", "1 large Egg, raw", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "120 g Raisins, dried", "50 g Walnuts, chopped"]

Let the cookies cool on the baking sheets for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Wholesome Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal Cookies
ingredients_json: ["150 g Rolled oats, whole", "75 g Whole wheat flour", "1 tsp Baking soda", "1/2 tsp Ground cinnamon", "1/4 tsp Ground nutmeg", "1/4 tsp Salt", "50 g Unsalted butter, softened", "75 g Coconut sugar", "1 large Egg, raw", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 dl Unsweetened applesauce", "75 g Apple, finely diced", "50 g Walnuts, chopped"]

Pour the filling into the prepared pie crust. Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 15 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F) and continue baking for another 35-45 minutes, or until the center is set and a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Let the pie cool completely on a wire rack before serving.

title: Healthier Spiced Pumpkin Pie with Whole Wheat Crust
ingredients_json: ["200 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Unsalted butter, cold, cubed", "50 ml Ice water", "425 g Pumpkin puree, unsweetened", "150 ml Evaporated milk, low fat", "75 g Maple syrup", "2 Large eggs, lightly beaten", "10 g Cornstarch", "10 g Pumpkin pie spice", "5 g Vanilla extract", "2 g Salt"]
instructions: For the crust, combine whole wheat flour and salt in a bowl. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry blender or your fingertips until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Gradually add ice water, 1 tablespoon at a time, mixing until the dough just comes together. Form into a disc, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 200°C. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to fit a 23cm pie plate. Carefully transfer the dough to the pie plate and crimp the edges. Line the crust with parchment paper and fill with pie weights or dried beans. Blind bake for 15 minutes. Remove the parchment paper and weights, and bake for another 5 minutes until lightly golden. Reduce oven temperature to 175°C. While the crust bakes, prepare the filling. In a large bowl, whisk together pumpkin puree, evaporated milk, maple syrup, beaten eggs, cornstarch, pumpkin pie spice, vanilla extract, and salt until smooth. Pour the filling into the pre-baked pie crust. Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until the center is almost set and a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Let cool completely on a wire rack before slicing and serving. This may take several hours.

title: Whole Wheat Rhubarb Crumble Pie with Oat Topping
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "75 g Rolled oats", "50 g Almond flour", "75 g Coconut oil, solid", "50 g Maple syrup", "1 pinch Salt", "800 g Rhubarb, fresh, chopped", "100 g Erythritol", "2 tbsp Cornstarch", "1 tsp Ground ginger", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 g Walnuts, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (170°C fan/gas mark 5). In a medium bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, almond flour, coconut oil, maple syrup, and salt. Press the remaining mixture firmly into the base and up the sides of a 23cm pie dish to form the crust. In a separate bowl, gently toss the chopped rhubarb with erythritol, cornstarch, ground ginger, and vanilla extract until evenly coated. Pour the rhubarb filling into the prepared crust. Sprinkle the reserved crumble mixture and the chopped walnuts evenly over the top of the rhubarb. Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the rhubarb filling is bubbling and tender. Let it cool for at least 20 minutes before serving to allow the filling to set.

title: Whole Wheat Rhubarb Crumble Pie
ingredients_json: ["300 g Rhubarb, fresh, trimmed and chopped", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "75 g Rolled oats", "50 g Unsalted butter, cold and cubed", "50 g Maple syrup", "30 g Almonds, slivered", "15 g Cornstarch", "10 g Lemon zest", "5 g Ground cinnamon", "2.5 g Salt"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (375°F). In a medium bowl, combine the chopped rhubarb with 10g of the cornstarch and toss to coat evenly. Set aside. Add the cold, cubed butter and use your fingertips or a pastry blender to cut the butter into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in the slivered almonds. title: Whole Wheat Rhubarb Crumble Pie with Oats
ingredients_json: ["1000 g Rhubarb, fresh, chopped", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "80 g Butter, unsalted, cold, cubed", "100 g Brown sugar, light", "50 g Almonds, slivered", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "1/2 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "1 egg, beaten, for egg wash", "1 tbsp Water"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (170°C fan/Gas Mark 5). In a large bowl, toss the chopped rhubarb with 2 tablespoons of the brown sugar, lemon juice, cinnamon, and nutmeg. title: Whole Wheat Rhubarb Crumble Pie
ingredients_json: ["600 g Rhubarb, fresh, chopped", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "75 g Almonds, blanched, ground", "100 g Maple syrup", "75 g Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/2 tsp Ground cinnamon", "1/4 tsp Ground nutmeg", "1 tbsp Lemon juice", "50 g Erythritol"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 190°C (170°C fan/gas mark 5). In a large bowl, combine the chopped rhubarb with lemon juice and erythritol. Let it sit for about 10 minutes. In a separate bowl, mix together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, ground almonds, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Pour in the melted coconut oil and maple syrup, then add the vanilla extract. Stir until a crumble mixture forms. Pour the rhubarb mixture into a 23cm pie dish. Evenly spread the crumble topping over the rhubarb. Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the rhubarb is tender and bubbling. Let it cool slightly before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Rhubarb Crumble Pie
ingredients_json: ["500 g Rhubarb, fresh, trimmed and chopped", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats, raw", "75 g Almonds, ground", "60 g Coconut sugar", "50 g Unsalted butter, cold and cubed", "1 Lemon, zest and juice", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "0.25 tsp Ground cinnamon", "0.25 tsp Ground nutmeg", "2 tbsp Maple syrup", "1 tbsp Cornstarch"]

In a separate bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, ground almonds, coconut sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg. title: Creamy Coconut and Cardamom Rice Pudding
ingredients_json: ["1.5 dl Round grain rice, white", "7 dl Water", "4 dl Coconut milk, light", "1 dl Maple syrup", "1 tsp Cardamom, ground", "1/4 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold running water until the water runs clear. In a medium saucepan, combine the rinsed rice with 7 dl of water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in the light coconut milk, maple syrup, ground cardamom, and salt. Continue to cook over low heat, stirring frequently, for another 20-25 minutes, or until the pudding has thickened to your desired consistency. Be careful not to let it stick to the bottom of the pan. Serve warm or chilled.

title: Creamy Coconut and Cardamom Rice Pudding
ingredients_json: ["100 g Arborio rice", "750 ml Unsweetened almond milk", "200 ml Coconut milk, light", "50 g Maple syrup", "1 tsp Ground cardamom", "1/2 tsp Vanilla extract", "Pinch of salt"]
instructions: Combine the Arborio rice, almond milk, coconut milk, maple syrup, ground cardamom, vanilla extract, and salt in a medium saucepan. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly to prevent sticking. Once simmering, reduce the heat to low, cover partially, and cook for 25-30 minutes, stirring frequently, until the rice is tender and the pudding has thickened to your desired consistency. If it becomes too thick, add a splash more almond milk. Serve warm, or chill in the refrigerator for a lighter, cold dessert.

title: Creamy Coconut and Cardamom Rice Pudding with Mango
ingredients_json: ["100 g Arborio rice", "700 ml Coconut milk, full fat", "300 ml Water", "80 g Maple syrup", "1 tsp Ground cardamom", "1/2 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 g Salt", "200 g Mango, fresh, ripe, cubed"]
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the Arborio rice, full-fat coconut milk, and water. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. Stir in the maple syrup, ground cardamom, vanilla extract, and salt. Continue to cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until well combined and the pudding reaches your desired creamy consistency. Remove from heat and let it cool slightly for about 10 minutes. Serve warm, topped with fresh cubed mango.

title: Creamy Coconut and Cardamom Rice Pudding
ingredients_json: ["1 dl Rice, short-grain", "5 dl Water", "5 dl Coconut milk, light", "1 dl Milk, skimmed", "50 g Sugar, white", "0.5 tsp Cardamom, ground", "1 pinch Salt"]

title: Creamy Coconut and Mango Rice Pudding
ingredients_json: ["100 g Arborio rice", "500 ml Coconut milk, light", "200 ml Water", "50 g Maple syrup", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/2 tsp Ground cardamom", "150 g Mango, fresh, ripe, diced"]

title: Whole Wheat Oatmeal Sandwich Cookies with Cashew Butter Filling
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats", "50 g Almond flour", "1 tsp Baking soda", "1/2 tsp Salt", "1 tsp Ground cinnamon", "1/2 tsp Ground nutmeg", "115 g Unsalted butter, softened", "100 g Coconut sugar", "1 large Egg", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 g Unsweetened applesauce", "150 g Cashew butter, unsweetened", "30 g Maple syrup"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F) and line two baking sheets with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, almond flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg. In a large bowl, cream together the softened butter and coconut sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract until well combined. Stir in the unsweetened applesauce. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. The dough will be soft. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the prepared baking sheets, about 2 inches apart. Flatten each cookie slightly with the bottom of a glass or your palm. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are set. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. While the cookies cool, prepare the filling by mixing the cashew butter and maple syrup in a small bowl until smooth and well combined. Once the cookies are completely cool, spread about 1 tablespoon of the cashew butter filling onto the flat side of one cookie and top with another cookie, pressing gently to form a sandwich. Repeat with the remaining cookies and filling.

title: Whole Wheat Oatmeal Sandwich Cookies with Avocado-Lime Filling
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats, ground", "80 g Coconut sugar", "60 g Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/2 tsp Baking soda", "1/4 tsp Salt", "70 g Avocado, ripe", "30 g Lime juice, fresh", "20 g Maple syrup", "10 g Lime zest"]

Flatten each ball slightly with your palm or the bottom of a glass. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. While the cookies are cooling, prepare the filling. In a small bowl, mash the ripe avocado until smooth. Stir in the fresh lime juice, maple syrup, and lime zest until well combined and creamy. Once the cookies are completely cool, spread a small amount of the avocado-lime filling onto the flat side of one cookie and top with another cookie to form a sandwich. Repeat with the remaining cookies.

title: Whole Wheat Oat Sandwich Cookies with Greek Yogurt Filling

title: Oatmeal Almond Butter Sandwich Cookies

ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Rolled oats, ground", "50 g Almond flour", "75 g Coconut oil, melted", "75 g Maple syrup", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/2 tsp Baking soda", "1/4 tsp Salt", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "50 g Honey", "1/2 tsp Lemon zest"]

title: Whole Wheat Lemon Almond Shortbread
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almond flour", "100 g Unsalted butter, cold and cubed", "50 g Powdered sugar", "1 tbsp Lemon zest", "1 ml Vanilla extract", "1 pinch Salt"]

Press the dough evenly into an 8-inch square baking pan lined with parchment paper. Prick the surface all over with a fork. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown. Let the shortbread cool completely in the pan before cutting into squares or fingers.

title: Whole Wheat Almond Shortbread
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Almond flour", "75 g Unsalted butter, softened", "50 g Maple syrup", "1/2 tsp Vanilla extract", "1/4 tsp Salt"]

Score the dough into rectangles or desired shapes using a knife, but do not separate them yet. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown. Let the shortbread cool completely on the baking sheet before cutting along the scored lines.

title: Whole Wheat Oat Shortbread with Honey and Almonds
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Rolled oats", "100 g Unsalted butter, cold and cubed", "50 g Honey", "30 g Almonds, blanched and finely chopped", "0.5 tsp Baking powder", "1 g Salt"]

title: Whole Wheat Almond Shortbread

title: Whole Wheat Oat Shortbread with Almonds

title: Whole Wheat Berry Shortcakes with Greek Yogurt

title: Whole Wheat Berry Shortcakes with Greek Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g All-purpose flour", "50 g Rolled oats, regular", "30 g Erythritol", "8 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt", "60 g Unsalted butter, cold, cut into cubes", "120 ml Milk, low-fat, 1%", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "150 g Mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "300 g Greek yogurt, plain, 0% fat", "15 g Maple syrup", "1 tsp Lemon zest"]

title: Healthier Spiced Sweet Potato Pie with Oat Crust

title: Healthy Spiced Sweet Potato Pie with Oat Crust

title: Wholesome Spiced Sweet Potato Pie

title: Healthy Sweet Potato Pie with Oat Crust

title: Healthy Spiced Sweet Potato Pie with Oat Crust

title: Lightened-Up Coffee & Mascarpone Tiramisu

title: Lightened-Up Coffee & Mascarpone Tiramisu

title: Healthy Date and Nut Toffee Bites

title: Healthy Date and Nut Butter Toffee Bites

title: Healthy Date and Nut Toffee Bites

title: Healthy Almond Butter Toffee Bites

title: Almond Flour Chocolate Avocado Torte

Remove from heat and let it cool slightly. In a food processor or blender, combine the scooped avocado flesh, maple syrup, and vanilla extract. Blend until completely smooth and creamy. Add the melted chocolate to the avocado mixture and process until well combined. In a separate large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, unsweetened cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt. Add the eggs to the chocolate-avocado mixture one at a time, processing briefly after each addition until incorporated. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix on low speed or by hand until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Pour the batter into the prepared springform pan and spread evenly. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out with moist crumbs attached. Let the torte cool in the pan for 15 minutes before carefully releasing the springform side and transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before slicing and serving.

title: Whole Wheat Chocolate Avocado Torte with Raspberry Coulis
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "50 g Unsweetened cocoa powder", "1 tsp Baking soda", "0.5 tsp Salt", "150 g Ripe avocado", "100 g Maple syrup", "2 large Eggs, raw", "1 dl Unsweetened almond milk", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "100 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids, chopped", "200 g Fresh raspberries", "1 tbsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C (350°F). Lightly grease and flour an 8-inch (20 cm) round cake pan. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt. In a separate large bowl, mash the ripe avocado until smooth. Add the maple syrup, eggs, almond milk, and vanilla extract to the mashed avocado and whisk until well combined and creamy. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Be careful not to overmix. Fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan and smooth the top. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the torte cool in the pan for 10 minutes before inverting it onto a wire rack to cool completely. While the torte is cooling, prepare the raspberry coulis. In a small saucepan, combine the fresh raspberries and lemon juice. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the raspberries break down and the sauce thickens slightly, about 5-7 minutes. For a smoother coulis, you can press it through a fine-mesh sieve to remove the seeds. Serve slices of the cooled torte with a drizzle of the raspberry coulis.

title: Healthy Almond and Berry Chocolate Torte
ingredients_json: ["150 g Almond flour", "50 g Unsweetened cocoa powder", "1 tsp Baking powder", "0.25 tsp Salt", "3 large Eggs", "100 g Maple syrup", "60 ml Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "100 g Mixed berries, fresh or frozen"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F) and lightly grease and line an 18cm (7-inch) springform pan. In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. In a separate large bowl, whisk the eggs until frothy, then gradually whisk in the maple syrup, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract until well combined. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Gently fold in the mixed berries. Pour the batter into the prepared springform pan and spread evenly. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the torte cool in the pan for 10 minutes before carefully releasing the sides and transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Almond Flour Chocolate Avocado Torte
ingredients_json: ["200 g Ripe avocado", "100 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids", "75 g Almond flour", "50 g Maple syrup", "3 large Egg, raw", "30 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "15 ml Vanilla extract", "5 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt, fine"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit) and grease and line a 20 cm (8-inch) springform pan. Melt the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl set over a saucepan of simmering water, stirring until smooth. In a separate bowl, mash the ripe avocado until completely smooth. Add the melted dark chocolate to the mashed avocado and stir well to combine. Whisk in the maple syrup, eggs, and vanilla extract until the mixture is uniform. In a third bowl, combine the almond flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just combined. Pour the batter into the prepared springform pan and smooth the top. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with moist crumbs attached. Let the torte cool in the pan for 10 minutes before releasing the springform side and transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Almond Flour Chocolate Raspberry Torte
ingredients_json: ["200 g Almond flour, blanched", "50 g Unsweetened cocoa powder", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1/2 tsp Salt", "4 large Eggs", "150 g Maple syrup", "100 ml Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "150 g Raspberries, fresh or frozen", "50 g Dark chocolate (70% cocoa solids), chopped"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C (350°F) and grease and flour a 20cm (8-inch) springform pan. In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt. In a separate large bowl, beat the eggs until foamy. Gradually whisk in the maple syrup, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract until well combined. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until just incorporated; do not overmix. Gently fold in the raspberries and most of the chopped dark chocolate, reserving some chocolate for topping. Pour the batter into the prepared springform pan and spread evenly. Sprinkle the remaining chocolate over the top. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the torte cool in the pan for 10 minutes before removing the sides of the springform pan. Allow it to cool completely on a wire rack before slicing and serving.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Truffles
ingredients_json: ["150 g Ripe avocado", "50 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids", "30 g Maple syrup", "15 g Unsweetened cocoa powder", "5 g Vanilla extract", "30 g Unsweetened cocoa powder, for coating"]
instructions: Melt the dark chocolate gently in a double boiler or microwave. In a food processor, combine the ripe avocado flesh, melted dark chocolate, maple syrup, 15g of unsweetened cocoa powder, and vanilla extract. Process until completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. Transfer the mixture to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or until firm enough to roll. Place the 30g of unsweetened cocoa powder for coating in a shallow dish. Scoop out tablespoon-sized portions of the chilled chocolate mixture and roll them into balls between your palms. Roll each ball in the cocoa powder until evenly coated. Store the finished truffles in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Ripe avocado", "50 g Unsweetened cocoa powder", "75 g Maple syrup", "50 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 g Chopped nuts, like almonds or walnuts (for coating)", "20 g Unsweetened cocoa powder (for coating)"]
instructions: Halve the avocado, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a food processor. Add the 50g unsweetened cocoa powder, maple syrup, and vanilla extract. Process until completely smooth and creamy. Melt the 50g dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a saucepan of simmering water, or in the microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring in between. Stir the melted chocolate into the avocado mixture until well combined. Transfer the mixture to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and chill in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour until firm enough to roll. Prepare your coatings by placing the chopped nuts on one plate and the remaining 20g cocoa powder on another. Scoop out small portions of the chilled mixture (about 1 tablespoon each) and roll them into balls between your palms. Roll each ball in the chopped nuts or cocoa powder until evenly coated. Place the finished truffles on a plate lined with parchment paper and refrigerate for at least another 30 minutes before serving to allow them to set.

title: Avocado Chocolate Truffles with Coconut
ingredients_json: ["200 g Ripe avocado", "50 g Unsweetened cocoa powder", "50 g Maple syrup", "30 g Coconut oil, melted", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 g Unsweetened shredded coconut"]
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash the ripe avocado until completely smooth. Add the unsweetened cocoa powder, maple syrup, melted coconut oil, and vanilla extract to the bowl. Stir everything together until well combined and a thick, chocolatey mixture forms. Place the bowl in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes, or until the mixture is firm enough to roll. Spoon out small portions of the mixture and roll them into bite-sized balls (about 1.5 cm in diameter). Place the shredded coconut on a plate. Roll each truffle ball in the shredded coconut until evenly coated. Arrange the finished truffles on a plate or in a container. Store in the refrigerator.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Avocado, ripe", "50 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "60 ml Maple syrup", "50 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "25 g Almonds, blanched", "25 g Coconut flakes, unsweetened"]
instructions: Melt the dark chocolate gently in a double boiler or microwave, stirring until smooth. In a food processor, combine the ripe avocado, melted dark chocolate, cocoa powder, maple syrup, and vanilla extract. Process until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes, or until firm enough to roll. While the mixture chills, finely chop the blanched almonds. Roll the chilled chocolate mixture into small balls, about 2-3 cm in diameter. If the mixture becomes too sticky, chill it again briefly. Roll half of the truffles in the chopped almonds and the other half in the unsweetened coconut flakes. Store the finished truffles in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Truffles
ingredients_json: ["200 g Avocado, ripe", "50 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "40 g Maple syrup", "10 g Coconut oil, melted", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "1 g Salt, fine", "50 g Coconut flakes, unsweetened, for coating"]
instructions: Halve the avocado, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a food processor. Add the unsweetened cocoa powder, maple syrup, melted coconut oil, vanilla extract, and salt. Process until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. Taste and adjust sweetness if necessary. Spoon the mixture into a bowl and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes until firm enough to roll. Once chilled, scoop out teaspoon-sized portions of the mixture and roll them into balls between your palms. Roll each truffle in the unsweetened coconut flakes until evenly coated. Place the finished truffles on a plate lined with parchment paper and chill for another 15 minutes before serving.

title: Apple and Cinnamon Whole Wheat Upside-Down Cake
ingredients_json: ["150 g Butter, unsalted", "100 g Brown sugar, light", "4 medium Apples, cored, peeled, and sliced", "200 g Whole wheat flour", "150 g All-purpose flour", "2 tsp Baking powder", "1/2 tsp Salt", "1 tsp Ground cinnamon", "1/4 tsp Ground nutmeg", "120 g Butter, unsalted, softened", "150 g Granulated sugar", "2 large Eggs, room temperature", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "2 dl Milk, low-fat", "1 tbsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Grease a 23cm (9-inch) round cake pan. In a small saucepan, melt 150g of butter over medium heat. Stir in the brown sugar until dissolved. Pour this mixture into the prepared cake pan, spreading it evenly. Arrange the apple slices in a decorative pattern over the brown sugar mixture. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg. In a large bowl, cream together the softened 120g butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then stir in the vanilla extract. In a small bowl, combine the milk and lemon juice. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with the milk mixture, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Pour the batter evenly over the apples in the cake pan. Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes before inverting it onto a serving plate. Serve warm.

title: Caramelized Pear and Ginger Upside-Down Cake
ingredients_json: ["150 g Butter, unsalted", "200 g Brown sugar, light", "4 medium Pears, ripe (like Conference or Bartlett)", "1 tsp Ground ginger", "250 g All-purpose flour", "1.5 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "1 tsp Ground cinnamon", "150 g Unsalted butter, softened", "175 g Granulated sugar", "2 large Eggs, raw", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "2 dl Milk, low-fat (1.5% fat)", "2 tbsp Fresh ginger, grated"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (160°C fan/gas mark 4). Melt 150g of unsalted butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the brown sugar and 1 teaspoon of ground ginger until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture is smooth. Pour this caramel mixture into the bottom of a 20cm round cake tin. Peel, core, and slice the pears. Arrange the pear slices in a decorative pattern over the caramel in the cake tin. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. In a larger bowl, cream together the 150g softened butter and granulated sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, followed by the vanilla extract and grated fresh ginger. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with the milk, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Pour the cake batter evenly over the pear slices in the prepared tin. Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes before carefully inverting it onto a serving plate. Allow to cool further before slicing and serving.

title: Apple and Cinnamon Whole Wheat Upside-Down Cake
ingredients_json: ["150 g Whole wheat flour", "75 g All-purpose flour", "1.5 tsp Baking powder", "0.5 tsp Ground cinnamon", "0.25 tsp Ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp Salt", "125 g Unsalted butter, softened", "150 g Maple syrup", "100 g Brown sugar, packed", "2 large Eggs, room temperature", "1 dl Unsweetened almond milk", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "3 medium Apples, peeled, cored, and thinly sliced (about 400g)"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175°C (350°F). Grease a 20cm (8-inch) round cake tin. In a small bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. In a large bowl, cream together 50g of the softened butter with the brown sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the maple syrup and vanilla extract. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients alternately with the almond milk, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Be careful not to overmix. In a separate saucepan, melt the remaining 75g of butter over medium heat. Stir in the maple syrup and bring to a gentle simmer for 2 minutes. Pour this mixture into the prepared cake tin and arrange the thinly sliced apples evenly over the bottom. Pour the cake batter evenly over the apples. Bake for 35-45 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes before inverting it onto a wire rack. Serve warm.

title: Whole Wheat Apple and Cinnamon Upside-Down Cake
ingredients_json: ["150 g Butter, unsalted", "100 g Brown sugar, light", "3 medium Apples, eg. Gala or Fuji, peeled, cored, and thinly sliced", "150 g Whole wheat flour", "100 g Almond flour", "1.5 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Cinnamon, ground", "0.5 tsp Nutmeg, ground", "0.25 tsp Salt", "2 large Eggs, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "100 ml Maple syrup, pure", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "50 ml Milk, semi-skimmed (1.5% fat)"]
instructions: Preheat your oven to 180°C (160°C fan/gas mark 4). Grease a 20cm round cake tin and line the base with parchment paper. In a small saucepan, melt 75g of the butter over medium heat.
